text: Beijing, CHINA, September 7, 2026 - Xiaomi today officially unveiled Xiaomi 18 Fold and Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max, both powered by the latest Xiaomi XRING O3 SoC. As Xiaomi's first-ever mid-size foldable smartphone, Xiaomi 18 Fold strikes a balance between portability and an expansive display, folding to just the size of a passport and unfolding to reveal a 7.58-inch tablet-like display, all while weighing just 219g and measuring 5.02mm thick when unfolded. Together with Xiaomi 18 Fold, Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max is the latest addition to Xiaomi's flagship tablet lineup. Designed for professional productivity on a large display, it combines flagship performance with versatile functionality for a powerful, flexible user experience across work, creativity, and entertainment. New Form Factor: From Single-Hand Fit to Full-Screen Views Adopting the same √2:1 aspect ratio as standard A4 paper, Xiaomi 18 Fold achieves a higher screen utilization rate for a range of content, from 16:9 video and 4:3 photos to documents and more. With both the inner and outer displays sharing the same aspect ratio, transitioning from one screen to the next feels more natural, creating a truly seamless user experience. When folded, Xiaomi 18 Fold measures 117.8 × 83.6mm, with a thickness of 10.68mm. At 219g, the phone is lighter than all previous Xiaomi foldable smartphones. Super-elliptical large R corners and a flat-edge frame give the phone a smooth in-hand feel and appearance, while the compact 5.38-inch outer display makes it easy to perform inputs like pull-down, typing, or back gestures with just one hand. When unfolded, Xiaomi 18 Fold opens up to an expansive 7.58-inch main screen in a slim 5.02mm body. Optimized especially for Xiaomi 18 Fold, Xiaomi HyperOS delivers a seamless multi-window experience — with two-way split providing two well-proportioned viewing areas, while three-way split gives each section a layout close to that of mainstream full-screen smartphones. Folding Architecture: Engineered for Greater Reliability Xiaomi 18 Fold is built for longevity with high-strength materials across all critical components, including a high-strength 7000-series aluminum alloy frame and Xiaomi Shield Glass 3.0 on both the outer display and back panel. The cover glass is further strengthened through ion implantation for improved drop resistance, and the new-generation Xiaomi proprietary hinge features a patented three-link design that wraps around the screen to provide added protection while creating more space for the display. Xiaomi 18 Fold debuts a dual-layer Ultra Thin Glass (UTG) structure, combining a 50μm upper UTG layer with an additional 30μm UTG support layer for enhanced inner display protection. At the same time, Xiaomi replaces the previous inorganic insulating material in the touch layer with a more stretchable organic film, further improving impact resistance. Together with reinforced hinge-area construction, these upgrades make Xiaomi 18 Fold Xiaomi's most reliable foldable smartphone to date, with 258% higher inner display impact resistance and support for drops from up to 1.2m. The optimized display stack also delivers a flatter inner display, with an average crease depth of no more than 30μm. Xiaomi XRING O3: Flagship AI SoC Unleashes Next-Gen Power Xiaomi 18 Fold is the first Xiaomi flagship powered by Xiaomi XRING O3, Xiaomi's second SoC designed entirely in-house. Built on a 3nm process, the chip packs 24 billion transistors—up from 19 billion on the previous generation—and combines a 10-core all-big-core CPU with a 16-core GPU. It also introduces architectural-level optimizations to CPU memory latency, speeding up data exchange for higher overall performance with lower power consumption Making up the 10 cores in the CPU are two Ultra cores, four Premium cores, and four Pro cores. Working together, they handle a full range of tasks while delivering 60% higher performance and 25% lower power consumption than the previous generation. For graphics, XRING O3 is equipped with the all-new G2-Ultra NX GPU featuring a massive 16-core configuration. Boosting graphics performance by 85% and reducing power consumption by 64% compared to its predecessor, the new G2-Ultra NX sets a new standard for graphics performance on a smartphone. XRING O3 is also the first SoC to support the latest LPDDR6 RAM. Featuring data rates of up to 10,667 Mbps and a 24-bit interface width — up from 16-bit on LPDDR5X — the new RAM achieves a total memory bandwidth of 113.8 GB/s, marking an almost 50% increase over LPDDR5X-9600. Xiaomi XRING O3 is an AI flagship SoC with AI deeply integrated at the architectural level. AI acceleration units are integrated across its key processing blocks, allowing lightweight AI workloads to be handled without unnecessarily invoking the NPU, improving execution efficiency while reducing power overhead. The NPU is an all-new quad-core low-power design built on SIMT architecture. Each NPU core pairs a Tensor unit with dual Vector units, delivering 200 TOPS of tensor performance (A8W4) and 3.13 TFLOPS of vector performance. When combined with Xiaomi MiMo's proprietary five-value quantization technology, Xiaomi XRING O3 delivers 45% faster on-device decoding performance compared to the previous-gen flagship processor. Through Xiaomi XRING O3, Xiaomi 18 Fold delivers stronger performance, longer battery life, and better thermal control than other foldables in everyday multitasking, large-screen gaming, and extended video playback. Leica Photography, Perfected for the Fold Xiaomi 18 Fold's 200MP Leica triple-camera system is led by a 200MP main camera powered by a flagship HP5 1/1.56-inch sensor, supporting native high dynamic range and in-sensor lossless zoom. Alongside the main camera, Xiaomi 18 Fold also features a 50MP Leica periscope telephoto camera with an inverted design that reduces module size while delivering smooth, naturally rounded bokeh. With its 80mm focal length, the camera is ideal for portrait photography, while its in-sensor zoom extends the range to 160mm with lossless zoom, making it equally versatile for landscape photography. An Uncompromising Experience From Front to Back Xiaomi 18 Fold is the first foldable smartphone to feature Xiaomi HyperRGB panels on its inner and outer displays that utilize a full RGB subpixel structure to make complete use of red, green, and blue subpixels. Both screens are Super Sunlight Displays, outputting up to 4,000 nits peak brightness with support for a 1-120Hz LTPO adaptive refresh rate, ensuring on-screen content remains clearly visible even in direct sunlight or bright indoor lighting. Packing a 6000mAh Silicon-carbon Battery, Xiaomi 18 Fold features the largest battery capacity among the same form factor. Both cells adopt a stacking process with 20% high silicon content and energy density up to 920Wh/L. Xiaomi 18 Fold supports 67W wired and 50W wireless HyperCharge. For connectivity, Xiaomi 18 Fold features Xiaomi Astral Communication with global roaming coverage in over 210 countries and regions, supported by more than 52 carriers, plus Wi-Fi 7 and UWB ultra-wideband connectivity. Ceramic Edition: Modern Innovation for a Timeless Look Xiaomi 18 Fold also comes in a special Ceramic Edition, featuring lightweight silicon nitride ceramic on the back panel — the first time this material has been used for a smartphone back panel. Silicon nitride is an advanced ceramic material that is commonly used in automotive and aircraft engines for its high-temperature resistance. It combines a warm, smooth ceramic feel with exceptionally high hardness, while weighing approximately 50% less than traditional zirconia ceramic. Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max: A 13.3-Inch Flagship for Professional Productivity Xiaomi also announces Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max, the latest addition to Xiaomi's flagship tablet lineup, designed to deliver a professional productivity experience on a large screen. Powered by the latest Xiaomi XRING O3 processor and Xiaomi HyperOS, it combines powerful performance, intelligent AI capabilities, and seamless multitasking to support demanding productivity and creative tasks. Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max features a 13.3-inch 3.4K display with a 3408 × 2272 resolution and 144Hz refresh rate, delivering sharp and smooth visuals. With up to 1000 nits of brightness, content remains clear and visible in various lighting conditions. Professional original color mode and multi-screen color consistency deliver accurate, consistent, and stable color reproduction across devices, making it ideal for professional creative and productivity workflows. At its core, Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max is powered by Xiaomi XRING O3, featuring a new 10-core all-big-core CPU design and the latest G2-Ultra NX GPU to deliver flagship performance and AI capabilities, with an AnTuTu score of over 5.61 million. Compared with tablets powered by Xiaomi XRING O1, CPU multi-core performance is improved by 54%, while GPU performance is improved by 85%, enabling Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max to handle demanding workloads and entertainment with ease. Running on Xiaomi HyperOS, it delivers a smarter and more efficient large-screen experience. Enhanced multitasking allows users to run multiple applications simultaneously, while AI-powered features help streamline everyday tasks and boost productivity. Equipped with a 12000mAh battery and 120W HyperCharge, Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max provides long-lasting power throughout the day. Its 6-mic array with high signal-to-noise ratio microphones enables clearer audio pickup from greater distances, while Wi-Fi 7 provides fast and stable connectivity. For greater versatility, Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max introduces DP-in video input for the first time, supporting resolutions of up to 3.4K at 120Hz via a full-featured USB-C cable, offering greater flexibility across work, gaming, and creative scenarios. Pricing & Availability Xiaomi 18 Fold Xiaomi 18 Fold is available in four variants: Black, White, Red, and Ceramic Version. Xiaomi 18 Fold comes in four storage variants: 12GB+256GB - RMB 10999 yuan 12GB+512GB - RMB 11999 yuan 16GB+512GB - RMB 12999 yuan 16GB+1TB - RMB 14999 yuan Xiaomi 18 Fold Ceramic Version is only available in the 16GB+1TB variant, starting at RMB 15999 yuan. Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max is available in three variants: Black, Silver, and Red. Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max comes in five storage variants: 8GB+256GB - RMB 4799 yuan 12GB+256GB - RMB 5299 yuan 12GB+512GB - RMB 6099 yuan 16GB+256GB - RMB 5799 yuan 16GB+512GB - RMB 6599 yuan Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max Matte Glass Version is only available in Red and the following two storage variants: 16GB+512GB - RMB 6899 yuan 16GB+1TB - RMB 7899 yuan ENDS About Xiaomi Corporation Xiaomi Corporation was founded in April 2010 and listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on July 9, 2018 (1810.HK). Xiaomi is a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones, smart hardware, and smart electric vehicles connected by an IoT platform at its core. Embracing our vision of "Make friends with users and be the coolest company in the users' hearts", Xiaomi continuously pursues innovations, high-quality user experience and operational efficiency. The Company relentlessly builds amazing products with honest prices to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology. Xiaomi is one of the world's leading smartphone companies. In June 2026, the MAU reached 766.5 million (including smartphones and tablets) globally. The Company has also established the world's leading consumer AIoT (AI+IoT) platform. As of June 30, 2026, the number of IoT devices connected to its platform (excluding smartphones, laptops, and tablets) reached 1,160.8 million. In October 2023, Xiaomi upgraded its strategy to "Human × Car × Home" smart ecosystem, seamlessly merging personal devices, smart home products, and cars. The Company has rapidly emerged as a leading innovator in the smart electric vehicle industry, reaching profitability within six quarters of commencing deliveries and delivering over 800,000 units by September 2026. Xiaomi always centers on humanity and is committed to providing comprehensive, better connected experiences. Xiaomi products are present in more than 100 countries and regions around the world. In July 2026, Xiaomi was included in the Fortune Global 500 list for the eighth year in a row, ranking 232nd. text: SINGAPORE, October 3, 2026 — At the Gran Turismo World Series ( GT World Series ) 2026 Round 3 in Singapore, Gran Turismo series Producer Kazunori Yamauchi and Jean-Arthur Madelaine, Head of Design from Xiaomi Europe R&D and Design Center at Xiaomi Auto, announced that Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo (Xiaomi Vision GT) will join Gran Turismo 7 (GT7) this October. The announcement also introduced Gran Turismo’s first EV Driving Experience , featuring dedicated driving challenges and training with Xiaomi SU7 Ultra and Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo. Yamauchi and Madelaine took the stage together to discuss the development of Xiaomi Vision GT and the evolving experience of electric performance driving. Xiaomi Joins the Vision Gran Turismo Project as Its 36th Participating Brand Launched in 2013, Vision Gran Turismo invites leading brands to imagine and create original concept cars exclusively for the Gran Turismo series. Over the past decade, the project has brought together some of the world’s most renowned automotive marques and produced 50 Vision Gran Turismo models, establishing a unique platform at the intersection of automotive design, engineering and virtual racing culture. Xiaomi is the 36th brand, and the first technology company, to join the Vision Gran Turismo project. Xiaomi Vision GT made its global debut at Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona, where it was unveiled by Xiaomi Auto Chief Designer Li Tianyuan and drew strong interest from automotive communities and car enthusiasts worldwide. The physical concept was subsequently showcased at Auto China 2026 in Beijing. Its arrival in Gran Turismo 7 marks the next milestone in Xiaomi Vision GT’s journey from design vision to an interactive driving experience for players worldwide. Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo: Sculpted by the Wind Xiaomi Vision GT is guided by the desi gn philosophy “Sculpted by the Wind.” Rather than relying on deliberately sharpened surfaces or add-on aerodynamic elements, the car is shaped around a suspended teardrop-like cabin, with every surface aerodynamically optimized and every structural elemen t designed with an airfoil cross-section. Building on aerodynamic solutions proven in production vehicles such as Xiaomi SU7 and Xiaomi YU7, Xiaomi Vision GT takes the approach further: its cross-shaped headlights also function as airflow guides, while the signature halo-shaped taillight is integrated into the rear air channel. Together with an active wake-control system, these features enable an aerodynamic efficiency value of 4.1 and a drag coefficient (Cd) of 0.29. Xiaomi Vision GT also introduces the “Sofa Racer” concept, centered on a cocoon-like cockpit that combines comfort, immersion and driver focus. Powered by Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi AI Voice Assistant and Xiaomi MiMo foundation model, the cockpit can anticipate and respond to driver intent while connecting naturally with Xiaomi’s "Human × Car × Home" smart ecosystem. Commenting on the design, Yamauchi said: “The overall design maintains its simplicity while revealing an indescribably sleek and incredibly sexy curved aesthetic. I believe this car will become a role model for this era." Kazunori Yamauchi and Jean-Arthur Madelaine: Xiaomi Vision GT Feels Incredibly Smooth in the Game Yamauchi noted that Xiaomi Vision GT has generated strong interest among racing and gaming enthusiasts since its appearances at MWC Barcelona and Auto China earlier this year. The community’s anticipation of experiencing the vehicle in Gran Turismo 7 helped build momentum behind the collaboration. Reflecting on his experience, Madelaine described Xiaomi Vision GT as a futuristic driver's car that is "sculpted by the wind", engineered to pursue the perfect balance between low drag and high downforce. In the game, it maintains both high speed and exceptional stability, resulting in an incredibly smooth overall driving experience. Gran Turismo 7 Introduces Its First EV Driving Experience The two companies also announced that Gran Turismo 7 will introduce its first EV Experience feature, with events featuring Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo. The feature gives players a new way to explore the distinct acceleration, braking and handling characteristics of high-performance EVs within the authentic driving environment of Gran Turismo 7 . A New Chapter in Xiaomi Auto’s Connection with Global Car Culture With Xiaomi SU7 Ultra joining Gran Turismo 7 , Xiaomi Vision GT entering the Vision Gran Turismo lineup, and both models featuring in the new EV Experience feature , Xiaomi Auto is expanding its presence across production performance cars, visionary concept design and interactive driving experiences. Gran Turismo 7 players worldwide will soon be able to drive Xiaomi Vision GT on iconic circuits including the Nürburgring, Le Mans and Suzuka. Through original design, advanced engineering and digital innovation, Xiaomi Auto will continue to contribute a distinctive perspective to global automotive and racing culture. *All performance data for Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo were obtained through iterative simulated testing under simulated environment and do not represent actual on-road performance. text: Beijing, CHINA, September 7th, 2026 — Xiaomi Auto officially launched Xiaomi SkyNomad Series at Xiaomi Fall Flagship Launch Event, introducing the all-new Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 and Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 models. As an Intelligent, Reconfigurable, Large-space SUV family built on the Xiaomi Kunlun Platform, Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro and Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max target the five-seat extended-range SUV segment, Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max positions itself as a seven-seat flagship for both business and family use, and Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio takes things further, transforming the vehicle into a mobile living space with a two-level loft layout, a second row that converts to a bed in 30 seconds, floor heating, and an electric lifting cabin roof. All four share the Xiaomi Kunlun Technical Architecture, each answering a different vision of what a car should be. The launch covers four models: Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro : Five-seat extended-range SUV, the gateway to an Intelligent, Reconfigurable, Large-space SUV Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max : Five-seat all-wheel-drive extended-range SUV, the benchmark for an Intelligent, Reconfigurable, Large-space SUV Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max : Seven-seat flagship extended-range SUV, the all-around flagship for business and family Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio : A mobile personal space, featuring a factory-integrated electric lifting cabin roof, designed for professionals as a mobile studio Xiaomi SkyNomad Series Official Pricing Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro ｜ Five-Seat Extended-Range SUV RMB 209,900 Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max ｜ Five-Seat AWD Extended-Range SUV RMB 239,900 Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max ｜ Seven-Seat Flagship Extended-Range SUV RMB 269,900 Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio ｜ Mobile Personal Space RMB 299,900 Xiaomi SkyNomad N70: A New Answer for Five-Seat Extended-Range SUVs Body Surfaces and Stance, Designed for Space Xiaomi Auto has always adhered to the philosophy of "design that stands the test of time." Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 shares the same design language and style as Xiaomi SkyNomad N90, with a commanding, composed presence that continues the classic luxury SUV proportions of a short front overhang and long rear overhang. Refined and composed: body proportions and stance are a projection of interior space Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 measures 4,960mm in length, 1,998mm in width, and has a wheelbase of 2,950mm. The body surfacing is clean and restrained, with all edges rounded off for a boxy silhouette that creates a cavernous interior space. The side profile looks younger and more athletic, with a forward-leaning D-pillar and subtle roofline slope creating a sense of power and momentum. The signature dragonfly headlights feature a high-beam range of up to 624 meters and a low-beam coverage angle of 180° , for clear visibility at night and on narrow roads. The halo-shaped taillights with their inverted U-shaped design are wide and stable, offering rich light layering and strong recognizability. Six Colors: Effortlessly Balancing Fashion and Classic Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 is available in Valley Blue, Mountain Green, Pearl White, Volcanic Gray, Obsidian Black, and Light Khaki , a palette that blends fashion, luxury, and timeless appeal. Valley Blue : Inspired by the mountain waters and skies deep within a valley. Under sunlight, the layers of color are finely textured; on overcast days, it takes on the deep blue tone of a mountain stream, understated and elegant. Mountain Green : The color of distant mountains, where blue and green merge in quiet subtlety. As light shifts, it evokes the misty verdant hues of mountain ridges, refined and introspective. Pearl White : Derived from the luster of natural seawater pearls. Not a plain white, its sheen shifts with the angle, lively, delicate, and full of vitality. Volcanic Gray : The natural color of cooled lava flows. A high-purity gray layered with nano-scale mineral particles that reveals a fine, multi-dimensional metallic texture in changing light. Obsidian Black : The depth of black fused with a gemstone-like luster. Dignified, commanding, and full of mystery and power. Light Khaki : Inspired by the natural tones of earth, sand, and morning mist. More restrained than beige, cooler than khaki, a neutral gray with an inherent sense of refinement. The interior is available in three colorways ( Cream Beige, Mocha Brown, and Nightscape Black ), three distinct design moods to suit different aesthetic preferences. Premium Interior Starting with Experience: Refined Comfort Within Reach Drawing from home furnishing design concepts, Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 features a "cabinet-style center console" , a "sliding center console" , and up to 33 storage compartments . Paired with a 1,530mm full-width dashboard display and 6.14m² of glass area, the cabin feels open and transparent, creating a refined, home-like atmosphere. The 256-color digital light curtain ambient lighting system uses diffuse reflection to create a theater-like lighting atmosphere. 95% of high-touch surfaces throughout the vehicle are soft-wrapped , and the OEKO-TEX®-certified interior is suitable for direct skin contact, including for infants under three, helping reduce concerns about allergens or harmful-substance migration. The cabin also comes standard with an energy-efficient heat pump air conditioning system, independent B-pillar air vents for the second row, so everyone can find their ideal temperature. The front seatbacks feature a 15-layer stacked construction that provides both comfort and support. Sitting down, you're enveloped as if in a plush lounge chair. Intelligent, Reconfigurable, Large-space: Returning to the Source of Needs, Letting Space Adapt to People Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 is built on the Xiaomi Kunlun Platform , featuring an Intelligent, Reconfigurable, Large-space design that achieves a layout rarely seen in mid-to-large extended-range SUVs: a completely flat floor with extra-long sliding rails. This eliminates the step-up design common in traditional mid-to-large SUVs for flexible, open space throughout. In the Xiaomi Kunlun Platform's design logic, space is no longer a byproduct of structural compromises. It is the starting point of product development, reserving space for those sitting inside. Flat Floor Running Through: Ultra-Large, Open Space; Storage and Camping Made Easy Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 comes standard with a flat floor. From the first and second rows to the trunk, the flat floor features only a 2.95° incline, extending up to 2.58 meters with a flat area of 4.01m². Five extra-long sliding rails are fitted, with the longest reaching 1.56 meters, allowing the second-row seats to slide up to 600mm for flexible space configuration. With the second-row seats in their standard position, the legroom measures 1,010mm with 1,021mm of headroom, so passengers up to 1.9 m can stretch out comfortably. With the second-row seats pushed to their rearmost position, maximum legroom reaches 1,410mm , 50% more than comparably sized vehicles, offering class-leading spaciousness. The trunk offers 1,203 liters of cargo space in its standard configuration, easily accommodating strollers, scooters, and daily essentials, or up to 10 suitcases. With the second-row seats folded flat, the cavernous 2,425-liter space can fit up to 38 twenty-inch suitcases. Beyond sheer volume, the trunk opening is wide and the sill is low, making it easy for the whole family to load and unload luggage. The rear doors open to nearly 90° , with a sill height of just 385mm from the ground, and electric door sills that make getting in and out easier and safer for children and elderly passengers. A Mobile Home: A Different Seating Position Means a Different Space Based on in-depth research into users' most frequent scenarios, Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 features a curated set of one-touch signature scenarios for nearly effortless convenience. Family Tea Break : Front seats rotate rearward for face-to-face meals or tea. The flat floor plus a sliding rail-mounted table transforms the space; after the meal, the table folds away and the second row becomes a rest area. With up to 1,410mm of second-row legroom, children can even do homework in the car, with the car-mounted table doubling as a study desk, all in a quiet, undisturbed cabin. *Rail-mounted table sold separately Family Playground : Front seats rotate and slide back, second-row seats slide rearward, creating an expansive family zone. Young families no longer need to juggle feeding, diaper changes, and playtime on the go. *Cup holder-mounted table sold separately Maximum Cargo : The trunk's maximum depth is 1.9 meters with up to 2,425 liters of expandable space. Whether it's a weekend camping trip with tents, chairs, cookbooks, and outdoor gear, or a weekend shopping run with large appliances and furniture, everything fits in one trip. First-Class Mode : Second-row seats slide rearward for up to 1,410mm of legroom, instantly creating a "first-class" experience. Even large family dogs can stretch out comfortably on the spacious flat floor, ideal for pet owners. A Luxury Comfortable Cabin: Refrigerator, Screen, and Lounge Seating, Plus Premium Xiaomi Astral Sound System Lounge Seating : Front seats are comfortable yet supportive, with 15-layer stacked seatback construction. Standard features include 16-point massage, ventilation, and heating. Massage seats, zero-gravity seats, or rotating seats are available as options. Onboard Refrigerator : A 9-liter ultra-large capacity, standing up to 10 cans of 330 ml Coca-Cola. It uses an independent compressor for seamless switching between heating and cooling, and features Flyback technology so cold drinks can be conveniently stored in the car. Rear Entertainment Screen : A 21.4-inch screen with a viewing distance of up to 1.15 meters, offering a great view from nearly every seat. Additionally, Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro comes standard with a 14-speaker sound system including a 200mm ultra-large subwoofer and 2 headrest speakers. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max features Xiaomi Auto's self-developed acoustic flagship, Xiaomi Astral Sound System , with 25 speakers in a 7.1.4 acoustic architecture, 4,890 W peak power, and 7 titanium-dome tweeters for more transparent, detailed, and stable high frequencies. Leveraging Xiaomi SkyNomad's large space, the sound field layout has been redesigned , incorporating "direct-firing tweeters," "presence midrange," and "reflected bass." Front tweeters sit on the triangular windows and rear tweeters on the B-pillars, directing sound toward passengers and minimizing reflections. Midrange speakers are positioned at the upper front corners of the door panels, closer to the tweeters, for more present vocals. Bass uses three reflective surfaces (door panels, floor, and dashboard) for wider coverage with fuller low-frequency energy and powerful, impactful output. Ease Range Anxiety: A Large Car That's Easy to Drive Xiaomi Kunlun HyperRange: Go the Distance with Confidence Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 is equipped with Xiaomi Kunlun Hyper Range System , a large-battery extended-range architecture delivering ultra-long electric range and ultra-low depleted-battery fuel consumption. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro features a 52 kWh lithium iron phosphate Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery with a CLTC pure-electric range of 351km and a CLTC combined range of up to 1,351km . It uses a front-wheel-drive architecture with a 0-100km/h time of 7.9 seconds, charging once every five days for daily commutes, helping reduce range anxiety. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max features dual-motor all-wheel drive, accelerating from 0-100km/h in 5.5 seconds, and is equipped with a 76 kWh ternary lithium Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery with a CLTC pure-electric range of 505km and a CLTC combined range of 1,461km, one of the leading pure-electric ranges among extended-range vehicles, usable as a pure EV for daily city driving. Charging from 20% to 80% takes as fast as 18 minutes, with 310km of CLTC range replenished in up to 15 minutes. Public charger compatibility is excellent, with a 99% first-attempt success rate, helping ease range anxiety. For long-distance travel, the range performance is reassuring. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max achieves a fuel consumption as low as 6.1L/100km in depleted-battery mode, while Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro's depleted-battery fuel consumption is just 5.7L/100km , excellent for the segment. The range extender requires its first service after 3 years or 30,000km, and the entire lineup supports 92, 95, and 98 octane gasoline for convenient, cost-effective travel. A Large Car That's Easy to Drive: Agile, Confident, and Easy to Handle Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 inherits the driving DNA hardware foundation of Xiaomi SU7 and Xiaomi YU7. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 features a front double-wishbone independent suspension and a rear integrated multi-link independent suspension . Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max comes standard with 5-level adjustable air suspension paired with continuously variable damping, plus four hydraulic bushings front and rear, effectively filtering road vibration for a smooth, comfortable ride. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 has a turning radius of just 5.67 meters , with steering precise enough to U-turn across three lanes in one go. The steering feel is adjustable in three modes, using an R-EPS rack-type electric power steering system that delivers authentic road feel and precise control, making this large car nimble and easy to handle. Braking is confident: 100-0km/h stopping distance is just 38.25 meters , with performance remaining stable even after 10 consecutive stops. Whether it's city commuting or long-distance road trips, Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 gives you the confidence and peace of mind you need. Advanced Intelligent Ecosystem: AI Empowers Every Family, Every Scenario Full-Vehicle Intelligence, One Step: AI-Powered Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi AI Voice Assistant Understands Your Every Need in One Command Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 is equipped with the Xiaomi Super EEA , achieving a four-in-one domain control module , making it smaller, lighter, more energy-efficient, and faster. It features the third-generation Snapdragon® 8 mobile platform on an advanced 4 nm process, instant app launches and smooth system operation. The entire lineup also comes standard with the NVIDIA Thor-U assisted driving chip, delivering 700 TOPS of computing power for faster response and stronger decision-making. The entire vehicle is fitted with the Flyback onboard low-voltage power supply system . When the fridge or sentry mode is active with the vehicle off, energy consumption is reduced by 60% compared to non-Flyback power supplies, for more reliable power usage. The vehicle features eFuse intelligent power distribution: traditional fuses take over 10 ms to disconnect, while eFuse takes less than 100 μs, making full-vehicle power usage safer. The vehicle supports multi-screen connectivity, featuring an 8.88-inch instrument display, a 16.1-inch central control screen, and an optional 21.4-inch rear entertainment screen. The front passenger seatback can accommodate a tablet mount supporting four Xiaomi tablet models, enabling seamless content sharing across the entire family. Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi AI Voice Assistant has been fully upgraded , covering 95% of vehicle control functions and enabling intelligent space orchestration: one command switches between more than ten layout modes. It understands intent like "I want to lie down and watch the stars," then coordinates the seats, lighting, air conditioning, and sound system to create a stargazing mode in one touch. It also brings enhanced Apple device compatibility, fully integrating into the Apple ecosystem for a friendlier experience for Apple users. The entire lineup comes standard with the NVIDIA Thor-U chip, LiDAR, and 4DmmWave radar, offering fully loaded assisted driving hardware. The entire lineup features Xiaomi Hyper Assisted Driving with the XLA architecture, continuously optimizing user experience, supporting voice-controlled driving, spatial understanding, and intelligent prediction. The entire lineup comes standard with 25 safety assistance features, including AEB (Autonomous Emergency Braking) with expanding obstacle recognition capabilities and AES (Autonomous Emergency Steering) supporting up to two consecutive evasive maneuvers. Safety Above All: Comprehensive Protection Across Every Dimension, Every Scenario Safety is the prerequisite. Safety is the foundation. Safety is everything. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 features the Xiaomi Kunlun Total Safety system, delivering comprehensive safety protection across every seat and scenario. Armor-Cage Steel-Aluminum Hybrid Body Structure: Safety Strength That Exceeds Its Class Xiaomi SkyNomad N70's body uses high-strength steel and aluminum alloy for up to 91.3% of its construction, balancing overall strength with lightweight design. 14 locations use 2,200MPa Xiaomi ultra-high strength steel , leading the segment. The 2,200MPa "embedded roll cage" features hot-gas-expanded tubes from A-pillar to C-pillar, fully prepared for rollover scenarios. It also features an integrated hot-formed door ring , significantly enhancing body load-bearing capacity. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 comes standard with 9 airbags: first-row far-side airbags with 4-point mounting, second-row side airbags and side curtain airbags. Nine collision sensors are fitted as standard, covering a wider range of collision scenarios. Safety development for all seating positions, exceeding C-NCAP and CIASI requirements. The door handles feature a triple-redundant design : even if a collision cuts all power, the central locking still releases and doors still open, with mechanical release handles inside and out. Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery: The Industry's Leading Battery Safety and Quality Standards Xiaomi has placed great emphasis on battery R&D capabilities since the inception of its automotive venture, continuously accumulating technical expertise and practical experience in battery safety. Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery features 18 layers of hardcore structural safety protection, designed to withstand a 500J bottom impact, exceeding relevant national standards. Up to 16 layers of thermal safety protection ensure that at 55°C with a fully charged single cell undergoing thermal runaway, it is designed to resist thermal propagation, fire, and explosion. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro is equipped with a 52kWh lithium iron phosphate Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery, and Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max with a 76kWh ternary lithium Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery, both undergoing comprehensive, end-to-end quality control and a simulated 300,000km durability test. The entire lineup comes standard with a Low-Speed Auxiliary Lighting located below the side mirrors, with a single-side coverage area of 12.88m². In low-light conditions, it activates automatically when the surround-view camera is engaged or parking assistance is in use, making the driving and parking experience safer and more reassuring. The vehicle features up to 650mm of wading capability , handling scenarios such as urban flooding, and also supports emergency floating escape. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max: The Next-Generation "Land Business Class" A Flagship Extended-Range SUV Born for Space Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max is positioned as a seven-seat flagship extended-range SUV , with dimensions on par with mainstream 9-series flagship SUVs: 5,285mm in length, 1,998mm in width, and a 3,080mm wheelbase. The body surfacing is clean and restrained, with body lines supporting a commanding, broad outline, delivering a powerful "boxy" silhouette and a cavernous interior space. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max is available in seven exterior colors: Mountain Green, Valley Blue, Volcanic Gray, Light Khaki, Pearl White, Obsidian Black, and one N90 Max exclusive color, Maroon Red. Inspired by aged fine wine, Maroon Red features a low brightness and medium-high saturation, deep and composed in shadow, blooming with a rich, gem-like, translucent red luster under light, warm and refined with exceptional texture. Three interior design options are available (Cream Beige, Mocha Brown, and Nightscape Black), whether warm and refined or business-luxurious, there's a choice to suit preference. The Flexible Space for Business Flagship and Family Flagship Business Flagship: The Next-Generation "Land Business Class" For many business professionals, the place they spend the most hours is not the office, but on the road, meeting clients, running projects, traveling, and attending meetings. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max redefines the mobile business space. At 5.28 meters, this large flagship SUV adopts a 2+2+3 seven-seat layout , with a commanding exterior presence that carries an air of authority without being ostentatious. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max supports four-seat zero-gravity seating: both front and second rows offering zero-gravity mode. Front seats are available in two configurations: zero-gravity seats that unlock a "mobile first-class cabin" for an MPV-level space experience; or rotating seats with a table that transforms the cabin into an interactive lounge for face-to-face meals with family, discussing projects, signing contracts, or even opening a laptop to instantly create a personal office. Family Flagship: Setting Off with the Whole Family and a Car Full of Happiness For most Chinese families, buying a car is never just for oneself. It's for the children, the parents, and every departure the whole family takes. When the whole family travels in Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max, seven people and seven twenty-inch suitcases fit comfortably . Second-row legroom measures 950mm, so passengers up to 1.9 m can sit comfortably. The center aisle to the third row is 180mm wide, allowing access without moving seats. Third-row legroom reaches 890mm with 962mm of headroom, so three adults can sit together with ease. The nearly 90° door opening and electric side steps let elderly passengers board without bending or struggling, and children board more safely. In maximum cargo mode, the expandable trunk can carry two 700C road bikes with full cycling gear, with no wheel removal needed. The small transitions of daily life hold the most practical needs, such as waiting between school runs, delivering lunch to a child, or the gap before an after-school class. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max is designed for these real-life moments. Park the car and it becomes a mobile dining room for lunch delivery. After picking up one child, while waiting for another to finish class, the child can do homework, read, or rest inside the car. Waiting is no longer just waiting; it's an extension of life. Confident Road Trips: A Large Car That's Easy to Drive, Experience Beyond Its Class Equipped with "Xiaomi Kunlun Hyper Range System": Industry-Leading Combined Range, Go the Distance with Confidence Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max is equipped with Xiaomi Kunlun Hyper Range System , featuring dual-motor all-wheel drive, a 0-100km/h time of 5.9 seconds, and a top speed of 190km/h. It is fitted with a 76kWh ternary lithium Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery, delivering a CLTC pure-electric range of 464km and a combined range of up to 1,705km , enabling a non-stop trip from Shanghai to Beijing, over 1,000 kilometers, without recharging . Energy efficiency is industry-leading, WLTC depleted-battery fuel consumption as low as 6.26L/100km. The chassis configuration is luxurious, coming standard with air springs and continuously variable damping shock absorbers. It features a front double-wishbone independent suspension and a rear integrated multi-link independent suspension . It smooths out bumps, stays composed through lane changes, and delivers linear acceleration, light and precise steering, and controlled braking, so even a large car is easy to drive. Intelligent Safety Flagship For the intelligent cabin, Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max features a 16.1-inch 3K central control screen, a 20-inch HUD, an 8.88-inch instrument display, a 21.4-inch rear entertainment screen, a rear mobile control screen, and an expandable pad on the front passenger seatback, supporting six-screen connectivity for seamless content flow. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max also features a rear-facing solid-state LiDAR , with a maximum ranging accuracy of 2 cm, enabling it to handle more complex parking scenarios and alleviating the difficulty of parking a large vehicle, making parking assistance safer and more capable. It features the Xiaomi Kunlun Total Safety system, with an armored cage-type hybrid body providing all-round occupant protection, extensively using 2,200 MPa ultra-high-strength steel, up to 16 locations using 2,200 MPa hot-stamped steel to enhance strength at critical points. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max also features a 2,200 MPa "embedded roll cage" with an integrated hot-stamped door ring (13-in-1), covering the A, B, C, and D pillars and the first, second, and third rows for comprehensive occupant cell protection. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max comes standard with 12 airbags , ensuring all-round protection for passengers in all three rows. Triple-redundant door handles, up to 750mm of wading capability, and 160km/h tire blowout stability control are among the emergency safety features that comprehensively strengthen protection. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio: A Mobile Personal Space A World That Moves With You: Exploring the Boundaries of Space One SUV. A world that moves with you. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio is Xiaomi Auto's boldest exploration of that idea, built on Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max. A Rare Factory-Integrated Electric Lifting Cabin Roof SUV Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio features a factory-integrated electric lifting cabin roof, a design currently very rare on domestic SUVs. The roof's height increase is controlled at 100mm, finished in body color to blend seamlessly with the vehicle. The drag coefficient achieves a remarkably low Cd of 0.245 for a large extended-range SUV. When the roof is raised, the interior transforms into a two-level loft space . The total raised roof height is reaching up to 2,294mm, so adults up to 1.8 meters tall can stand upright even at the lowest point in the rear. The second-level activity area measures 2,110mm × 985mm, with a maximum bed board length of 1,946mm . It uses an aluminum metal frame with aluminum honeycomb panel reinforcement, supporting up to 200 kg while maintaining lightweight construction. The lifting cabin roof features three sides with five mesh screens; the forward-facing screen can be fully opened, offering 1.7m² of expansive window area for a panoramic viewing experience on the upper level. The factory-integrated upper level also includes air conditioning vents, an 18 W charging port, and magnetic mounting points, paired with an original 30mm comfort mattress in the same beige design as the interior, warm and refined. Redesigned Large Five-Seat: Your Mobile Studio with a Bed and a Seat Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio reimagines the interior space, rethinking the concept of the second row entirely, with a new design that is more like an Italian sofa. The second row can transform into a bed in one touch , no disassembly, no mattress needed, just 30 seconds to get a remarkably flat large bed : 1.87 meters long, 1.24 meters wide, with classic diamond quilting, plump surfaces, and a soft touch that's comfortable for adults to lie on. It comes standard with ventilation and heating, cooling in summer and warming in winter, and features electric headrests that automatically flip and stow, eliminating the hassle of manual removal. The second-row seats use a 40/60 split design, with both left and right sides capable of independently transforming into a bed. Set the left side as an independent bed and install a rail-mounted table on the right to create a personal refined living room where you can not only sit and work, eat, or play games, but you can also lie down and rest at any time. Living room, bedroom, and workspace, all effortlessly achieved in one vehicle. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio features factory wood-grain aluminum-alloy floor , covering an area of 1.7m². Using a multi-layer composite structure with an aluminum alloy frame , the surface has a wood-grain texture design with a tactile, real-grain feel that creates a home-like atmosphere inside the vehicle. The flooring is ultra-wear-resistant, so after 6,000+ abrasion cycles, daily stepping, shoe friction, drink spills, and hard-object scratches are less likely to leave marks, and it stays easy to maintain and resistant to dirt and corrosion. The floor comes standard with factory-integrated floor heating , using aviation-grade sealing materials, offering three adjustable temperature settings up to 38°C. In the cold northern winters, the car has floor heating, heat pump air conditioning, a heated steering wheel, and heated seats throughout, plus a fridge that can also heat, making the interior truly as warm as home. One Vehicle, A Home Wherever You Go Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio supports a 30-inch screen cinematic projection system, with an optimized support arm structure for better screen flatness. Draw the blackout curtains during the day for a clear picture; at night, the viewing experience is gentle on the eyes. The vehicle offers an industry-rare car-mounted large-screen viewing distance. With the second row pushed to its rearmost position, the viewing distance reaches 1,096mm for a highly immersive experience. It also features a unique "privacy screen mode" : the screen lowers without projection, serving as a cabin partition for privacy and light blocking simultaneously. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio goes beyond a driving companion, offering a suite of luxury features for personal retreat: a floating nightstand with soft fabric wrapping and a refined surface touch, featuring 220 V and 15 V dual outlets for on-the-go device charging; a 20-liter total capacity built-in cabinet with individual lighting in each compartment for organizing watches, phones, and glasses at arm's reach; and an 11.5-inch vanity mirror with a 115° opening angle, stepless positioning, and a 4,000 K ring light, so you can wake up and do your makeup right in the car, instantly transforming it into a mobile makeup studio for content creators. For camping enthusiasts, this is an ideal "camping vehicle." A large bed inside plus the rooftop loft space, 30 seconds to set up a "private loft." While others are still pitching tents, your "mobile campsite" is ready to go. For creative professionals, Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio is a purpose-built mobile studio. With 220V power, Wi-Fi, a sound system, and a fridge, plus a table, sofa, bed, wood-grain flooring, and floor heating for maximum home comfort, plus a ceiling high enough to actually stand under. Drive into the mountains or park by the sea, coffee in hand, nature all around, and rediscover your creative source in the wild. Flagship Performance, Standard Across the Lineup Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio shares the same luxury specifications and top-tier hardware as Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max: dual-motor all-wheel drive with a 0-100km/h time of 5.9 seconds; a 76kWh ternary lithium Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery with a CLTC pure-electric range of 462km and a CLTC combined range of 1,688km. Performance, range, driving dynamics, intelligence, and safety, all at flagship level across every dimension. From the intelligently configurable spacious interior of Xiaomi SkyNomad N70, to Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max’s all-round versatility for both business and family use, and Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio’s bold exploration of the concept “the car as a lifestyle,” Xiaomi SkyNomad addresses all the key questions around space, range, safety, and intelligence in a single vehicle. A combined range of 1,705km (Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max) helps reduce range anxiety on long-distance journeys. The Xiaomi Kunlun Total Safety system helps raise the bar for vehicle safety, while Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Studio’s electric lifting cabin roof and second-row seats that transform into a bed in just 30 seconds give the vehicle, for the first time, a genuine ability to “live” in. Xiaomi SkyNomad's goal is not to add another screen or feature to an existing category, but to turn the car into a mobile space that is truly your own. *Xiaomi SkyNomad Series is announced in 2026 and currently only available in the Chinese Mainland. **Data in this press release was retrieved from Xiaomi Auto Lab and/or partners, and may vary depending on models/configurations. ***Some configurations are optional. ****Xiaomi CarIoT accessories need to be purchased separately. text: BEIJING, China, August 27, 2026 – Xiaomi today unveiled REDMI Note 17 Series, the latest generation of its best-selling smartphone lineup, introducing four new models, including the first-ever Pro Max model — REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G. The series provides substantially larger batteries and faster charging for extended endurance, enhanced water and drop resistance, and an all-new design language, bringing long-lasting reliability to the mid-range segment and delivering on REDMI's vision of a smartphone built for years. The launch also marks a major milestone: REDMI Note Series has now surpassed 500 million shipments worldwide.¹ Generation after generation, the series has stayed true to what earned that trust: " premium products made accessible, and premium quality across every product ." REDMI Note 17 Series carries this forward, with every upgrade designed to help users enjoy their devices with confidence for years to come. Leading the lineup is the first-ever REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G , combining a bold new design, REDMI Titan Quality, flagship-grade experiences, and Xiaomi's largest-ever 10,000mAh smartphone battery.² Together with REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G , REDMI Note 17 5G , and REDMI Note 17 , the four-device lineup brings REDMI's Built for Years philosophy to users with different needs and lifestyles. Built with REDMI Titan Quality, the series reflects Xiaomi's commitment to engineering smartphones that remain dependable through years of daily use. That commitment extends throughout the ownership experience, with up to six years of security updates across the lineup. On selected models, users also benefit from up to six years of battery health.³ REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G goes a step further with a six-year like-new software experience,⁴ ensuring lasting smoothness and reliability over time. REDMI Titan Quality: built around your everyday needs REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G⁶ and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G⁷ are the first in the industry to earn TÜV SÜD 5-star Titan Quality Certification, a new quality standard co-developed with TÜV SÜD under the philosophy of "built to last, made to trust." The certification validates three critical dimensions of long-term reliability through rigorous lab and real-world testing: drop resistance covering mechanical impact, vibration, collision, and port and button lifecycle; water resistance spanning extended submersion endurance across 8 testing categories; and battery performance encompassing temperature cycling, mechanical shock, high-cycle charging, and long-range endurance. REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G⁶ and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G⁷ achieve full certification across all three dimensions. REDMI Note 17 5G and REDMI Note 17 carry TÜV SÜD 5-star Battery Performance Certification,⁸ with battery longevity validated to the same rigorous standard. From the battery that powers each day to the structure that survives each drop, REDMI Titan Quality is designed around the ways people actually use their phones. REDMI Titan Battery System: endurance when it matters most With up to three days of battery life on a single charge and just 20 minutes of charging for a full day of use,⁹ REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G is built for users who need their phone to keep pace — not hold them back. The entire REDMI Note 17 Series features the REDMI Titan Battery System, built around advanced silicon-carbon battery technology to deliver a dual breakthrough in ultra-long battery life and intelligent power management. REDMI Titan Quality is built on the experiences users rely on most every day, starting with battery endurance. REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G introduces Xiaomi's largest-ever smartphone battery, featuring a 10,000mAh battery with 16% silicon content.² In select markets, the device is equipped with a 9,210mAh battery,² delivering the same fast-charging and long-cycle-life performance. Paired with 100W HyperCharge¹⁰ and 27W reverse charging¹¹, it delivers exceptional endurance and fast charging for users who rely on their devices throughout the day and beyond. The focus on battery endurance continues across the series. REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G features an 8,340mAh² battery with 67W HyperCharge,¹⁰ while REDMI Note 17 5G and REDMI Note 17 come with a 7,700mAh battery² and 45W turbo charging.¹⁰ Supported by smart battery management system, the batteries retain 80% or more of their original capacity after 1,600 charge cycles, equivalent to approximately six years of typical use.³ Battery performance is further validated by TÜV SÜD 5-star Battery Performance Certification, awarded following rigorous testing for cycle lifespan, endurance, impact resistance, and performance under extreme temperatures. REDMI Titan Structure: toughness where it counts REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G feature REDMI Titan Structure, a reinforced hardware architecture designed to withstand the physical demands of everyday use. With stronger drop resistance and comprehensive dust and water protection, both models are engineered to handle real-world impacts, splashes, and demanding environments with confidence. Both Pro models feature advanced waterproof architecture with IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K ratings.¹² Both models have also passed a demanding 2-meter, 72-hour water-resistance test¹³ and introduce Underwater Mode for the first time.¹⁴ Meanwhile, reliable dust and water resistance across all models means there's no need to worry about everyday splashes. Wet Touch Technology 2.0 intelligently detects water, oil, foam, and sweat — keeping every touch precise and responsive. Built and rigorously tested for real-world conditions, REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G deliver enhanced protection against accidental drops. Backed by SGS certification,¹⁵ the Pro models have been tested to withstand drops from up to three meters onto granite surfaces.¹⁶ Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus® 2 further enhances resistance against everyday drops and scratches. On REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G, a flagship-level internal architecture further strengthens durability from within. A high-strength motherboard, reinforced MDA mid-frame, and impact-absorbing cushion design work together to help protect critical components against accidental impacts. Elegance meets everyday practicality Bringing a cleaner and more contemporary aesthetic to the series, REDMI Note 17 Series introduces a refreshed design language featuring a redesigned camera module, a flat display, gently rounded corners, and a dual-finish back panel. On REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G, the rear cover and frame transition more seamlessly through an upgraded mid-frame design, delivering a smoother and more comfortable in-hand feel. A metal camera runway on REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G further enriches the design with added depth and layering, giving the device a distinctive visual identity. Exclusive finishes bring additional personality to the series. Available exclusively on REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G, Cloud Blush features a photochromic back cover that transforms from cloud white to a warm pink-orange tone under UV light.¹⁷ For REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G, Satin Orange and Sky Blue offer two distinctive expressions of style. Satin Orange features a new Glitter Process to create unique patterns on every device, and Sky Blue showcases a soft azure finish that brings a fresh and vibrant character to the design. Flagship experiences, made more accessible A device built for years should never feel outdated. REDMI Note 17 Series pairs long-term durability with flagship-grade display, performance, and camera capabilities — so the experience stays rewarding not just on day one, but years into ownership. More Immersive Displays and Audio Vivid displays across the series deliver a brighter and more immersive viewing experience, complemented by powerful audio performance. The Pro models feature a 6.83-inch display, while REDMI Note 17 5G and REDMI Note 17 offer a larger 6.99-inch immersive viewing experience for streaming and gaming alike. Upgraded flagship-level luminous materials on REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G deliver up to 3,500 nits peak brightness for exceptional outdoor visibility, complemented by 1.5K resolution that brings vivid colors, deep contrast, and sharp detail to every scene. A 3200Hz instantaneous touch sampling rate ensures ultra-responsive interactions.¹⁸ REDMI Note 17 Series also brings a powerful audio experience to match its overall capabilities. The speaker output across the series delivers loud and clear audio for media playback, ringtones, and notifications. On REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G, the experience is elevated even further with up to a 400% volume boost.¹⁹ Powerful performance with intelligent AI REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G is powered by the Snapdragon® 6 Gen 5 Mobile Platform, handling intensive gaming, 4K content, and heavy multitasking with ease. REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G delivers smooth, reliable performance for everyday entertainment and productivity. Both models support up to 24GB RAM through Memory extension²⁰ to keep apps running seamlessly in the background. REDMI Note 17 5G and REDMI Note 17 round out the lineup with efficient performance tuned for smooth daily use. AI capabilities on REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G and REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G add a layer of everyday intelligence. REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G features Xiaomi HyperAI²¹ for advanced productivity and creative assistance. Across the entire REDMI Note 17 Series, Google Gemini²² and Circle to Search with Google²³ bring intuitive AI-powered interactions to every model. True-to-life portraits for everyday creativity From everyday moments to memorable portraits, REDMI Note 17 Series is designed to deliver true-to-life results with enhanced clarity and realism. text: First-half R&D Investment Reaches RMB18.2 Billion "Human × Car × Home" Ecosystem Underscores Operational Resilience Beijing, Hong Kong, August 18, 2026 - Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”; stock code: 1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things ("IoT") platform at its core, announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months ended June 30, 2026 ("the Period"). During the Period, despite significant increases in key component costs, including memory, and intensifying industry competition, the Group delivered total revenue of RMB108.9 billion, up 9.9% quarter-over-quarter, once again exceeding RMB100 billion. Adjusted net profit reached RMB6.2 billion, up 2.4% quarter-over-quarter, demonstrating solid operational resilience against market headwinds. Guided by its "Human × Car × Home" strategy, Xiaomi delivered steady development across its two segments and four business lines during the Period. Revenue from the smartphone × AIoT segment reached RMB84.0 billion. Within this, revenue from the smartphone business reached RMB42.1 billion, with global smartphone shipments ranking among the top three for 24 consecutive quarters. Revenue from IoT and lifestyle products reached RMB31.3 billion, up 26.7% quarter-over-quarter, with overseas revenue from this business growing rapidly year-over-year. The internet services business advanced steadily, with revenue of RMB9.0 billion, while global monthly active users ("MAU") reached another record high. Revenue from the smart electric vehicle ("EV"), artificial intelligence ("AI") and other new initiatives segment reached RMB24.9 billion, up 17.1% year-over-year. Within this, revenue from smart EV was RMB23.9 billion, as vehicle deliveries continued to climb during the Period. Xiaomi's premiumization strategy continued to advance. In the second quarter, the average selling price ("ASP") of Xiaomi smartphones rose 25.9% year-over-year to a record high of RMB1,351. In July 2026, Xiaomi Auto officially unveiled the Xiaomi Kunlun Technical Architecture and introduced the Xiaomi SkyNomad Series of extended-range SUVs, formally entering the extended-range market and opening up a new avenue for growth in its smart EV business. Xiaomi Smartphones Rank Among Global Top Three for 24 Consecutive Quarters as Global Smartphone ASP Sets a New Record The smartphone industry faced broad headwinds from significant increases in memory costs. Xiaomi proactively optimized its product mix and pricing strategy. In the second quarter, smartphone revenue reached RMB42.1 billion, and global smartphone shipments reached 31.2 million units. According to Omdia, Xiaomi's global smartphone shipments have ranked among the top three for 24 consecutive quarters. During the Period, Xiaomi's smartphone shipments ranked among the top three in 53 countries and regions globally and among the top five in 67 countries and regions globally, ranking No. 2 in Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Middle East. Benefiting from the proactive adjustment of its global product mix, the global ASP of Xiaomi smartphones increased by 25.9% year-over-year to a record high of RMB1,351 in the second quarter of this year. According to third-party data, in the Chinese Mainland, smartphones with retail prices at or above RMB3,000 accounted for a record-high 32.1% of the Group's total smartphone units sold, up 4.5 percentage points year-over-year. In the RMB3,000-4,000 price segment in the Chinese Mainland, Xiaomi’s market share reached 16.2%, up 3.3 percentage points year-over-year. In May 2026, Xiaomi successfully launched the Xiaomi 17T Series, its all-in-one imaging flagship smartphone, further enriching its premium product portfolio, and increase the contribution of premium smartphone shipments in the overseas markets. Xiaomi Auto Quarterly Deliveries Surpass 100,000 Units as the Group Formally Enters the Extended-Range SUV Market Xiaomi's smart EV, AI and other new initiatives segment maintained its growth momentum, with total revenue reaching RMB24.9 billion in the second quarter, up 17.1% year-over-year. Xiaomi Auto deliveries continued to climb, with quarterly deliveries reaching 104,199 vehicles, up 28.2% year-over-year, sustaining its trajectory of growth at scale. According to BitAuto, in the first half of 2026, the Xiaomi SU7 Series ranked No. 1 in sales among pure electric sedans priced at or above RMB200,000 in the Chinese Mainland. Xiaomi Auto continued to enrich its product portfolio. Following the Xiaomi SU7 Series and the Xiaomi YU7 Series , the Group unveiled the Xiaomi SkyNomad Series of extended-range SUVs in July 2026, positioned as an "intelligent, reconfigurable, spacious SUV." The Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max is equipped with a 76 kWh Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery, delivering a CLTC (China Light-duty Vehicle Test Cycle) combined range of up to 1,705 km, while its cabin supports face-to-face seating, office mode, and bed mode to meet the needs of family travel. With the SkyNomad line, Xiaomi Auto has completed a dual-series lineup, positioning it to tap incremental demand. Xiaomi's safety performance also earned recognition from leading authorities. In the assessment under the China Intelligent-connected Car Assessment Programme (C-ICAP), the Xiaomi YU7 achieved the highest ratings across all four dimensions: driving assistance, parking assistance, smart cockpit and privacy protection. The Xiaomi YU7 also received a "Five-Star Plus Rating" safety certification in the safety tests under the China-New Car Assessment Program (C-NCAP). Overseas IoT Revenue Grows Rapidly YoY as Connected AIoT Devices Surpass 1.16 Billion In the second quarter, revenue from the Group's IoT and lifestyle products business reached RMB31.3 billion, with a gross profit margin of 20.1%. Benefiting from the expansion of overseas channels and broader product categories, revenue from overseas IoT and lifestyle products grew rapidly year-over-year, becoming an important driver of growth for the business. According to Omdia, in the second quarter, Xiaomi's tablet shipments ranked fourth globally, marking the 9th consecutive quarter among the global top five, and ranked fourth in the Chinese Mainland. Both overseas tablet shipments and revenue reached record highs during the Period. Over the same period, Xiaomi's TWS earbud shipments ranked No. 2 globally and No. 2 in the Chinese Mainland, while shipments of its wearable bands ranked No. 2 globally and No. 2 in the Chinese Mainland. As of June 30, 2026, the number of connected IoT devices on the Group's AIoT platform (excluding smartphones and tablets) reached 1,160.8 million, up 17.4% year-over-year. The number of users with five or more devices connected to the Group's AIoT platform (excluding smartphones and tablets) reached 24.6 million, up 20.2% year-over-year. In June 2026, the MAU of the Xiaomi Home App grew 9.7% year-over-year to 124.1 million, while the MAU of Xiaomi AI Assistant grew 14.2% year-over-year to 174.9 million. The internet services business remained solid, with revenue of RMB9.0 billion. Its gross profit margin was 76.8%, up 1.4 percentage points year-over-year, and remained at a high level. The user base continued to expand: in June 2026, global MAU reached 766.5 million and MAU in the Chinese Mainland reached 197.7 million, both setting record highs. Xiaomi Makes Continued Breakthroughs in Core Technologies as AI, OS and Robotics Advance at Full Speed Xiaomi remains committed to investing in the future as it strives to become a global leader in the evolving realm of cutting-edge technologies. In the second quarter, Xiaomi's R&D expenses reached RMB9.2 billion, up 18.9% year-over-year. In the first half of this year, Xiaomi's R&D expenses reached over RMB18 billion. In AI, Xiaomi's self-developed large model, Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5, ranked No. 1 on the international model platform OpenRouter in weekly token usage*, reaching 10.5 trillion tokens, gaining broad recognition among developers worldwide. In July 2026, the Xiaomi MiMo on-device model officially completed the national large model filing procedures, and the Xiaomi 17 Max was among the first to receive Level 3 (L3) certifications under the national standards for "Intelligence Grading of Artificial Intelligence Terminal" from the China Computer Industry Association. In robotics, Xiaomi successively launched two embodied foundation models in July, Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 and Xiaomi-Robotics-1 , both of which ranked No. 1 across multiple authoritative international benchmarks. The applications of these technologies were also demonstrated at the Xiaomi Auto factory, where the success rate of Xiaomi's embodied robots in dual-sided tasks at the self-tapping threaded insert nut loading station improved from 90.2% to 98.0%, and the robots have been deployed at new workstations in the logistics area of the final assembly workshop. In August 2026, Xiaomi officially launched its next-generation operating system, the beta version of Xiaomi HyperOS 4. Featuring "Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi 2.0", powered by the Xiaomi MiMo large model and enhanced with AI, it enables coordinated interactions across ecosystems, scenarios and devices, delivering a significant upgrade to the AI experience. As Xiaomi's foundational core technologies enter a period of intensive realization, the Group is further strengthening the competitive moat of its "Human × Car × Home" ecosystem. *From July 20, 2026 to July 26, 2026 ENDS About Xiaomi Corporation Xiaomi Corporation was founded in April 2010 and listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on July 9, 2018 (1810.HK). text: BEIJING, China, August 7, 2026 – Xiaomi today introduced REDMI 17 Series, the latest generation of its value-focused smartphone lineup, built for all-day reliability and effortless entertainment to more users around the world. Featuring REDMI 17 and REDMI 17 5G, the series pairs a massive 7,500mAh (typ) battery with a 6.9-inch² immersive high-refresh-rate display and a 50MP AI dual camera system, delivering a durable and reliable smartphone experience built to keep pace with everyday life. Larger battery and faster charging for everyday reliability Power is at the core of REDMI 17 Series. Built around a massive 7500mAh (typ) battery, the series is engineered to stay productive, entertained, and connected for longer, helping users go longer between charges.¹ Whether streaming, navigating, video calling, or creating content, the large-capacity battery is designed to keep up with busy schedules and longer days. Whether watching videos, listening to music, staying connected, or capturing everyday moments, REDMI 17 Series is designed to keep up with the demands of everyday life. Depending on the activity, REDMI 17 delivers up to 28 hours of video playback, 91 hours of music playback, 46 hours of calling, or 12 hours of video recording, while REDMI 17 5G supports up to 28 hours of 1080p local video playback, 109 hours of music playback with Bluetooth® earphones, 53 hours of calling, or 10 hours of 1080p video recording.² With 45W turbo charging,³ REDMI 17 Series gets back to full power in just 96 minutes, while a quick 35-minute charge is enough to power through the day.¹ It also supports 22.5W wired reverse charging that adds even greater convenience, allowing REDMI 17 Series to power compatible accessories whenever they're needed.⁴ An expansive display for immersive viewing REDMI 17 Series features an expansive 6.9-inch immersive display that brings a more immersive viewing experience across streaming, gaming, browsing, and reading. Its intelligent 120Hz AdaptiveSync refresh rate dynamically adjusts between 60Hz, 90Hz, and 120Hz to keep interactions smooth while optimizing power efficiency.⁵ Combined with Triple TÜV Rheinland certifications and DC dimming, the display provides a more comfortable viewing experience, even during extended use. Built to withstand the demands of everyday life, the display is protected by Corning® Gorilla® Glass 7i for enhanced scratch resistance and improved drop protection. IP64 dust and water resistance together with Wet Touch Technology help ensure reliable responsiveness across a variety of everyday conditions.⁶ Bold new design, inside and out REDMI 17 Series introduces an all-new, nature-inspired design language in a range of classic and expressive colors that balances clean aesthetics with everyday practicality. Available in a selection of carefully curated finishes, REDMI 17 comes in Black, Deep Blue, Oak Green, and Lotus Purple, while REDMI 17 5G is offered in Black, Deep Blue, and Vivid Orange,⁷ with the latter featuring a premium PU leather finish for a softer, more comfortable grip. Beyond its refreshed color palette, REDMI's flat display and matte frame architecture as well as Metal Deco design come together with a more pronounced R-angle to create a flagship-inspired look that's as comfortable to hold as it is to look at, while a center punch-hole display and thinner bezels give the front a cleaner, more immersive appearance. Rounding out the design is a Dynamic RGB Light system that brings personalized lighting to incoming calls, app notifications, charging status, gaming, and camera use, combining practical feedback with distinctive visual expression. Smooth performance for everyday entertainment REDMI 17 Series combines capable hardware with Xiaomi HyperOS 3 to deliver a smooth and responsive experience across everyday tasks, entertainment, and multitasking.⁹ REDMI 17 is powered by the MediaTek Helio G91-Ultra, while REDMI 17 5G features the Snapdragon® 4 Gen 5 Mobile Platform with 5G for faster, more reliable connectivity. Both models support up to 12GB of RAM with Memory Extension,⁸ helping apps launch faster and multitasking feel more responsive. Xiaomi HyperOS 3 further enhances the experience with smoother animations,⁹ improved responsiveness, and more seamless day-to-day interactions. For the camera, REDMI 17 Series' 50MP AI dual camera system captures stunningly clear, natural images in everyday environments, while front and rear dual-view shooting makes it easy to record moments from multiple perspectives all at once. For those live-out-loud moments, dual stereo speakers equipped with up to 300% volume boost bring bigger,¹⁰ more powerful audio to videos, music, calls, and more. Product Availability REDMI 17 will be available in four colors: Black, Deep Blue, Oak Green, and Lotus Purple.⁷ It will be available in four variants: 4GB+128GB, 4GB+256GB, 6GB+128GB, and 6GB+256GB,¹⁴ starting from USD 179. REDMI 17 5G will be available in three colors: Black, Deep Blue, and Vivid Orange.⁷ It will be available in three variants: 4GB+128GB, 4GB+256GB, and 6GB+256GB,¹⁴ starting from USD 249.
