text: Beijing, China, July 30, 2026 — Xiaomi Auto today unveiled its all-new Xiaomi SkyNomad Series, the first model built on Xiaomi Kunlun Platform at Xiaomi SkyNomad Technology Launch Event. Positioned as an intelligent, reconfigurable, large-space SUV, Xiaomi SkyNomad is built around three core strengths — expansive interior space, a completely flat cabin floor, and reconfigurable seating — paired with the Xiaomi Kunlun HyperRange, Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery, and Xiaomi Kunlun Total Safety. Across space, safety, intelligence, driving dynamics, and range, Xiaomi SkyNomad is designed to meet the core needs of family vehicle ownership — marking the opening of a new chapter in Xiaomi's automotive journey. This launch introduces two variants: Xiaomi SKyNomad N90 Max — Flagship 7-Seater Extended-Range SUV and Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max — 5-Seat AWD Extended-Range SUV , catering to the versatile spatial needs of different families. Xiaomi SkyNomad Series Official Pre-Sale Price Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max Flagship 7-Seater Extended-Range SUV RMB 299,900 Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max 5-Seat AWD Extended-Range SUV RMB 259,900 Design that stands the test of time. Design born for space. Xiaomi Auto designs for longevity, and Xiaomi SkyNomad's design philosophy can be summed up in one phrase: form follows function. Where traditional large SUVs finalize styling, powertrain, and chassis first and treat interior space as whatever is left over, Xiaomi SkyNomad reverses that order — function leads, and every design feature traces back to a specific spatial need. Bold, upright proportions — every line serves the space That spatial logic shows up directly in the body: Xiaomi SkyNomad's squared-off proportions are effectively a projection of the interior space — an SUV exterior wrapped around MPV-level interior volume. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max, a large extended-range SUV, measures 5,285 mm long, 1,998 mm wide, and 1,825 mm tall, on a 3,080 mm wheelbase. Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max, a mid-to-large extended-range SUV, measures 4,960 mm × 1,998 mm × 1,765 mm, on a 2,950 mm wheelbase. Three lines define the upright stance: a flat roofline that maximizes second- and third-row headroom; a continuous waistline that stretches the profile; and a rising sill line that lifts the visual center of gravity for a more commanding presence. Front and rear lights sit at nearly the same height, giving the car a stable, balanced, upscale look. A rounded-rectangle motif carries through the headlights, taillights, door handles, and side cameras for a cohesive, orderly design language. The dragonfly-shaped headlights evolve the classic cross pattern into the front fascia; the halo taillight transforms into an inverted U-shape. Xiaomi SkyNomad incorporates over 140 aerodynamic optimizations , including a standard active grille across the range , achieving a drag coefficient of 0.255 on Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max. Smart electric doors open by touch or voice; rear doors open to nearly 90° for easy entry and exit. A 360° anti-collision system uses AI to detect obstacles near open doors and can actively resist opening or sound a warning. Second- and third-row privacy curtains create a private space for the cabin. An optional electric side step (aluminum-alloy, rated to 300 kg per side, tested through 100,000 open/close cycles) assists entry for children and older passengers. Premium-grade materials, throughout. A cabin that feels warm, elevated. Drawing on residential interior design, Xiaomi SkyNomad's cabin aims for a simple, elevated, homelike atmosphere. A cabinet-style center console extends 1,530 mm horizontally for a wider visual and physical footprint. A new two-spoke steering wheel shares its grip profile with Xiaomi SU7. Hidden mechanical air vents keep the dashboard clean while retaining precise manual adjustment. A threaded accessory port delivers 27W fast charging for phone mounts, action cameras, and similar accessories. 95% of high-touch interior surfaces of Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Series are soft-wrapped , covering up to 32 m² — far exceeding the class average — virtually eliminating hard plastic in all hand, elbow, shoulder, and knee contact zones. The entire 32 m² interior carries OEKO-TEX® certification , applying infant-grade safety standards to the cabin. Infants under 3 can touch every surface without risk of allergy or harmful substance migration. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Series' front and second-row seatbacks use a 12-layer comfort structure for a "big sofa" feel. Front seats come standard with 16-point massage, ventilation, and heating ; up to four zero-gravity seats are available across the trims. Extensive personalization options — a way to express every aesthetic Since Xiaomi Auto's debut, its distinctive sense of color has produced a series of car colors that have won broad market appeal. This time, the SkyNomad series introduces two new exterior colors: Mountain Green and Valley Blue , alongside a classic Volcanic Gray . Mountain Green: Inspired by the color philosophy of ink wash painting, the muted blue-green of mountains shrouded in mist, soft yet resolute, verdant without being vivid. Valley Blue: A layered image blending natural wonder, spiritual vitality, and cultural metaphor, the clear, ethereal blue of a mountain stream deep in a secluded valley. Volcanic Gray: Derived from the original hue of dormant volcanic rock veins, a high-purity gray overlaid with nano-scale mineral particles, revealing a refined, layered metallic texture under shifting light. The interior offers Cream Beige and Mocha Brown , both inspired by nature. These two "premium finishing styles" cater to different aesthetic preferences. Cream Beige: Fine sand-beige as the primary tone, accented with chestnut brown — a low-saturation, soft-textured palette that creates an open, serene atmosphere reminiscent of the wilderness. Mocha Brown: The primary tone drawn from the natural color of deep-valley soil, paired with light ash-wood grain reminiscent of Nordic ash — transforming the cabin into a mobile forest cabin. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max wheel options include standard 21" Prism-shaped Rims , plus optional 21" Beam-shaped Rims (luxury-oriented) and 21" Starburst-shaped Rims Stealth Black Edition (sport-oriented). Bridgestone quiet-tuned tires are standard across the range. Space: Redefining What an SUV Interior Can Do Xiaomi's approach starts from a simple question: why should people adapt to the space, instead of the space adapting to them? Traditional large SUVs fix styling, powertrain, and chassis first, and space is whatever is left over — fixed seat orientation, uneven fold-flat surfaces, not enough room for everyone's luggage. Xiaomi SkyNomad's Kunlun Platform reverses that: it defines what the space needs to do first, then engineers the architecture around it. Xiaomi Kunlun Platform — built specifically for space. Xiaomi Kunlun Platform optimizes packaging across three axes to minimize structural intrusion into the cabin: X-axis — Front cabin integration frees interior space: A five-in-one EREV system, integrated water-cooling module, integrated refrigerant module, mid-mounted HVAC unit, and PTC-compressor two-in-one compress the front cabin length to just 1,265 mm. Every millimeter saved up front translates directly into more usable space inside. Y-axis — Third-row wheel-arch optimization: Springs and shock absorbers are separated into a split layout, releasing 15 mm of wheel-arch height for the third row compared to traditional large SUVs. Moving the shock absorbers outward with a shallow-angle installation optimizes the overall wheel-arch packaging, combined with third-row HVAC ducting redesign, delivering a squared-off, full-cabin spatial experience. Z-axis — Eliminating the step between the second and third rows: Focused on rear electric drive unit integration and rear suspension design, a highly integrated rear coaxial electric drive frees 145 mm of vertical space. An integrated-linkage independent suspension uses an H-arm structure where the air spring sits inside the arm, lowering the floor by another 37 mm. Additionally, the large battery pack is redesigned with the battery pack control module relocated inside, reducing floor thickness by 180 mm — achieving a completely flat second-row floor. The result is a flat floor running from row one through the cargo area — uninterrupted, and unusual for the large extended-range SUV segment. Every structural line is built toward the same goal with Xiaomi Kunlun Platform: the largest, flattest, most flexible space for the people inside. Seating for Seven, Cargo for Seven — MPV-Level Space Inside an SUV Xiaomi SkyNomad Series delivers class-leading in-cabin seating space. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Series offers 2,760 mm of total occupant space across the vehicle, with second-row legroom reaching up to 1.55 m — enough to sit with legs fully stretched out. Beyond spacious seating, the cargo area expands to a maximum of 1,831 L — fitting seven 20-inch suitcases while all seven passengers ride in comfort. In Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max's Ultimate Storage Mode, it holds up to 24 20-inch suitcases . For a family camping trip, comfortably load a canopy tent, a camping trailer, a foldable roll-up table, a barbecue grill, five moon chairs, and three storage boxes — and still enjoy every bit of the campsite. The cabin includes 34 storage compartments , including an 18.4 L front passenger glovebox (fits seven 13" laptops) and extended door-panel storage. Up to 12 accessory ports support flexible device mounting. Rear doors open to nearly 90°, with a 1,258 mm entry aperture, a low sill height, and an optional electric step, for easy entry and exit. Fully flat floor, front to back. Maximum space, total openness. One of the core pain points of traditional large SUVs is the step between the second/third rows and the cargo area — a fragmented space that severely limits flexibility. Xiaomi SkyNomad Series comes standard with a completely flat floor across all trims: from rows one through three to the boot, the entire cabin features a flat floor with just a 2.95° slope, spanning nearly 3 meters in length with a maximum flat area exceeding 4.4 m² — eliminating the step design common in traditional large SUVs for a continuous, flexible space. Built on this flat floor, every model comes standard with extra-long seat slide rails — up to 1,938 mm on Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max, the longest of any SUV in its class — with 900 mm of travel for both second and third rows, far exceeding comparable models. The rails use aerospace-grade 7-series reinforced aluminum alloy, rated to 54 kN lock strength and 57 kN peel strength, and validated through 15,000 cycles with no loosening or functional degradation. A standard cabinet-style sliding center console — deployable when needed, retracting flush when not — integrates 50W wireless charging, a 9 L compressor refrigerator (fits up to ten 330 ml cans upright), dual USB-C ports, and accessory expansion, combining sliding, charging, cooling, storage, and connectivity in one unit. All seats are power-adjustable; front seats include 16-point massage, ventilation, and heating as standard. Front seatbacks use an industry-leading 15-layer comfort structure — 20 mm of zero-pressure-feel foam over a 65 kg/m³ high-density base — with a three-layer cushion design balancing surface softness and underlying support for fatigue-free long drives. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max supports four-seat zero-gravity mode across the front and second rows. Optional front-seat configurations include zero-gravity recline, unlocking a mobile first-class experience for immersive rest, orrotating seats , which turn the cabin into an interactive lounge for face-to-face conversation with family and friends in the rear, or for playing with kids during a break. 7+N Scenarios — Change Your Seating, Change Your Space Rather than a small set of engineer-defined modes, Xiaomi SkyNomad's variable space is designed around real usage patterns — rest, family time, camping, business meetings — enabled by high seat and rail flexibility. Configurations include: Business Lounge Face-to-Face, Family Lakeside Seating Front seats rotate: the four independent seats in the first and second rows face each other, while the third row folds and slides back to free up 720 mm of legroom. The third row slides back and the seat cushions fold up to create an extra-large play area — instantly turning into a mobile play fort for kids. Pair with the folding table, rear entertainment screens, and factory-installed second/third-row sunshades to elevate the in-cabin experience. Executive Four-Seat Business Reception, Everyday Four-Seat Travel First-Class Mode: second and third rows slide all the way back, with second-row legroom reaching up to 1,550 mm — instantly turning into a first-class cabin with room for very long legs. Second-row zero-gravity seats can also be engaged, reaching an industry-leading zero-gravity posture at a 128° hip angle and 130° knee angle. If storage is needed, one-touch convenient storage mode accommodates 4 passengers in comfort while fitting 16 20-inch suitcases. Super-Size Bed for Naps, Overnight Camping Front seats stay occupied while one touch turns the second and third rows into a bed — suited for a midday nap or a long rest. Alternatively, after flattening the second and third rows into a bed, the front and passenger seats can rotate to extend the bed to a maximum length of 2,300 mm, giving you a fully stretched-out sleeping space whenever you need it. Maximum Cargo Mode, Your Moving-Day Hero One touch activates Ultimate Storage Mode: 1,260 mm of cargo depth and a maximum expanded volume of 1,831 L, fitting up to 24 20-inch suitcases. All Seven Family Members in Comfort For everyday trips with all 7 family members, everyone rides comfortably while the cargo area still fits 7 20-inch suitcases — one per person, making short trips effortless. Creator's Personal Studio One second-row seat serves as a seat while the other enters zero-gravity mode, creating a single-person studio mode for both work and rest. Family Camping The third-row seat cushions fold up and the backrests fold down, turning the third row into rear-facing scenic seating open to the cargo area — perfect for the whole family to enjoy the outdoors. Safety Above All Safety is the foundation of Xiaomi SkyNomad's engineering, addressed through Xiaomi Kunlun Total Safety system spanning materials, structure, airbags, battery, and the variable-space design itself. Armor Cage steel-aluminum hybrid body, safeguarding occupants from every direction High-strength steel and aluminum alloy make up 90.4% of Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max body, with 2,200 MPa ultra-high-strength steel used in 16 critical locations . A 2,200 MPa embedded roll cage (A-pillar to C-pillar) supports a maximum roof-crush load of nearly 14 tons, and improves A-pillar load capacity by 24% against underride scenarios. All four doors carry standard 2,200 MPa anti-collision beams , with anti-detachment hooks on the rear doors. A 13-in-1 integrated hot-formed door ring spans the A/B/C/D pillars across all three rows, improving side-impact load capacity by 19%. A 2,000 MPa integrated hot-formed front floor frame — laser-welded from multiple high-strength steel panels and stamped as a single piece, with 2,200 MPa reinforcement at critical points — improves occupant survival space by 9% in frontal impacts and 10% in side-pole impacts, while protecting the cabin and battery pack. All-scenario, all-seat protection — safety coverage that extends to every occupant 12 airbags come standard on Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max — the most in its class — protecting all three rows. Dual-chamber far-side airbags in the second row reduce head displacement for the left-side occupant by 34%. 4-point-mounted far-side airbags (versus 2-point) reduce driver head displacement by 24%. Third-row side airbags, paired with a 3,200 mm side curtain, cover head, chest, and waist protection for third-row occupants — reducing shoulder compression by 44% and rib compression by an average of 18% in side impacts. 9 collision sensors, including added front and C-pillar sensors, improve detection across more collision types (including center-pole and rear-side impacts) and airbag deployment precision. Beyond the standard 50th-percentile male test dummy, safety development also covers 5th-percentile female dummies and dedicated second/third-row child protection, across all conditions and seating positions. Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery — the industry's highest standard for battery quality and safety Over five years, Xiaomi has built a 230+ person battery R&D team, filed 697 related patents, and built its own battery pack factory, with cumulative deliveries exceeding 700,000 vehicles. Xiaomi Armor Scale Battery is Xiaomi's end-to-end battery system: Xiaomi defines the product, leads pack design and development, participates in cell design, and manages quality control across the full process. Xiaomi selects cell cathode, anode, electrolyte, and separator materials directly, and has optimized core cell design and manufacturing — reducing cell health degradation by 50% and achieving twice the cycle life of the relevant national standard. The battery includes 18 layers of structural safety protection, maintaining full function — no leak, fire, or explosion — after a 500 J underbody impact. Thermal protection runs up to 16 layers, including extensive aerogel insulation, preventing thermal propagation, fire, or explosion even under 55°C full-charge single-cell thermal runaway — Xiaomi's highest thermal-runaway safety rating to date. A "Shadow Factory" quality system gives Xiaomi engineers direct oversight of every module, with full-process traceability from raw material to finished pack. Triple-redundant door handles allow central unlocking and mechanical opening even after a full power loss, with mechanical release handles inside and outside the vehicle. Xiaomi SkyNomad is the only large SUV in its class with dual emergency pull handles on the tailgate, letting third-row passengers exit through the rear without climbing into the cargo area. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max is rated for emergency wading up to 750 mm , with emergency floating capability keeping the cabin free of significant water ingress for 3 minutes in the event of accidental submersion. 26 standard driver-assistance safety features support the full chain from warning to escape. 39 anti-pinch points across seats, windows, sunshades, and the electric side step keep pinch force below 150 N, reducing the risk of injury — particularly for children. Intelligence and Ecosystem: AI-powered across every scenario Whole-home smart integration, delivered in one step Xiaomi SkyNomad's cabin electronics run on a four-in-one domain control module , built on the Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 Mobile Platform (4nm process) for 17% higher CPU and 100% higher AI compute versus the prior generation, with fast app loading and smooth system performance. Dual 5G + Wi-Fi 7 connectivity supports flagship-phone-level dual-SIM standby and stronger in-cabin signal and speed. An e-Fuse solid-state power distribution system manages vehicle electrical load more intelligently and safely. An upgraded Flyback low-voltage power system can run Sentry Mode and the onboard refrigerator independently while parked, cutting energy use by 60% versus a non-Flyback system in that scenario. A customizable head-up display offers a -4.7° optimal viewing angle and 15,000-nit brightness for clear visibility. Six-screen cabin connectivity allows content to move seamlessly between displays, paired with a 25-speaker in-house audio system for an immersive sound experience. A 6.9-inch rear control screen enables full-cabin control from the back seat, including a live exterior sentry-camera view — useful for overnight security while camping. A variable-space table supports both the sliding console and rail mounting, for work, family time, or shared use, alongside a range of camping accessory options. Up to 6 magnetic mount points around the cabin support accessories — Bluetooth remotes, pet-related mounts, glasses cases — plus NFC touch-to-control tags for one-touch vehicle commands. Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi, Xiaomi's onboard AI assistant, can switch among 11 cabin layout modes with a single voice command, coordinating seats, lighting, and climate based on stated intent. Class-leading assisted driving hardware, XLA architecture that communicates, understands, and reasons Xiaomi SkyNomad comes standard with high-spec assisted-driving hardware: a 700 TOPS onboard compute platform, integrated and forward-facing LiDAR, 4D mmWave radar, and anti-glare cameras — uncommon in this class. Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 series adds rear LiDAR with ranging precision to 2 cm, improving detection of low or overhanging obstacles for safer parking. Xiaomi's HAD assisted-driving system, upgraded with the XLA architecture, supports voice-controlled driving (lane changes, acceleration, deceleration via single commands) and space-level navigation guidance in underground parking structures. It ships standard across Xiaomi SkyNomad range, with ongoing improvements planned in voice control, spatial understanding, and predictive assistance. Driving Dynamics: Ultra-long range, top-tier energy efficiency, large yet easy to drive Xiaomi Kunlun HyperRange — best-in-class combined range, worry-free long-distance travel Xiaomi SkyNomad's Kunlun HyperRange system uses a large-battery extended-range architecture to address common EREV pain points — short EV-only range, high combined consumption, weak performance on a depleted battery. Battery capacity ranges from 52 kWh (entry) to 76 kWh. On CLTC, Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Max reaches up to 505 km of EV-only range (best in its class); Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max reaches 464 km. A five-in-one SiC range-extending drive unit improves efficiency by 2.65%, reducing consumption to 15.85 kWh/100 km. Combined with a large fuel tank, Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max reaches a combined range of 1,705 km — among the strongest results in the extended-range SUV segment. A fuel-to-electricity conversion ratio of 3.66 kWh/L supports depleted-battery consumption as low as 6.26 L/100 km. Source-and-path vibration isolation plus active noise cancellation keep the range extender close to inaudible in operation. After its first scheduled service, the range-extender unit requires maintenance only every 3 years or 30,000 km — cutting total service costs by 23%. All variants support 92, 95, and 98 octane fuel (applicable in Chinese Mainland). Specially designed and tuned for effortless handling of a large vehicle — the whole family can drive with ease Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max carries chassis DNA from Xiaomi SU7 and Xiaomi YU7: a double-wishbone front suspension for high lateral stiffness and strong anti-roll performance, and an H-arm multi-link rear suspension for a strong ride/handling balance. Five-stage adjustable air springs and continuously variable damping balance comfort and control. Dual-motor all-wheel drive delivers 310 kW of peak power, tuned for a linear power delivery similar to a large-displacement engine across the full speed range. Braking from 100–0 km/h takes 38.57 meters, with consistent performance across 10 consecutive stops. Despite a nearly 5.3-meter length, Xiaomi SkyNomad N90 Max has a 5.95 m turning radius, aided by rack-type electric power steering for agile, precise handling. Availability Xiaomi SkyNomad Series is designed for families with children, buyers seeking independent, flexible SUV interior space, and anyone looking for one vehicle to handle the whole family's needs — combining flagship chassis dynamics, comprehensive safety, an advanced intelligent ecosystem, and long-range efficiency in a single package. Pre-orders for Xiaomi SkyNomad Series open July 30 at 21:00 in Chinese Mainland. A RMB 1,000 deposit secures an order; once the order is locked in, buyers receive priority production scheduling, plus a complimentary RMB 999 in-car dual-cupholder table upon delivery. text: BEIJING, China, July 9th, 2026 — Xiaomi Auto today announced Xiaomi SkyNomad (小米澎程), the second product series under Xiaomi Auto brand. Xiaomi SU7 and Xiaomi YU7 Series are positioned as "the driver's car"; SkyNomad Series is positioned as an "intelligent, reconfigurable, large-space SUV". Together, the two series represent two distinct answers to different user needs, delivered in more than five years of Xiaomi building cars. Where Xiaomi SU7 and Xiaomi YU7 Series focus on the driver, SkyNomad Series focuses on the people inside, designing the cabin as a living space that adapts across the hours of a day. The launch marks another step in Xiaomi Auto's portfolio expansion. Why SkyNomad China's auto industry has advanced rapidly in recent years. Large six- and seven-seat layouts and feature-rich interiors are now common, and the market is not short on space or supply. Buyer priorities, however, are shifting: increasingly, the deciding factor is not whether a cabin is large or the seats are soft, but whether occupants feel genuinely at ease inside it. This shift reflects how people actually use their cars: commuting up to two hours a day, resting in the driver's seat, working from a parked car, taking the family on a weekend trip, or using the vehicle as a second home while camping. For these owners, a car functions not only as a vehicle but as an extension of your living space, on the move . That principle, designing a car built around how people actually feel inside it, was the starting point for SkyNomad's development in early 2023. A Cabin That Adapts, Not Just Expands SkyNomad is built on Xiaomi's all-new Kunlun Architecture, developed from early 2023 specifically to enable reconfigurable interior space. In an SUV body, a flat floor and long-track seating system allow the cabin to switch between driving mode, accommodating passengers, luggage, and pets with generous room, and parked modes that transform into a workspace, a lounge, or a family activity space. Delivering this required the integration of AI, Xiaomi's smart-device ecosystem, and smart manufacturing capabilities — three areas where Lei Jun has noted that Xiaomi holds a rare combination of depth. "Our answer was to let intelligence define the space, to build a living interior that moves with you," Lei Jun, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Xiaomi, wrote in a post on Weibo describing SkyNomad's development. Who SkyNomad Is Built For SkyNomad targets buyers who need one vehicle to cover daily commuting, family travel, and occasional work-from-car use, not a lifestyle statement, but a flexible tool that adapts across roles. The series is designed for professionals and parents alike, not as separate categories, but as the same person across different hours of the day. Xiaomi SkyNomad Series will soon launch in Chinese Mainland, the result of three and a half years of development. Stay tuned for more news. headings: Xiaomi 17T
Xiaomi 17T Pro
text: Vienna, AUSTRIA, May 28, 2026 – Xiaomi today unveiled the latest additions to Xiaomi T Series smartphone lineup with the brand new Xiaomi 17T Series, including Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro. Combining an advanced Leica 5x telephoto camera and eye-care display with an ultra-large capacity battery, Xiaomi 17T Series comes as an imaging flagship encased in a refined design. Introducing dual sizes to the T Series for the first time, this lineup is set to deliver an exceptional experience, crafted for modern users. Transform moments into living stories with The Telephoto Master and Leica Live Moment Combining Leica optics with Xiaomi's cutting-edge imaging technology, Xiaomi 17T Series features a triple camera system headlined by a 50MP main camera designed to capture crystal-clear images. Inside lies an ultra-large 1/1.31-inch sensor in Xiaomi 17T Pro and a 1/1.55-inch sensor in Xiaomi 17T. Both combine Leica UltraPure optical design with a 1G + 6P hybrid Leica Summilux lens structure, renowned for rendering fine detail with exceptional clarity. The large aperture across the series delivers superior dynamic range and beautifully rendered depth of field. For the first time, Xiaomi 17T Series brings the Leica 5x telephoto camera to both models in the T series, redefining versatility across the lineup. It delivers 50MP images with OIS and exceptional range, from intricate details captured via 30cm macro photography to 10x optical-grade zoom and up to 120x AI Ultra Zoom. This enables seamless shooting from near to far, giving creators flexibility across focal lengths. Beyond photography, the telephoto system also enhances videography, particularly on Xiaomi 17T Pro, which introduces Xiaomi Series smartphones' first 4K 60fps cinematic recording, delivering natural background bokeh for a more immersive visual experience. Specialized modes such as Stage further improve performance in complex lighting conditions across both photo and video, helping ensure concerts, performances, and other scenes are captured with clarity. Moving beyond traditional still photography, Xiaomi 17T Series introduces Leica Live Moment, capturing not only the decisive instant, but also the motion and emotion that lead up to it. Leica Live Moment preserves movements and fleeting expressions, adding greater depth and context to everyday scenes. Supported across all rear camera focal lengths, Leica Live Moment delivers dynamic imaging infused with Leica's signature aesthetic, ensuring a consistent visual style across perspectives. The result is more expressive, nuanced storytelling beyond a single frame, capturing emotion and narrative in every shot. Leica Live Portrait extends this capability into Portrait mode, adding a natural bokeh effect that enhances subject separation while retaining the fluidity of motion. Newly designed exclusive Leica watermarks are available for Leica Live Moment captures, and multiple moments can be combined into shareable collages for social platforms. Live cinematography, exclusive to Xiaomi 17T Pro, brings further creative options with Ultra-HD Live Moment in 4K, as well as seamless zoom effects via Freestyle or Portrait Live cinematography.¹ A flagship display experience balancing visual brilliance and intelligent eye care Xiaomi 17T Series puts user needs at the forefront, integrating advanced eye-care technology into its displays to debut Xiaomi Vision Care.² Guided by medical research with precise engineering, this display automatically adapts to ambient light conditions, and effectively manages blue light, flicker, and motion blur to ensure all-day comfort. Thanks to these innovations, Xiaomi 17T Series is the first to receive the TÜV Rheinland quadruple eye-care certification, and has earned Xiaomi's first TÜV Rheinland Intelligent Eye Care certification. At the heart of this exceptional visual experience is a 1.5K AMOLED display with 3500-nit peak brightness that delivers clear image quality and high color accuracy even in bright outdoor sunlight. Xiaomi 17T Pro takes this a step further, enhancing ultra-low-light night-time viewing with hardware-level 1-nit minimum brightness. Not only is viewing crystal-clear, but also buttery-smooth with a high refresh rate offered across the series, namely up to 144Hz on the Pro variant,³ and 120Hz on the base version. Surrounding the screen are ultra-slim bezels that create an immersive look, focusing attention on the display. Notably, Xiaomi 17T Pro achieves this with the innovative LIPO packaging solution, resulting in equally-sized 1.29mm bezels on all four sides.⁵ Xiaomi 17T, meanwhile, comes in a more compact form factor that features a streamlined and lightweight design, optimized for effortless one-handed use for users who value portability and convenience. Accentuating this display are a series of finishes that blend timeless design with modern style through the latest technology and craftsmanship. Xiaomi 17T Pro is available in a sophisticated Deep Blue, an elegant Deep Violet, or a classic Black.⁴ Meanwhile, Xiaomi 17T is available in four expressive colors, including an iridescent Opal White, an ethereal Violet, a vibrant Blue, or a classic Black.⁴ A refined brushed finish extending around the sides lends a neat, modern look, while the smaller, lower camera module adds to the sleek silhouette. Micro-curved edges also result in an effortless in-hand feel. Power and performance without compromise Enabling these advanced camera and visual experiences on the Xiaomi 17T Series is the powerful underlying performance across the series. Both models introduce next-generation silicon-carbon battery technology, achieving higher energy density while maintaining long-term performance. Xiaomi 17T Pro's 7000mAh battery⁶ is the largest on a Xiaomi Series smartphone in the international markets,⁷ with a 27% increase in capacity over the previous generation,⁵ delivering an average of 1.88 days of use for typical users and all-day power for even the heaviest users.⁸ Both 100W wired HyperCharge and 50W wireless HyperCharge are also supported for a quick recharge whenever needed.⁹ Meanwhile, despite coming in a more compact design, Xiaomi 17T is equipped with a 6500mAh battery⁶ with an 18% higher capacity than the previous generation.⁵ Paired with 67W HyperCharge,¹⁰ it keeps users powered throughout the day. Both Xiaomi 17T Pro and Xiaomi 17T are compatible with third-party chargers, thanks to 100W⁹ and 50W PPS support,¹⁰ respectively. Maximizing battery efficiency are two highly optimized chipsets designed for sustained performance. Xiaomi 17T Pro is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500, built on a 3nm process, while Xiaomi 17T features the MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra on a 4nm architecture. Both deliver major upgrades in CPU, GPU, and AI performance, enabling smooth responsiveness across demanding multitasking and next-generation gaming. To maintain this peak output, the Xiaomi 3D IceLoop System provides advanced thermal management through efficient vapor–liquid separation. By rapidly channeling heat away from the core chipset, it enhances sustained stability and ensures the device remains comfortable to hold, even under heavy workloads. Both Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro deliver comprehensive upgrades across the board, including an enhanced camera system featuring the innovative Leica Live Moment and a highly versatile telephoto lens, along with increased battery capacity and more, elevating the Xiaomi T Series to an entirely new level. Price and Availability ¹¹ Xiaomi 17T Pro will be available in three color options: Deep Blue, Deep Violet, and Black.⁴ Xiaomi 17T Pro comes in three storage variants¹², starting from EUR 899. Xiaomi 17T will be available in four color options: Violet, Opal White, Blue, and Black.⁴ Xiaomi 17T comes in two storage variants¹², starting from EUR 749. Moreover, users who purchase Xiaomi 17T Series in eligible markets will enjoy several benefits¹³ at no extra cost: a 3-month trial of Google AI Pro with higher access to Google AI and 5TB of cloud storage;¹⁴ a 3-month trial of YouTube Premium,¹⁵ with ad-free access and offline downloads across YouTube and YouTube Music; and a 4-month trial of Spotify Premium with ad-free listening,¹⁶ offline downloads, and enhanced audio quality. text: Vienna, AUSTRIA, May 28, 2026 – Xiaomi today introduced its latest ecosystem lineup to global markets, expanding its portfolio with four new products: Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm, Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro, Xiaomi Buds 6, and Xiaomi Sound Play. Together, they bring more seamless, intuitive experiences to everyday life, designed to fit effortlessly into a range of routines and lifestyles. Alongside the new lineup, Xiaomi also unveiled the Violet Collection, a refined new finish available across Xiaomi 17T, Xiaomi Buds 6, and Xiaomi Sound Play. Rendered in a deep, understated violet, the collection plays with light and texture to create a look that feels both contemporary and distinctive. Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm: Designed for Premium Style and Everyday Performance Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm combines advanced sports and health monitoring within a refined, lightweight design featuring a bold 46mm case, weighing just 46g, with an ultra-slim 10.99mm profile.¹ A premium stainless steel middle frame enhances durability and aesthetics, while optional stainless steel, ceramic, and forged carbon bezels offer added distinction. With a range of strap options, including new genuine leather materials, the watch adapts seamlessly to business, sports, and everyday settings. The display is further elevated by a 1.48-inch AMOLED display, featuring a 40% narrower bezel and up to 2,500 nits peak brightness,² ensuring clear visibility of notifications and health data even under bright sunlight. Powered by an 815mAh Xiaomi Surge Battery, delivering up to 21 days of battery life under light use,³ supporting continuous health monitoring and sports tracking with reduced charging frequency.⁴ To deliver more comprehensive everyday wellness insights, Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm features enhanced hardware and software capabilities. It introduces Passion Mode, which detects cheering gestures and converts them into measurable data, including heart rate, calories burned, and cheer counts. With over 150 sports modes, the device also integrates an upgraded 4 LED + 4 PD heart rate sensor and refined algorithms, improving accuracy to 98.4% for more reliable monitoring.⁵ An upgraded dual-band, five-system GNSS further ensures precise and stable tracking for outdoor activities. For sleep, new weekly and monthly reports, alongside sleep HRV tracking, provide deeper insights into long-term rest patterns.⁶ Developed in collaboration with leading international organizations, including the World Sleep Society, the Asian Society of Sleep Medicine, and the Chinese Sleep Research Society, these features deliver more science-based insights to support improved sleep health. Powered by Xiaomi HyperOS 3, Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm delivers a seamless connected experience with smartphones. Key functions — including remote photo capture, find my phone, earphone controls, and automatic synchronization of sports and health data — are accessible with ease. The device also supports integration with Xiaomi Home, enabling enhanced connectivity between wearables and smart home environments. Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro: Lightweight Design with Advanced Everyday Wellness Positioned as an everyday smart band, Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro combines comprehensive wellness tracking with an elevated design and broad compatibility. It features a 1.74-inch AMOLED display⁷ with up to 2,000 nits peak brightness for clear visibility.⁸ Despite the larger screen, Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro maintains a slim 9.7mm profile across the lineup, while weighing just 21.6g (excluding the Ceramic edition)⁹ for comfortable all-day wear. Crafted with a new generation of high-strength aluminum, it delivers durability and scratch resistance in a lightweight form. A 350mAh battery and low-power chipset enable up to 21 days of battery life under light usage conditions.¹⁰ Beyond design, it enhances health and fitness tracking with an upgraded PPG module and self-developed algorithms, improving heart rate accuracy to 98.2%.¹¹ With over 150 sports modes, it introduces track mode for lap recording and enhanced cycling mode for more precise workout tracking.¹² Sleep monitoring is also upgraded with sleep trend reports and deeper metrics such as HRV and sleep efficiency, while sleep algorithm 2.0 improves sleep onset and stage accuracy.¹¹ Moreover, Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro collaborates with Clue,¹³ a world-leading period and cycle tracking app, to deliver a more comprehensive approach to women's health management. With the purchase of Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro, users receive a 3-month free trial of Clue Plus. This premium subscription offers features like advanced cycle analysis, accurate fertility predictions, pregnancy and perimenopause tracking, and more. Users can bring together health and wellness data generated by their band with deeper menstrual health insights from Clue. The collaboration empowers people to better understand their well-being and make more informed health decisions. When connected to a Xiaomi smartphone, Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro supports notification synchronization and allows simultaneous pairing with an iPhone, enabling calls, messages, and alerts from both devices to be received on a single band.¹⁴ An optimized vibration motor differentiates alerts by message type, enhancing usability, while the NFC version¹⁵ enables secure contactless payments.¹⁶ The NFC version is available in Midnight Black, Glacier Silver, and a new Ceramic Edition, while the standard version comes in Midnight Black, Glacier Silver, and Lavender Pink, offering versatile style options. Xiaomi Buds 6: Refined Comfort with Immersive Audio As flagship semi-in-ear earbuds, Xiaomi Buds 6 feature new audio performance through the integration of enhanced hardware and software. It features an 11mm triple-magnet dynamic driver for impactful bass, paired with a 24k gold-plated diaphragm that improves treble sensitivity by 30% for crisper, clearer high notes.¹⁷ This is further refined by a suite of digital enhancements, including master-tuning by the Harman Golden Ear Team that introduces Harman Master Mode alongside Harman AudioEFX for superior sound quality, while Qualcomm® aptX™ Lossless technology enables high-resolution, lossless audio.¹⁸ Additionally, the system utilizes adaptive sound to maintain consistent mid-low frequencies across different ear shapes, while independent dimensional audio¹⁹ with head-tracking creates a fully immersive 360° soundstage. To ensure clear calls in a daily environment, the 3-mic AI noise reduction system, paired with a mesh-shaped acoustic structure, suppresses up to 95dB²⁰ of background noise and maintains voice clarity even in wind speeds of up to 12m/s.²¹ Combined with ANC featuring Balanced and Deep dual modes, users can choose the level of noise cancellation best suited to their surroundings for a more immersive listening experience. Engineered for comfort and seamless connectivity, Xiaomi Buds 6 deliver a lightweight fit and an intelligent cross-device experience. Each earbud weighs just 4.4g,²² featuring an ergonomic semi-in-ear design that follows the natural curve of the ear, reducing pressure and discomfort associated with traditional in-ear styles. The charging case is slim and portable, available in four colors: Graphite Black, Pearl White, Titan Gray, and Nebula Purple. On connectivity, Xiaomi Buds 6 integrates with Xiaomi HyperOS for effortless pairing and smooth switching across phones, tablets, and other Xiaomi devices. For the first time, Xiaomi earbuds debut compatibility with Apple Find My (Apple devices) and Google's Find Hub (Android™ devices).²³ This enables users to locate lost devices using the Apple or Find Hub networks.²⁴ Xiaomi Sound Play: Portable Sound with Dynamic Atmosphere Expanding on the Red Dot Award-winning Sound design language, Xiaomi Sound Play blends immersive audio with dynamic lighting in a compact, textile-wrapped design that seamlessly harmonizes sound, space, and atmosphere. Its 18W high-power sound engine produces room-filling sound, making it suitable for a variety of daily scenarios, from morning routines and workouts to outdoor gatherings and evening relaxation. Designed to elevate both sound and atmosphere, Xiaomi Sound Play features an infinity mirror light at the top and surrounding ambient lighting at the bottom. It offers five color effects and three lighting modes — Drumbeat, Water ripple, and Always-on — allowing users to tailor the visual experience to different environments. For connectivity, True Wireless Stereo (TWS) enables two units to function as separate left and right channels for a true stereo soundstage,²⁵ while party mode with Auracast™ supports up to 100 compatible speakers playing in sync,²⁶ delivering a coordinated audio and lighting experience for larger spaces or events. Built for quality and durability, Xiaomi Sound Play is engineered with IP68 dust and water resistance,²⁷ offering reliable protection against outdoor elements such as sand, rain, and dust. A 2,600mAh battery provides up to 14 hours of playback on a single charge,²⁸ with a full recharge in 2.5 hours. Available in Black, White, Green, and Purple, Xiaomi Sound Play offers a palette of diverse colorways to suit any lifestyle, merging portability, expressive design, and rugged performance into one versatile package. Price and Availability Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm, Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro, Xiaomi Buds 6, and Xiaomi Sound Play are now available on Xiaomi's official channels and authorized retailers. Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm starting at EUR 179.99 Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro starting at EUR 79.9 Xiaomi Buds 6 starting at EUR 119.99 Xiaomi Sound Play starting at EUR 49.9 Product images are available here: Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro Xiaomi Buds 6 Xiaomi Sound Play Please visit mi.com/global for more detailed information on these products and their features. text: Vienna, AUSTRIA, May 28, 2026 – Xiaomi today unveiled its new Smart Tech Appliances lineup for the global market, including new TVs, air conditioners, a refrigerator, a washer-dryer, and a robot vacuum. Following Xiaomi's Smart Tech Appliances' global debut last year, these new products mark another expansion and a major step forward in Xiaomi's "Human × Car × Home" smart ecosystem strategy, bringing smarter connectivity, greater efficiency, and more intelligent living experiences to households worldwide. The new lineup combines intelligent performance, advanced energy efficiency, and seamless connectivity across everyday home scenarios. Xiaomi TV S Mini LED Series 2026 delivers an immersive entertainment experience with advanced QD-Mini LED technology,¹ enhanced refresh rates,² and upgraded audio performance for vivid visuals and smooth motion.³ Mijia Air Conditioner GentleAir creates a softer, more comfortable airflow with precision micro-hole air flaps, while supporting 30-second fast cooling, 60-second rapid heating,⁴ and AI-powered energy optimization.⁵ Mijia Refrigerator Side-by-Side 621L offers generous multi-zone storage with Ag ⁺ Fresh technology to help reduce odors and maintain freshness,⁶ alongside dual inverter technology for quieter and more energy-efficient cooling. Mijia Front Load Washer Dryer 8kg combines washing and drying in one solution, achieving 30% higher energy efficiency than the EU Class A threshold⁷ while eliminating 99.99% of bacteria with high-temperature steam.⁸ Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 Pro completes the smart home experience with 15,000Pa⁹ powerful suction, dual anti-tangle technology,¹⁰ and an all-in-one auto base station for effortless hands-free cleaning. All five new home appliances are integrated into the Xiaomi ecosystem, enabling smarter and more convenient home management. Through Xiaomi Home app, users can monitor real-time device status, receive helpful notifications, customize settings remotely, and benefit from OTA software updates from anywhere. Compatible models also support Google Assistant or Alexa,¹¹ adding seamless voice control for an even more intuitive smart home experience. Xiaomi TV S Mini LED Series 2026: Brings Cinematic Mini LED Entertainment Home Xiaomi TV S Mini LED Series 2026 is available in 55", 65", 75", 85", and 98" models to suit a variety of living spaces and entertainment needs. Finished in elegant dark gray with a stable double-stand design, the series combines a sleek minimalist aesthetic with a premium viewing experience, achieving up to a 98% screen-to-body ratio across the lineup.¹² Powered by QD-Mini LED technology, Xiaomi TV S Mini LED Series 2026 delivers deep contrast, vivid detail, and impressive brightness with up to 1200 nits peak brightness,¹³ a 94% DCI-P3 wide color gamut,¹⁴ and 1.07 billion colors.¹⁵ The series also supports HDR10+, HLG, and Filmmaker Mode for more lifelike visuals, while Dolby Vision®¹⁶ further enhances cinematic immersion on the 85" and 98" models. Designed for smoother entertainment and gaming experiences, the 55", 65", and 75" models support up to 120Hz refresh rate in Game Boost mode,¹⁷ while the flagship 85" and 98" models feature a native 144Hz refresh rate¹⁸ that can be boosted up to 288Hz in Game Boost mode¹⁹ for ultra-smooth, blur-free motion in fast-paced content. Complementing the visuals, dual 15W speakers across the lineup deliver immersive audio with Dolby Audio™²⁰ and DTS:X support, while the 85" and 98" models further elevate the experience with Dolby Atmos®²¹ for more cinematic and immersive sound. Powered by Google TV™, Xiaomi TV S Mini LED Series 2026 brings together streaming apps, personalized recommendations, and seamless smart home connectivity in one platform.²² Support for Apple AirPlay,²³ Google Assistant, and Google Cast²⁴ further enables convenient cross-device connectivity and voice control. Mijia Air Conditioner GentleAir: Fast Cooling and Gentle Airflow for Room-Wide Comfort Designed to deliver softer and more comfortable airflow, Mijia Air Conditioner GentleAir is available in 2.6 kW, 3.5 kW, 5.2 kW, and 7.0 kW variants for different living spaces. Its innovative soft air vane disperses strong airflow at the source, replacing harsh direct drafts with a gentle and even breeze.²⁵ To further enhance comfort, it features three dedicated airflow modes for different scenarios: Halo Flow creates surrounding circulation to minimize direct drafts, Canopy Flow gently cools from above for wider coverage, while Carpet Flow allows warm air to rise naturally from the floor. Built for both comfort and efficiency, Mijia Air Conditioner GentleAir supports 30-second fast cooling and 60-second fast heating for rapid temperature adjustment,⁴ while Turbo Mode instantly unlocks maximum cooling or heating performance with a single tap. Four-way swing airflow further adapts airflow direction for more flexible comfort across different spaces.²⁶ Powered by Mijia AI Energy Saving mode, it dynamically adjusts operating frequency based on real-time conditions, improving energy efficiency by up to 24.5% depending on the model.⁵ Designed for smarter connectivity, Mijia Air Conditioner GentleAir integrates seamlessly with Xiaomi Home app, enabling remote power control, fan speed adjustment, mode switching, and more. Beyond convenient control, AI continuously learns user preferences and adjusts settings based on real-time environmental data to optimize comfort while reducing the need for manual setup. The display brightness also automatically adapts to ambient light, creating a more comfortable sleep environment.²⁷ For added convenience, it further supports hands-free voice control via Google Assistant,¹¹ offering effortless smart home interaction. Mijia Refrigerator Side-by-Side 621L: Expansive Storage Meets Freshness Protection Designed with a premium stainless steel color and modern side-by-side configuration, Mijia Refrigerator Side-by-Side 621L blends seamlessly into contemporary kitchen spaces while delivering generous storage for everyday family needs. It features a spacious 621-liter capacity, including 385 liters for refrigeration and 236 liters for freezing.²⁸ Inside, three-tier storage and a total of 18 compartments provide greater flexibility for organizing groceries, beverages, and bulk items more efficiently. Powered by dual inverter technology, Mijia Refrigerator Side-by-Side 621L delivers energy-efficient performance alongside rapid and even surround cooling to maintain consistent temperatures throughout both compartments. Ag ⁺ Fresh technology further enhances freshness by reducing odors and bacteria such as E. coli,⁶ supporting cleaner and longer-lasting food storage. For smarter everyday management, Mijia Refrigerator Side-by-Side 621L supports remote control through Xiaomi Home app, allowing users to adjust temperature and modes from anywhere, alongside control via the exterior LED touch panel. It also supports Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa for hands-free voice commands.²⁹ Real-time notifications further help users stay informed, including alerts when the refrigerator door is left open to help reduce unnecessary energy loss and potential food waste. Mijia Front Load Washer Dryer 8kg: All-in-One Laundry Solution with Energy-Efficient Design Built for efficient everyday laundry care, Mijia Front Load Washer Dryer 8kg delivers 30% better energy efficiency than the EU Class A threshold.⁷ Equipped with a large 525mm drum and power wash technology,³⁰ it generates strong water flow for deeper and more effective cleaning. The dedicated hygiene mode combines high-temperature steam and hot water to eliminate 99.99% of bacteria, while the steam function can also be added to selected wash cycles for extra sanitization.⁸ Designed to adapt to different daily routines, Mijia Front Load Washer Dryer 8kg offers over 30 wash programs,³¹ including a 15-minute quick wash³² for lightly soiled clothes and a one-tap wash-and-dry function for effortless everyday convenience. Powered by smart dry control, it uses 3D airflow and high-precision sensors to automatically stop drying once clothes reach the optimal condition, helping prevent overheating while keeping fabrics soft and ready to wear. Blending smart functionality with modern design, the washer-dryer features a clean white exterior paired with a colorful touch panel for a more intuitive user experience. Through the Xiaomi Home app, users can remotely control and monitor laundry cycles, customize settings with the My Time program, and save personalized preferences for one-tap access. For long-term use, over-the-air updates continuously add new features and refine wash programs, making everyday laundry smarter and more effortless. Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 Pro: Effortless Cleaning for Everyday Convenience Engineered for effortless everyday cleaning, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 Pro combines edge-to-corner coverage, powerful suction, intelligent navigation, and a fully automated dock for a more complete hands-free cleaning experience. Dual robotic arms extend outward to reach edges and tight corners, reducing blind spots for more thorough coverage. Delivering 15,000Pa powerful suction,⁹ Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 Pro efficiently handles dust, debris, and hair, while its dual anti-tangle system reduces hair wrap for more consistent performance.¹⁰ The intelligent obstacle avoidance system enables millimeter-level detection,³³ while advanced LDS laser navigation ensures precise movement around furniture, cables, and household objects.³⁴ When transitioning to carpets, it automatically lifts its mop pads and boosts suction for deeper cleaning performance.³⁵ The all-in-one auto base station integrates auto dust collection,³⁶ self-cleaning washboard, and hot-air drying into a single streamlined system for a truly hands-free experience. Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 Pro also supports Xiaomi Home app control for remote scheduling and monitoring, as well as voice control via Google Assistant and Alexa,²⁹ enabling effortless everyday operation. text: R&D Expenses Increase 33.4% YoY to RMB9.0 Billion as AI Accelerates Reshaping of “Human × Car × Home” Ecosystem Beijing, Hong Kong, May 26, 2026 - Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”; stock code:1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things (“IoT”) platform at its core, announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months ended March 31, 2026 (“the Period”). Leveraging a solid foundation and driven by continuous innovation, the Group demonstrated strong resilience in the first quarter. Total revenue reached RMB99.1 billion, remaining at a high level. Adjusted net profit was RMB6.1 billion, exceeding market expectations. The operating profit of its core business (smartphone × AIoT) grew by nearly 200% quarter-over-quarter. During the Period, the Group’s “Human × Car × Home” strategy continued to deliver results, with all core businesses performing steadily. Revenue from the smartphone business reached RMB44.3 billion, with the premiumization strategy driving global smartphone average selling price (“ASP”) to a record high. Revenue from the smart electric vehicle (“EV”), artificial intelligence (“AI”) and other new initiatives segment grew 6.9% year-over-year to RMB19.9 billion, demonstrating strong resilience. Revenue from the IoT and lifestyle products segment was RMB24.7 billion, with overseas revenue from this segment hitting a record high on double-digit year-over-year growth. Premiumization Strategy Advances as Global Smartphone ASP Hits Record High The smartphone business made steady progress, with revenue reaching RMB44.3 billion in the first quarter of 2026 on global shipments of 33.8 million units. According to Omdia, Xiaomi’s global smartphone shipments ranked in the top three for the 23rd consecutive quarter. The Group’s smartphone shipments ranked among the top three in 47 countries and regions globally. The Group’s premiumization strategy delivered notable results. Global smartphone ASP increased by 8.2% year-over-year to a record high of RMB1,310. According to third-party data, in the first quarter of 2026, premium smartphones (retail price at or above RMB3,000) accounted for 23.5% of the Group’s total smartphone units sold in the Chinese Mainland. In May 2026, Xiaomi officially unveiled the Xiaomi 17 Max , completing the full lineup of standard and Pro models with both large and small screens for Xiaomi’s flagship numbered series and enabling the Group to meet diverse user needs with a more comprehensive premium product portfolio. Smart EV Business Maintains Growth Momentum with New Product Matrix Gaining Market Recognition In the first quarter, revenue from the smart EV, AI and other new initiatives segment grew 6.9% year-over-year to RMB19.9 billion, with new vehicle deliveries reaching 80,856 units, an increase of 6.6% year-over-year. The Xiaomi SU7 Series and Xiaomi YU7 Series have been widely recognized by the market since their launch. The New-Generation Xiaomi SU7 , officially launched in March 2026, has been met with strong market demand. As of May 6, 2026, locked-in orders for the New-Generation Xiaomi SU7 surpassed 80,000 vehicles during its initial sales period. As of April 23, 2026, cumulative deliveries of the New-Generation Xiaomi SU7 surpassed 26,000 vehicles; and cumulative deliveries of the Xiaomi YU7 Series reached 232,000 vehicles in the first 10 months after launch. According to Yiche, from January to April 2026, the Xiaomi SU7 ranked No. 1 in units sold among pure electric sedans priced above RMB200,000, while the Xiaomi YU7 ranked No. 2 in cumulative units sold among SUVs of the same class. The Group continued to enrich its product portfolio as it advances toward becoming a top global automaker. The Xiaomi YU7 Standard Edition and Xiaomi YU7 GT were officially launched in May. The Xiaomi YU7 GT , positioned as a "sports car-level SUV designed for long-distance travel," set the fastest Nürburgring Nordschleife lap time for an SUV at 7:22.755, marking the first time a Chinese SUV has claimed the top spot globally. The Group also continued to expand its sales and service network. As of March 31, 2026, Xiaomi had opened 490 smart EV sales centers across 143 cities in the Chinese Mainland. IoT Gross Profit Margin Remains at High Level; Internet Services Revenue Maintains Healthy Growth In the first quarter, the Group’s IoT and lifestyle products business maintained high levels of revenue and gross profit margin. Revenue reached RMB24.7 billion, and gross profit margin was 25.2%, an increase of 5.1 percentage points quarter-over-quarter. Revenue from overseas IoT and lifestyle products reached a record high, posting double-digit year-over-year growth, with strong momentum in overseas markets for categories including tablets, TVs, and large home appliances. During the Period, Xiaomi’s tablet products achieved steady sales growth. According to Omdia, Xiaomi’s tablet shipments ranked among the top five globally for the 8th consecutive quarter and among the top three in the Chinese Mainland. Xiaomi's wearable band devices maintained their leading position, with global shipments ranking No. 3 and shipments in the Chinese Mainland ranking No. 2 in the first quarter of 2026. The Group’s TWS earbuds also performed well, ranking No. 2 in shipments both globally and in the Chinese Mainland. In May 2026, the Group launched the Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro and its first clip-on earbuds, further expanding its wearable product portfolio. The synergy between hardware and software continued to solidify the leading advantages of Xiaomi’s smart ecosystem. As of March 31, 2026, the number of connected IoT devices on the Group’s AIoT platform (excluding smartphones, tablets and laptops) reached 1,118.7 million, up 18.5% year-over-year. The number of users with five or more devices connected to the Group’s AIoT platform reached a record high of 23.6 million, an increase of 22.3% year-over-year. In March 2026, the MAU of Xiaomi AI Assistant reached a record high of 169.3 million, up 15.5% year-over-year. The MAU of the Xiaomi Home App grew 10.0% year-over-year to 117.0 million. The internet services business maintained healthy growth, with revenue reaching RMB9.5 billion in the first quarter, up 4.3% year-over-year. Gross profit margin was 76.1%. Revenue from overseas internet services was RMB3.0 billion, up 9.0% year-over-year. Revenue from internet services in the Chinese Mainland reached a record high. Xiaomi’s user base also continued to expand. In March 2026, MAU in the Chinese Mainland reached a record high of 195.8 million, up 8.1% year-over-year. Quarterly R&D Expenses Rise 33.4% YoY as AI Accelerates Reshaping of “Human × Car × Home” Ecosystem Xiaomi remains committed to long-term investment in foundational core technologies and investing resolutely in the future. In the first quarter, R&D expenses reached RMB9.0 billion, an increase of 33.4% year-over-year. R&D personnel totaled 26,048. The Group announced it will invest at least RMB16 billion in AI this year, with total investment set to exceed RMB60 billion over the next three years to accelerate the creation of a closed-loop AI experience within the “Human × Car × Home” ecosystem. Xiaomi achieved major breakthroughs in foundation models. Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-Pro ranked first among global open-source models on both the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and the Agentic Index. Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro topped the global daily and weekly call volume charts on OpenRouter via Hermes Agent. On April 28, 2026, the Group officially open-sourced the Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 series under the MIT License. The Group is leveraging its leading AI capabilities to comprehensively empower its “Human × Car × Home” ecosystem. In April 2026, Xiaomi launched a limited closed beta of Xiaomi miclaw across multiple devices, which now supports smartphones, tablets, PCs, Macs, and Xiaomi Smart Home Screen. Xiaomi miclaw was also among the first in the Chinese Mainland to pass the CAICT's authoritative assessment for mobile intelligent assistants. In embodied intelligence, Xiaomi successively launched its first-generation robotics VLA large model and a tactile-driven fine-grasping fine-tuning model for robots. In March 2026, Xiaomi's humanoid robot officially entered the EV factory for hands-on practice and training, taking a critical step toward physical AI. text: Beijing, CHINA, May 21, 2026 — Xiaomi Auto today unveiled two new additions to Xiaomi YU7 family, Xiaomi YU7 Standard and Xiaomi YU7 GT, featuring a comprehensive upgrade to its luxury high-performance electric SUV lineup. Xiaomi YU7 Series, positioned as a luxury high-performance family SUV, has earned widespread acclaim since its launch — achieving over 240,000 locked orders within the first 18 hours and delivering 232,000 units as of April 30th 2026, firmly establishing itself among the top-selling mid-to-large SUVs in Chinese Mainland. Xiaomi YU7 Standard starts at RMB 233,500, while Xiaomi YU7 GT — a track-bred SUV engineered for "The Grand Tour" — starts at RMB 389,900. Equipped with Xiaomi's latest electric powertrain technology and master-tuned chassis, Xiaomi YU7 GT with Track Package set a Nürburgring Nordschleife lap time of 7:22.755 on April 2, 2026, shattering the previous SUV lap record by a staggering 14 seconds. Design: Where Athletic Sculpture Meets Luxury Craftsmanship Classic Long-Hood Proportions, Warhorse Stance Xiaomi YU7 is a driver-focused luxury performance SUV that balances family comfort with athletic poise. Its exterior features classic long-hood proportions with a powerful, ground-hugging stance that delivers strong visual impact. Three new exterior colors join the palette this year: Crimson Red: A rich, saturated wine-red infused with fine golden pearl particles that reveal layered metallic luster in sunlight and exude understated elegance in shadow. Radiant Purple: Continuing Xiaomi Auto's most popular color gene, this signature shade takes on a new level of refined depth on Xiaomi YU7's sculpted body. Volcanic Gray: Inspired by mist-shrouded volcanic landscapes, this high-purity gray tone is infused with nano-scale mineral particles, creating a layered metallic texture as light shifts across the surface. Understated, sophisticated, and commanding a quiet presence, it exudes effortless elegance. Xiaomi YU7 adds the highly acclaimed Plum Blossom Rims and matching body-color Mi-Shaped Rims, which, together with the new Dawn Pink and Pearl White finishes, elevate the overall premium feel of the vehicle. GT-Specific Design: Widebody, Carbon Fibre, and Aggressive Aerodynamics Xiaomi YU7 GT receives an exclusive widebody treatment with 295mm rear wide tires, a unified front splitter, active rear diffuser, 24K gold carbon fiber badges, and carbon fiber mirror housings. The family design language continues with signature cross-shaped headlights and halo taillights. Optional 21-inch forged two-piece wheels further enhance visual impact and handling precision. Xiaomi YU7 GT is available in five exclusive colors: Crimson Red, Obsidian Black, Titanium Silver, Pearl White, and Volcanic Gray. Xiaomi YU7 GT is available in five colors: Crimson Red, Obsidian Black, Titanium Silver, Pearl White, and Volcanic Gray. Crimson Red is rich, warm, and luminous with remarkable depth. In low light, it appears sophisticated and elegant. Under sunlight, it reveals a translucent pearlescent finish infused with fine metallic particles that create angle-dependent sparkle. Obsidian Black delivers the ultimate classic blacked-out aesthetic. Titanium Silver, the most popular color across Xiaomi YU7 lineup, continues onto Xiaomi YU7 GT. Pearl White is a classic, versatile, and elegant finish that is particularly popular among female owners. Volcanic Gray is understated, sophisticated, and timeless. Premium Customization Additionally, Xiaomi Auto began piloting a premium customization service last year, allowing owners to create a truly unique vehicle. Xiaomi YU7 GT now adds three new premium custom paint finishes: Stealth Black (Matte), Titanium Silver (Matte), and Mercury Silver, showcasing the pinnacle of modern industrial aesthetics. A new Gentian Blue leather interior is also available for Xiaomi YU7 GT, drawing inspiration from luxury fashion color pairings for an even more upscale feel. For wheels, customers can option 21" Dual Five-Spoke Forged Rims for Xiaomi YU7 GT. Crafted through a forging process that involves milling with 20 different cutting heads over 11 hours of machining, followed by fine polishing, these wheels deliver greater strength and reduced weight. Racing Red Interior and Luxury Quiet Cabin: Performance and Serenity in One As a C-segment performance SUV, Xiaomi YU7 offers generous interior space with comfortable seating for three in the rear. The cabin is designed with special attention to family users and female owners: all materials are infant-safe and pet-friendly (OEKO Standard I certified), with a HEPA high-efficiency air filter, magnetic accessory mounts, gentle airflow climate system, and hidden rear storage compartment, plus excellent NVH performance and heat-insulating, UV-protected glass, creating a quiet and comfortable travel environment for the whole family. Xiaomi YU7 GT deepens the integration of luxury and sport. All high-touch surfaces feature 100% soft-touch wrapping with extensive use of supercar-grade Alcantara, totaling 2.3 square meters, with up to 15 available carbon fiber trim pieces. Three GT-exclusive interior colorways — Racing Red & Blaze Black Dual-Tone, Ash Gray & Iris Purple Dual-Tone, and Blaze Black — are accented throughout with over a dozen GT badges, complemented by quilting craftsmanship and red seat belts. The entire cabin features five-screen connectivity, an exclusive GT theme with visual elements and animations perfectly integrated with the interior, plus GT sport sound with 40W external speaker, fully showcasing a technological edge. Comfort is equally premium: the driver's seat features 18-way adjustment (including lumbar support, leg rest, cushion length, side bolsters, and even cushion side bolster electric adjustment) with active cornering bolsters that provide enhanced support. All four seats are equipped with 4-layer airbag massage systems (3 intensity levels, 6 massage modes) and ventilation with heating. The rear seats recline to 132 degrees with infinitely variable electric adjustment, and also feature ventilation and heating. Optional front dual zero-gravity seats ensure first-class comfort on long journeys. With the rear seats folded, cargo volume reaches 1,740 liters, keeping long journeys relaxed and comfortable. Master Chassis + 1,003 PS: The SUV King of Nürburgring Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0 Standard Across the Lineup, Master Edition Hardware for GT Xiaomi YU7 Series comes standard with Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0, featuring a front double-wishbone and rear five-link independent suspension architecture deeply optimized for pure electric vehicle characteristics. The system incorporates sealed dual-chamber air springs and continuously damping variable shock absorbers, front double-wishbone and rear five-link suspension, four-piston fixed calipers, achieving a minimum turning radius of just 5.7 meters. The driving experience is refined and customizable, with multiple driving styles and independently adjustable steering feel. "Sport+" mode is designed for driving enthusiasts, while Comfort mode suits daily city commuting. A specially developed motion-sickness relief mode, which coordinates suspension damping, power delivery, and climate control, reduces motion sickness incidence by 51 percent, addressing a common concern among pure electric vehicle owners. Xiaomi YU7 GT, equipped with the Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0 Master Edition, redefines performance expectations with supercar-grade hardware. Underpinning the YU7 GT's dynamic prowess is a suite of high-performance components. The SUV rides on dual-valve CDC variable dampers, employing the same dual-valve architecture trusted by leading automotive marques to deliver exceptional chassis control. This is complemented by a dual-chamber air suspension offering 75 millimetres of travel, which seamlessly balances plush ride comfort with precise body control across varying road surfaces. Further enhancing agility is an electronic limited-slip differential (eLSD), a first in the segment, that actively transfers torque between the left and right rear wheels with millisecond-level response times. Bringing Xiaomi YU7 GT to a decisive halt is a carbon-ceramic braking system shared with the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, featuring Akebono six-piston front and four-piston rear fixed calipers that achieve a 100–0 km/h stopping distance of just 32.9 metres, maintaining stable braking performance even under continuous aggressive driving. Nürburgring Lap Record 7:22.755: King of the Corners Xiaomi YU7 GT is the first production vehicle developed with deep involvement from technical experts at Xiaomi Auto's Europe R&D Centre. After two years of meticulous tuning by the team in Munich — staffed by engineers from leading performance brands — Xiaomi YU7 GT with Track Package delivered a stunning result on the legendary Nürburgring Nordschleife: a lap time of 7:22.755, smashing the previous SUV lap record by an astonishing 14 seconds. The lap was validated during official testing sessions at the legendary German circuit, further demonstrating Xiaomi Auto's growing capability in high-performance vehicle engineering. Powertrain: 1,003 PS and 705 km — Performance Without Compromise 1,003 PS Super Powertrain: Redefining the Peak of Electric Performance Xiaomi YU7 Standard delivers class-leading powertrain performance, accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in 5.9 seconds and reaching a top speed of 220 km/h, making it perfectly capable of handling everyday driving scenarios from city commuting to highway passing. Xiaomi YU7 GT features a self-developed silicon carbide power module that increases effective current to 800A and improves power output by 13 percent. It also incorporates the industry's thinnest rotor silicon steel sheet at just 0.15mm, a 57 percent reduction in thickness compared to the previous V8s motor. Motor efficiency reaches 98.35 percent, with CLTC efficiency improving by 0.5 percent over the previous generation, equivalent to an additional 6.4 km of range. It is equipped with Xiaomi's latest-generation HyperEngine V8s EVO, with a maximum rotational speed of 28,000 rpm. Combined with a front and rear dual-motor system, it unleashes 1,003 PS, achieving 0–100 km/h in just 2.92 seconds and an astonishing top speed of 300 km/h. The braking system delivers performance even more capable than the vehicle's acceleration, providing substantial safety margin. Xiaomi YU7 GT comes standard with the same track-grade braking system as Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, featuring Akebono six-piston calipers and carbon-ceramic brake discs rated for operating temperatures up to 1,300°C, achieving a 100-0 km/h stopping distance of 32.9 meters. The system also delivers 10 consecutive 180-0 km/h braking stops with no fade, releasing three times the energy of a single 100-0 km/h stop, as well as two consecutive 300-0 km/h extreme braking stops. Combined with the Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0 Master Edition, dual-valve CDC variable damping, and sealed dual-chamber air springs, it achieves a perfect balance between extreme sportiness and exceptional comfort, delivering an ultimate driving experience whether on the racetrack or during long-distance cruising. The electronic limited-slip differential (eLSD) intelligently limits rear axle left-right wheel speed differential in milliseconds, automatically distributing drive force to wheels with traction. This torque vectoring capability reduces drive force loss during cornering, delivering faster and more stable cornering speeds. Ultra-High-Voltage Platform: High Performance Meets Long Range Xiaomi YU7 Standard is equipped with a 73 kWh lithium iron phosphate battery on a 752V silicon carbide high-voltage platform, delivering a CLTC range of 643 km. A 15-minute fast charge provides 385 km of range, more than sufficient for daily urban commuting needs. Xiaomi YU7 GT features a 101.7 kWh ternary lithium battery on an 897V ultra-high-voltage platform with a 5.2C high-rate charging architecture, delivering a CLTC range of 705 km. An intelligent front motor decoupling system adds an extra 20 km of range in Eco mode, achieving a true balance between high performance and long-distance capability, ensuring the great journey is never out of reach. Intelligence and Safety All-Scenario Smart Experience with Lifetime Free Access to Advanced Driver Assistance Xiaomi YU7 Series features an extra-large panoramic display, Xiaomi HyperVision, and a fully upgraded XiaoAi AI Voice Assistant, along with a new AI pet companion, delivering smooth, natural in-car interaction and caring emotional companionship. The entire lineup comes standard with an advanced driver assistance system powered by a NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor computing platform delivering 700 TOPS of computing power, complemented by LiDAR and 4D millimeter-wave radar, as well as the latest version of Xiaomi HAD (Hyper Assisted Driving). This enables full-scenario assistance including highway navigation, urban navigation, and automated parking. The practical voice-activated exterior parking function is standard across all variants, and all driver assistance features are free for life with no subscription fees. Safety First: Building a Mobile Safe Haven Xiaomi Auto has always prioritized user safety above all else. Xiaomi YU7 Series incorporates an embedded roll cage constructed from 2,200 MPa ultra-high-strength steel, achieving industry-leading body torsional rigidity. The door handles feature a triple-redundancy safety design, ensuring that even under extreme conditions such as dual battery disconnection, an independent backup power supply supports in-cabin unlocking, complemented by an exterior mechanical pull handle. For battery safety, Xiaomi YU7 Series battery pack has undergone over 1,200 rigorous tests, including a double dual-needle battery puncture test equivalent to 400,000 kilometers of real-world use, safeguarding users on every journey.
