text: Beijing, CHINA, April 29, 2025 — Xiaomi Corporation ("Xiaomi" or the "Group") today released its eighth annual Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report for 2025, which demonstrates its commitment to sustainability. Xiaomi's strategy, driven by its foundational core technologies, is to consistently embed ESG principles into the daily operations of its "Human × Car × Home" smart ecosystem. The report details Xiaomi's cutting-edge technology, trustworthy governance, data security, privacy protections, and its pledge to deliver green, climate-resilient products to advance a circular economy. Cutting-edge Technology and Trustworthy Governance Xiaomi remains committed to long-term investment, which forms the foundation of the Group's technological breakthroughs and premiumization strategy. Full-year R&D expenses in 2025 reached RMB33.1 billion. 25,457 R&D personnel account for 45% of the total workforce. Xiaomi has built an AI capability matrix of "foundation models + scenario-based derivative models", achieving the technological objective of general capabilities while enabling more precise scenario adaptation. Its large AI model capabilities have led to breakthroughs and are accelerating the empowerment of the "Human × Car × Home" smart ecosystem. Xiaomi recently unveiled three self-developed large models built for the agentic AI era: flagship foundation model Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro, omni-modal large model Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Omni, and speech large model Xiaomi MiMo-V2-TTS. Within less than a week of its launch, Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro ranked No. 1 in weekly call volume on OpenRouter, a global API platform, and was rated No. 8 globally and No. 2 in China on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. To navigate uncertainties arising from evolving global AI regulatory landscape, Xiaomi references the EU's Ethical Guidelines for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence to propose the "Trustworthy AI" concept, ensuring its AI models are fair, inclusive, and trustworthy. It embraces trustworthy AI governance practices for privacy, ethics, and security. Data Security and Privacy Protection Xiaomi is committed to building trustworthy products and services in four categories: security, privacy, compliance, and transparency. Its privacy protection capabilities and practices have been validated through authoritative industry certifications and assessments, including ISO 27001 Information Security Management Systems certification, which covers 100% of its technical operation facilities, and ISO 27701 Privacy Information Management Systems certification. To reinforce on-device security foundations and protect users' core privacy and digital assets, Xiaomi has self-developed the MiTEE secure operating system to operate within an isolated environment that is separate from the main system. This ensures that core assets — such as facial templates, payment credentials, account tokens, and vehicle digital keys — never leave the device or travel beyond the endpoint. For cross-device data protection, Xiaomi strictly adheres to four core principles: Authorization First, End-to-End & No Trace, Consistent Protection, and Secure Link. These assure high-standard data protection across multi-device collaboration scenarios. To safeguard user data rights, Xiaomi has standardised the processing timeframe for Data Subject Requests (DSRs) to 15 days worldwide, which is significantly faster than the one-month period required by the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) — with a 100% response rate. Green Products and Circular Economy Guided by the 3R principles of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle, Xiaomi manages resource efficiency and environmental impact through the entire lifecycle of its products. Several smartphone models, including Xiaomi 15T Series and REDMI K90, use mid-plates made from 100% recycled, high-strength, high-thermal-conductivity die-cast aluminum. Smartphone charger housings incorporate 30% post-consumer recycled (PCR) plastic. The recycled aluminium usage ratio is 14.2% and 19%, respectively, for the Xiaomi YU7 Series and the Xiaomi SU7 Series EVs. Xiaomi systematically integrates low-carbon and near-zero energy concepts into its designs and R&D. In 2025, it launched the world's first Ultra-Low Standby Power Consumption Technology for 100W chargers, with an expected annual saving of hundreds of millions of kilowatt-hours of standby electricity consumption. Its refrigerator business has implemented expanded polystyrene (EPS) reduction initiatives by optimizing packaging design, reducing EPS usage per unit by 620g and cutting annual EPS consumption by nearly 310 tonnes. More than 2 million used smartphones were recycled through trade-in programs during the year. In overseas markets, Xiaomi has positioned trade-in programs as a key driver of its global circular ecosystem. In 2025, it established trade-in capabilities in 14 markets. By the end of the Reporting Period, the program covered 24 countries and regions worldwide. The range of items eligible for recycling includes smartphones, electric scooters, TVs, smartwatches, and a wide range of electronic products. Climate Resilience Xiaomi has been adapting to climate change and advancing emissions reduction across its operations and value chain in line with the Paris Agreement's 1.5°C pathway. It has also been delivering technology products and services that are more resilient to climate impacts worldwide. Xiaomi Smart Factory and Xiaomi Auto Factory have obtained ISO 50001 Energy Management System certification. At the Xiaomi Auto Factory, a regenerative thermal oxidizer (RTO) system was introduced to treat exhaust gas while recovering high-temperature heat for drying rooms. This achieved total annual heat recovery of 38,333 GJ. In addition, Xiaomi HyperCasting enabled a more compact production line and optimized die-casting workshop systems, which reduced temperature control units and operational load and saved approximately 1.82 million kWh of electricity annually. Xiaomi also carries out low-carbon logistics restructuring by continuing to shift from air freight to sea and rail transport. This reduced emissions by approximately 2,471 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent in 2025. Xiaomi procured over 40 million kWh of green electricity in 2025, which represents more than a 10-fold year-on-year increase in transaction volume. Through a model combining direct rooftop photovoltaic connection and green electricity trading, the Xiaomi Smart Home Appliances Factory has advanced renewable energy adoption and the decarbonisation of purchased electricity. By 2026, it plans for directly connected photovoltaic electricity to cover approximately 15% of its annual electricity demand. Xiaomi invests in high-quality enterprises in the new energy vehicle industry chain. This investment focuses on low-carbon technology such as automotive-grade lightweight materials and efficient thermal management systems, enabling breakthroughs and the scaled application of key clean technologies. Xiaomi is committed to leveraging technological innovation to build an advanced and continuously evolving technology ecosystem, providing users worldwide with a comprehensive, seamless, and sustainable smart-living experience. These include a larger display, higher capacity battery, enhanced performance, and a slimmer design, making REDMI Pad 2 9.7 Series ideal for immersive entertainment on the go. High resolution, vibrant visuals, and silky smoothness Determining the level of entertainment that users can enjoy on their tablet is first and foremost the screen, and with this, REDMI Pad 2 9.7 Series delivers with perfection, offering the ideal blend of crystal-clear resolution, immersive visuals, and true-to-life colors on a large 9.7-inch display.¹ Images are sharp and clear, thanks to a high 2K resolution. Meanwhile, a wide color gamut ensures colors remain true-to-life to reproduce scenes in their original detail and vibrancy. Also key to an ideal display is assurance, even with long periods of viewing. REDMI Pad 2 9.7 Series comes with triple TÜV Rheinland certifications for eye-care, and up to 600 nits brightness under bright sunlight in Outdoor mode, for reliable viewing whether indoors or out. Meanwhile, scrolling through content feels buttery smooth with the support of an up to 120Hz refresh rate.² High-capacity battery and strong performance for lengthy sessions Particularly for longer entertainment sessions, endurance is essential. REDMI Pad 2 9.7 Series is equipped with a massive 7600mAh (typ) battery, capable of offering up to 1.7 days of use.³ Alongside the large battery to power entertainment sessions is a powerful Snapdragon® 6s 4G Gen 2 Mobile Platform. Boasting an impressive 34% enhancement in performance and a high AnTuTu score of over 400,000,⁴ this 6nm octa-core processor can achieve a clock speed of up to 2.9GHz, together with improved heat dissipation compared to the previous generation, bringing assurance during long periods of use.⁴ Refreshed interface design and seamless interconnectivity Not only does REDMI Pad 2 9.7 Series feature impressive hardware, but it is also equipped with Xiaomi's latest operating system, Xiaomi HyperOS 3, in-box.⁵ With this comes a more intuitive user interface, including a refreshed lockscreen and wallpapers to unlock more customization options. Xiaomi smartphone owners can also enjoy the benefits of Xiaomi Interconnectivity, including a shared clipboard for quicker and easier copying and pasting between their phone and tablet.⁶ Meanwhile, Circle to Search by Google is offered, making image search simpler.⁷ Slim, durable design for ultimate portability Boasting a sleek modern look at just 7.4mm slim,³ REDMI Pad 2 9.7 Series offers two color options, Graphite Gray or Silver.⁸ The 4G variant stands out with an end-to-end strip, which extends from the top to the bottom of the tablet, around its waterdrop-style camera module, and across its metallic exterior for a touch of class. Meanwhile, REDMI Pad 2 9.7 is equipped with a full metal unibody design for a more classic look.⁹ Both tablets are not only aesthetically pleasing but also highly durable, having successfully passed over 40 rigorous durability tests.³ REDMI Pad 2 9.7 and REDMI Pad 2 9.7 4G are ideal for on-the-go entertainment, boasting a high resolution, vibrant display, and a slim and durable design, together with cutting-edge performance, bringing another option to REDMI Pad 2 Series' wide-ranging portfolio. text: [BEIJING, April 1, 2026] — Xiaomi today officially unveiled REDMI A7 Pro, the first Pro model in the REDMI A Series, introducing a suite of practical features designed to meet the needs of a wide range of users. Featuring an immersive 6.9" display, a massive 6000mAh battery with long-term durability, and the debut of Xiaomi HyperOS 3 on REDMI A Series,¹ REDMI A7 Pro combines essential functions with responsive performance for all-day connectivity and entertainment at an entry-level price point. Featuring an enlarged 6.9" display, REDMI A7 Pro delivers an enhanced viewing experience, whether scrolling through social media, watching videos, or browsing content. With a peak brightness of up to 800nits and a refresh rate of up to 120Hz,² the device ensures clear visuals even in bright outdoor conditions and seamless operation for smooth interaction. With Wet Touch Technology 2.0, REDMI A7 Pro maintains precise and responsive control even when fingers are damp, oily, or soapy. Paired with triple TÜV Rheinland eye-comfort certifications and DC dimming, the display ensures comfortable and immersive viewing throughout the day. Complementing its immersive display, REDMI A7 Pro packs a massive 6000mAh battery,³ delivering a worry-free experience with over two days of usage on a single charge.⁴ It powers up to 49 hours of calls, 35 hours of video playback, or 77 hours of music⁵ — making it the perfect companion for long trips, binge-watching sessions, and nonstop playlists. Built for long-term durability, the device features a 1000-cycle long-life battery that retains over 80% of its capacity after 1,000 charges,⁶ ensuring consistent, dependable power over time. On the performance side, REDMI A7 Pro is powered by a robust octa-core processor and UFS 2.2 high-speed storage, delivering smooth, efficient handling of everyday tasks. With support for up to 8GB RAM expansion,⁷ the device further enhances responsiveness, ensuring reliable performance when it matters most. Moreover, REDMI A7 Pro marks the first time Xiaomi HyperOS debuts on the REDMI A Series, introducing the latest Xiaomi HyperOS 3. With this upgrade, users benefit from intelligent, real-time assistance and intuitive search interactions via Google Gemini⁸ and Circle to Search with Google⁹. Xiaomi HyperIsland makes multitasking smoother and more efficient,¹⁰ while Xiaomi Interconnectivity enables seamless collaboration across Xiaomi devices,¹¹ bringing greater flexibility and convenience to everyday use. On the imaging side, REDMI A7 Pro features a versatile camera experience with a 13 MP AI dual camera¹² and an enlarged sensor that increases light intake by 13% for brighter, clearer shots¹³. With HDR+, it captures vivid, well-balanced photos across a variety of lighting conditions. The 8MP front camera, with built-in beauty features, delivers natural-looking selfies, while night mode on both front and rear cameras ensures detailed, low-light shots — ideal for evening hangouts and city lights. For creative editing, REDMI A7 Pro introduces AI Sky, which effortlessly enhances skies in your images regardless of weather conditions. Meanwhile, Document Mode turns the camera into a portable scanner, allowing for easy digitization of receipts, notes, or documents on the go. Sporting a slim 8.15mm body for comfortable grip,⁵ REDMI A7 Pro features a sophisticated prismatic lens ring and four nature-inspired color options: Black, Mist Blue, Palm Green, and Sunset Orange.¹⁴ Designed for everyday practicality, it also features a range of versatile features, including 200% volume boost,¹⁵ a 3.5 mm headphone jack, side fingerprint unlock, and NFC,¹⁶ delivering enhanced convenience for daily use. Price and Availability REDMI A7 Pro is available in Black, Mist Blue, Palm Green, and Sunset Orange¹⁴, in 4GB+64GB and 4GB+128GB memory and storage configurations¹⁷, starting from 119 USD. Xiaomi Smartphones Maintain Top-Three Global Ranking as Premiumization Strategy Delivers Strong Results
text: AI Accelerates Empowerment of “Human × Car × Home” Ecosystem Smart EV, AI and Other New Initiatives Segment Achieves Positive Full-Year Income from Operations for the First Time Beijing, Hong Kong, March 24, 2026 — Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”; stock code:1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things (“IoT”) platform at its core, announced its audited consolidated results for the year ended December 31, 2025 (“the year”). In 2025, the Group’s multiple core indicators reached record highs, demonstrating strong growth resilience. For the year, total revenue reached RMB457.3 billion, an increase of 25.0% year-over-year. Adjusted net profit surged 43.8% year-over-year to a record high of RMB39.2 billion. As Xiaomi further deepened the deployment of its “Human × Car × Home” strategy, all of its core businesses showed strong momentum. Revenue from the smart EV, AI and other new initiatives segment surged 223.8% year-over-year to RMB106.1 billion, not only surpassing the RMB100 billion mark for the first time but also achieving positive full-year income from operations for the first time, a historic breakthrough. Revenue from the smartphone business reached RMB186.4 billion for the year, while revenue from IoT and lifestyle products reached a record high of RMB123.2 billion. Xiaomi’s premium products continued to gain market recognition in 2025, with the launch of new premium products including the Xiaomi 17 Ultra , Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica , and the Xiaomi YU7 , a high-performance luxury SUV etc. As of February 2026, the Xiaomi YU7 Series ranked No. 1 in mid- to large-size SUV sales in the Chinese Mainland for seven consecutive months. In March 2026, Xiaomi launched the next-generation Xiaomi SU7 , with locked-in orders surpassing 15,000 units within the first 34 minutes of launch, and surpassing 30,000 units in the first 3 days after launch. Smart EV Revenue Surpasses RMB100 Billion for the First Time, Becoming a Core Growth Engine as the Group's Growth Momentum Enters a New Era 2025 marked the first full year for the Group’s smart EV, AI and other new initiatives business, and it delivered a historic breakthrough by achieving positive full-year income from operations for the first time. Revenue from the segment reached RMB106.1 billion, up 223.8% year-over-year, with income from operations of RMB0.9 billion. In the fourth quarter alone, revenue from the segment reached RMB37.2 billion, up 123.4% year-over-year, accounting for 31.8% of Group revenue. As the segment’s revenue increasingly approaches that of the smartphone business, it has become the most powerful growth driver for the Group. Xiaomi’s smart EV deliveries continued to climb, with total deliveries of 411,082 vehicles in 2025, including 145,115 vehicles in the fourth quarter. In 2026, we will strive to achieve the target of delivering 550,000 vehicles for the entire year. The Group continued to expand its sales and service network. As of December 31, 2025, Xiaomi had opened 477 smart EV sales centers across 138 cities in the Chinese Mainland. In 2025, the Xiaomi SU7 Series ranked No. 1 in sales among sedans priced at or above RMB200,000 in the Chinese Mainland. In February 2026, Xiaomi officially revealed the Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo , a visionary electric hypercar concept project, in Barcelona, becoming the first Chinese brand invited to contribute to this legendary franchise. Xiaomi Smartphones Maintain Top-Three Global Ranking as Premiumization Strategy Delivers Strong Results The Group’s smartphone business made steady progress in 2025, with revenue reaching RMB186.4 billion and global shipments totaling 165.2 million units. According to Omdia, Xiaomi maintained its top 3 global smartphone shipment ranking for the 5th consecutive year, with a market share of 13.3%. In the Chinese Mainland, Xiaomi ranked No. 2 in terms of smartphone units sold, with a market share of 16.6%, up 0.7 percentage points year-over-year. Xiaomi’s premiumization strategy accelerated and delivered solid results. According to third-party data, in 2025, premium smartphones (retail price at or above RMB3,000) accounted for a record-high 27.1% of the Group’s total smartphone units sold in the Chinese Mainland. In the RMB4,000–6,000 price segment, the Group’s smartphone market share by units sold reached 17.3%. Xiaomi continued to deepen its presence in global markets. Xiaomi smartphone shipments ranked among the top three in 58 countries and regions globally and among the top five in 70 countries and regions globally. In Latin America and Southeast Asia, Xiaomi rose to No. 2, with market share reaching 17.5% and 17.0%, respectively. In Europe and Africa, Xiaomi ranked No. 3, with market share rising by 0.6 and 1.4 percentage points year-over-year to 20.3% and 12.7%, respectively. IoT and Internet Services Revenue Both Reach Record Highs as Global MAU Exceeds 750 Million The Group’s IoT and lifestyle products business recorded record highs in both revenue and gross profit margin. Full-year revenue reached RMB123.2 billion, up 18.3% year-over-year, while gross profit margin increased by 2.8 percentage points year-over-year to 23.1%. The smart large home appliances business maintained its rapid growth momentum, with revenue up 23.1% year-over-year, as shipments of air conditioners, refrigerators and washing machines all reached record highs. During the period, Xiaomi’s tablet products achieved steady growth. According to Omdia, Xiaomi tablet products ranked among the top five in global shipments and among the top three in the Chinese Mainland. Xiaomi’s wearable bands maintained a leading position, ranking No. 1 globally and No. 2 in the Chinese Mainland in 2025. TWS earbud shipments ranked No. 2 globally and No. 1 in the Chinese Mainland. As of December 31, 2025, the number of connected IoT devices on the Group’s AIoT platform (excluding smartphones, tablets and laptops) reached 1,079.2 million, up 19.3% year-over-year. The number of users with five or more devices connected to the Group’s AIoT platform (excluding smartphones, tablets and laptops) reached 22.7 million, up 23.6% year-over-year. In December 2025, the MAU of the Xiaomi Home App grew by 11.7% year-over-year to 112.7 million. The Group’s internet services business maintained solid growth. Full-year revenue rose 9.7% year-over-year to a record high of RMB37.4 billion. As of December 2025, global MAU increased by 7.4% year-over-year to 754.1 million, while MAU in the Chinese Mainland increased by 10.1% year-over-year to 190.4 million. Full-Year R&D Investment Nears Annual Profit Level as AI Achievements Empower “Human × Car × Home” Ecosystem Xiaomi remains committed to long-term investment, which forms the foundation for the Group’s technological breakthroughs and premiumization strategy. Full-year R&D expenses reached RMB33.1 billion, up 37.8% year-over-year, while total R&D personnel increased to 25,457. Cumulative R&D investment over the past five years totaled RMB105.5 billion, and the Group expects to invest at least RMB60 billion in AI over the next three years. The Group's AI large model capabilities have achieved key breakthroughs and are accelerating the empowerment of the “Human × Car × Home” ecosystem. Recently, Xiaomi unveiled three self-developed large models built for the agentic AI era - flagship foundation model Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro, omni-modal large model Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Omni, and speech large model Xiaomi MiMo-V2-TTS. Within less than a week of its launch, Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro ranked No. 1 in weekly call volume on OpenRouter, a global API platform, and was rated No. 8 globally and No. 2 in China on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. As for the previously released mobile agent, Xiaomi miclaw, it has entered invitation beta testing. The Group has also open-sourced its first-generation robotics large vision-language-action (VLA) model, Xiaomi-Robotics-0 . In March 2026, Xiaomi’s embodied robots autonomously operated for 3 consecutive hours at the self-piercing nut loading workstation at the Xiaomi Auto Factory, achieving a 90.2% success rate in simultaneous two-side installation while satisfying the production line’s fastest takt time of 76 seconds. This marked a critical step toward large-scale applications. The convergence of AI, robotics for industrial use, smart EVs and smart manufacturing is accelerating. With its deep and integrated presence across cutting-edge technology, smart ecosystem and smart manufacturing, Xiaomi is forging a unique competitive advantage. ENDS About Xiaomi Corporation Xiaomi Corporation was founded in April 2010 and listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on July 9, 2018 (1810.HK). Xiaomi is a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform at its core. Embracing our vision of “Make friends with users and be the coolest company in the users’ hearts”, Xiaomi continuously pursues innovations, high-quality user experience and operational efficiency. The Company relentlessly builds amazing products with honest prices to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology. Xiaomi is one of the world’s leading smartphone companies. In December 2025, the MAU reached 754.1 million (including smartphones and tablets) globally. The Company has also established the world’s leading consumer AIoT (AI+IoT) platform. As of December 31, 2025, the number of IoT devices connected to its platform (excluding smartphones, laptops and tablets) reached 1,079.2 million. In October 2023, Xiaomi upgraded its strategy to “Human × Car × Home” smart ecosystem, seamlessly merging personal devices, smart home products, and cars. Xiaomi always centers on humanity and is committed to providing comprehensive, better connected experiences. Xiaomi products are present in more than 100 countries and regions around the world. In July 2025, Xiaomi was included in the Fortune Global 500 list for the seventh year in a row, ranking 297th. Xiaomi is a constituent of the Hang Seng Index, Hang Seng China Enterprises Index, Hang Seng TECH Index and Hang Seng China 50 Index.

text: Beijing, CHINA, March 19, 2026 — Xiaomi today officially launched the new-generation Xiaomi SU7. Envisioned as The Driver's Car for a New Era , fully electric sedan is available in three models — Standard, Pro, and Max — starting from RMB 219,900, RMB 249,900 and RMB 303,900 respectively. With next-level upgrades across vehicle safety, precision driving dynamics, interaction and connectivity, and premium quality, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 delivers better design, better driving, smarter intelligence, and stronger safety in a dream car worth aspiring to. Iconic Identity Elevated for Next-Level Refinement for Driver and Family Iconic DNA enhanced with new finishes and expanded personalization options Embodying a true luxury C-segment sedan , the new‑generation Xiaomi SU7 maintains the signature dimensions of the first-gen Xiaomi SU7, measuring 5 meters long and 2 meters wide, with a 3-meter wheelbase . After two years of refinement, iconic elements such as the waterdrop headlights and halo taillights returns, reinforcing the new generation' s identity as a member of the Xiaomi SU7 family and firmly establishing the unmistakable Xiaomi design language in the world of automotives . Major exterior upgrades for the new generation are focused on color and details in craftmanship that create a more luxury design while offering more extensive personalization choices. The new‑generation Xiaomi SU7 remains available in a comprehensive palette of nine exterior color options . Four of the original Xiaomi SU7' s most popular finishes — Mineral Gray, Pearl White, Brilliant Magenta, and Radiant Purple — return, plus two popular colors from other Xiaomi models: Obsidian Black, from the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, and Dawn Pink from the Xiaomi YU7. These are joined by three all‑new colors: Coastal Blue, Blazing Red, and Viridian Green . Coastal Blue is a refreshing, pure, and distinctly premium shade of blue crafted from blue aluminum flakes and nano pigments. Blazing Red is bold and expressive—bringing the Xiaomi SU7' s first true red into life like the fiery glow of daybreak with a unique shimmer that changes as it catches the light, giving the red a vivid, three-dimensional, and energetic presence. Deeper in tone and understated in luxury, Viridian Green is enriched with natural malachite pearlescent particles and a bamboo‑charcoal black base layer, creating a graceful transition from deep green to blue‑green depending on the angle of observation, conveying a calm, understated form of luxury. In addition to the new colors, the most visible upgrade to the new‑generation Xiaomi SU7 is the all‑new air intake grille design . Cleaner and sportier, the new design features an enlarged C‑shaped decorative surround and wider brake‑cooling ducts, while the 4D millimeter‑wave radar is now integrated within the grille, enhancing both aerodynamics and intelligent sensing capabilities. Six wheel options are available across the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 lineup, including three all‑new designs that extend the personalization for all styles and tastes. The new wheel options include 19" Diamond Cut Rims, 20" Blade Rims, and 21" Forged Dual Plum Blossom Rims. Among these, the 21" Forged Dual Plum Blossom Rims feature a complex dual‑layer construction that undergoes thirteen hours of precision machining. Using 22 specialized single‑crystal diamond tools, the wheel is continuously milled for six hours to sculpt an intricate dragon‑scale texture, achieving a seamless glossy finish with exceptionally crisp detailing. In addition to these options, classic options including 20" Plum Blossom Rims, 20" Mi‑shaped Rims, and 21" Sport Rims are also available. Continuing this premium look, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 series brings an electric front trunk to the entire lineup. Featuring a 105‑liter capacity and enough size to accommodate a standard 20" carry‑on suitcase, the trunk supports eight different opening methods, including via the exterior physical button, the central display, Xiaomi Auto app, Xiaomi Auto app widget, the remote key fob, UWB proximity control, in‑car XiaoAi voice command, and exterior XiaoAi voice command for unparalleled convenience. Interior design undergoes major refresh for elevated sophistication and comfort The new‑generation Xiaomi SU7 features comprehensive upgrades to its interior design that create refined luxury from the moment you enter the cabin. The cabin itself has undergone a full redesign, brought to reality through premium materials and meticulous workmanship. With a level of comfort above its class , the car offers major upgrades across interior color schemes, ambient lighting, and seat comfort, fully redefining the cabin's premium experience. This luxe interior is available in four color options — the classic Twilight Red and Mist Purple, and the all-new Midnight Black and Cream Beige . Interior detailing has also been further refined. On the central console, an all-new symmetrical layout has been adopted to improve visibility and operational convenience for both the driver and front passenger. In terms of materials, almost 100% of all high-frequency contact surfaces have also been wrapped in soft-touch finishes, while the steering is finished in Nappa leather and accented with chrome trim for enhanced luxury. Jewel‑like high‑gloss electroplated buttons electroplated buttons further elevate both tactile feedback and visual sophistication, and luxury quilting is applied to the door panels and seats, complemented by metal nameplates and metal speaker grilles for more exquisite expressions of craftsmanship. For lighting, the wraparound ambient lighting is the longest in its class at 3,636 mm . Extending from the central console to the rear row, it now forms a complete band of light encircling the cockpit. The lighting system itself has also been upgraded to a triple‑layer design composed of direct and indirect lighting : direct light outlines the cabin's contours, while indirect light creates an immersive ambience. With support for split-tone upper/lower settings, real-time synchronization with music and drive modes, and the addition of a door‑open warning function, the new lighting combines personal expression with practicality wrapped in the epitome of luxury and refinement. Sport meets comfort with new interior refinements you can feel Further elevating both luxury and comfort , the new‑generation Xiaomi SU7 also features comprehensive upgrades in seat design and overall interior quality . The front seats now feature a dual‑style design with three major improvements . Seat ventilation and heating is now provided as standard across the line up. The driver' s seat is now 18‑way power‑adjustable with newly added cushion extension, active side bolsters, and cushion side bolsters, complemented by a 60 mm power‑extendable leg rest. The front passenger seat is also available with a new optional 123° zero‑gravity configuration with a dedicated massage mode optimized for recline for balanced full‑body support. The rear seats also receive four key upgrades . Longer and thicker cushion side bolsters for enhanced lateral support; an additional 20 mm of seat foam; an optimized recline angle of up to 121° for a more relaxed posture that reduces fatigue; and widened, concave sleep-optimized headrests on both sides to securely support the head, ensuring greater stability and sleep quality during long journeys. In terms of interior experience, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 features segment's most extensive premium upholstered surfaces, with nearly 100% of high-frequency surfaces wrapped in soft materials. All materials are certified to the highest-grade OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 , ensuring a safe and comfortable environment for all passengers, including pregnant women and children. The cabin has also been comprehensively upgraded. Acoustic laminated glass is now standard across all four doors , enhancing overall sound insulation, while the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 Max introduces an Ultra-Quiet Cabin with noise and vibration reduction. Through the use of PVB acoustic laminated glass in both the windshield and panoramic roof and additional high-density soundproofing materials throughout the cabin, overall noise reduction is improved by over 4 dB , bringing cabin quietness to the level of D-segment luxury sedans. Heat insulation and sun protection are significantly improved too. All new-generation Xiaomi SU7 models come with a triple-silver coated windshields and double-silver coated roof glass as standard , while side windows feature heat-insulating acoustic laminated glass for enhanced protection against both heat and sunlight. On top of these standard features, Xiaomi SU7 Max debuts a new dual-zone silent EC dimming roof that allows independent brightness control between front and rear within two minutes. With faster response and greater flexibility, the upgraded roof allows front and rear passengers to set their own balances of shade and visibility. The onboard refrigerator has been upgraded to a drawer-style unit with an independent compressor that enables faster cooling. The independent compressor also supports three adjustable modes — Silent, Standard, and Performance — while offering a wider temperature range, improved stability, and faster cooling. The in-cabin sensory experience has also been overhauled with two new major upgrades. In collaboration with premium fragrance brand DOCUMENTS , three exclusive new scents have been crafted for use with the in-car fragrance system. Woodland Bloom blends floral and woody notes for moments of earthly calm; Alpine Breeze combines fir wood with aquatic mineral tones for a cool and composed refresh; and Cedar Mist recreates the natural scent of deep cedar forests. New Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0: Comprehensive upgrades across core electric systems for precise, composed driving and a up to 902 km max range The V6s Plus motor comes to the entire Xiaomi SU7 lineup alongside an upgraded high-voltage platform, delivering faster acceleration, lower energy consumption, quicker charging, and a range of up to 902 km (CLTC) The new-generation Xiaomi SU7 pushes performance further, with comprehensive upgrades across the entire powertrain. At the heart of this blistering performance, the entire lineup is equipped with the Xiaomi HyperEngine V6s Plus . With a maximum rotational speed of 22,000 rpm , it powers the car from 0–100 km/h in as little as 3.08 seconds and to a top speed of 265 km/h , marking a major breakthrough in high-performance electric drive. Range is also class-leading thanks to CTB (Cell-to-Body) integrated battery technology across the series with a pack volumetric energy density of up to 83.9% that boosts energy capacity without increasing volume. This enables a CLTC range of 720 km on the Standard model, 902 km on the Pro, and 835 km on the Max. Further improvements to energy efficiency come courtesy of upgraded energy flow management that increases the battery-to-wheel energy transfer efficiency to 94% , with combined consumption as low as 11.7 kWh/100 km for highly efficient energy utilization. Ultra-fast charging has also been upgraded, delivering up to 670 km of CLTC range in 15 minutes and charging from 10–80% SoC as quick as 12 minutes with a peak charging rate of 5.2C. New Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0 achieves leap in hardware, software, and intelligence to reinforce driving dynamics and safety The new-generation Xiaomi SU7 continues Xiaomi's commitment to setting the benchmark in its class , introducing an all-new Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0 with breakthroughs across hardware, software, intelligence, and real-world driving experience. Offering one of the best configurations in the RMB 300,000 segment, the Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0 features a double wishbone front and five-link independent rear suspension across all models. The chassis automatically detects road conditions and actively adjusts the closed dual-chamber air spring system and continuous damper control (CDC®) to absorb impacts and increase damping to stabilize the body for notable improvements in ride comfort. The system also supports variable suspension adjustment with location memory that automatically raises and lowers suspension based on GPS location for improved rides in variable terrain. Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0 also offers three suspension modes — Comfort, Sport, and Sport+ — with independently adjustable stiffness for instant response to road conditions. Multi-mode tuning expands the chassis bandwidth, delivering both dynamic performance and daily comfort. Suspension height is also adjustable across four levels from -20 mm to +30 mm (50 mm total) , allowing for improved clearance on rough roads and better aerodynamics and reduced drag on flat surfaces. On the software side, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 enhances steering performance through refined system tuning. Reduced steering friction allows for a smoother ride, while the 12.5:1 steering ratio — lower than the typical 15:1 in family cars — ensures a quicker, more direct response. At 11.4 m, the turning diameter also stands above the segment average of 12 m, enabling tighter U-turns and other maneuvers perfect for urban driving. Even multi-lane maneuvers can be completed in a single, fluid motion, with smooth and precise control throughout. The upgraded breaking system now includes four-piston fixed front calipers across the lineup, maintaining consistent performance through 40 consecutive 100–0 km/h stops without fade (on the Max version). Both Standard and Pro models have enlarged NAO brake pads with a 30% larger contact surface area , offering improved quiet and comfort, while the Max model uses low-metallic brake pads for higher heat resistance and durability. Brake feel on all three models are tuned to match the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, delivering faster responses, stronger feedback, and improved pedal precision. Complemented by 265 mm wide rear tires across the range, the vehicle delivers significantly enhanced stability and grip. Bringing further enhancements to the driving experience, Xiaomi Smart Chassis 2.0's Wet Road AI Detection technology has been updated to include an automatically-enabled enhanced stability control mode. Using multi-source data from rain sensors, external temperature sensors, microphones, and cameras, the system analyzes the environment in real-time to accurately judge road grip. Upon detecting wet surfaces, the system prompts the driver to switch to Wet Mode via a quick-access shortcut, which then automatically manages AWD torque distribution (on the Max version) and limits regenerative braking intensity. This process operates seamlessly without intrusive pop-ups, ensuring a smoother and safer experience. Moreover, Xiaomi's proprietary collaborative anti-slip control system reduces wheel slip up to 40% , with a fourfold increase in reaction speed for reactions in just 0.35 seconds . To reduce risks associated with vehicle sharing or valet use, Xiaomi SU7 also introduces an Owner Management Mode accessible via the central display or Xiaomi Auto app. Through the new mode, owners can perform functions like limiting power output across all drive modes while still enabling core functionalities, enabling one-tap toggle for high-performance features like Boost, Launch Control, specialized tuning to mitigate risks from accidental operation, and the ability to set flexible speed limits to ensure the vehicle remains in a safe and controllable state at all times. The system also incorporates the same Motion Sickness Relief Mode as Xiaomi YU7. Through coordinated optimization of power response and regenerative braking strategies, Motion Sickness Relief Mode significantly enhances acceleration and deceleration smoothness, helping to significantly reduce the likelihood of motion sickness and improve ride comfort and safety. Intelligent, Thoughtful, and Engaging: Assisted Driving Upgraded to XLA Architecture for Safer and Smoother Driving and Parking All-new Four-in-One Domain Control Module for a more powerful intelligent platform The new-generation Xiaomi SU7 achieves more advanced intelligence with an integrated Four-in-One Domain Control Module . More compact and lightweight, the controller enables end-to-end optimizations to energy efficient while being built to durability standards more than twice the industry average. Inside, it integrates two flagship 4 nm chips — the Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 handles cabin computing while the NVIDIA DRIVE AGX™ Thor runs assisted driving. Cutting-edge protocols, including UWB and Wi-Fi 7 are also supported for improved connection stability, while Sentry Mode boasts a large 40% increase in energy efficiency. More thoughtful smart cabin with Xiaomi HyperAI enriches multi-scenario experience With the introduction of the Xiaomi HyperOS-powered Smart Cabin as standard, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 redefines the smart cabin experience across the lineup. The upgraded system includes an updated rear remote control panel , enabling a more seamless user experience across all six in-car screens. This is complemented by a more advanced infotainment system and full compatibility with Xiaomi 'Human x Car x Home' smart ecosystem . Additional upgrades further support greater plug-and-play convenience with external devices: Both driver and passenger sides now feature 1/4‑inch thread mounts with automotive-grade 27W power delivery to support high‑power devices. An interface beneath the interior rearview mirror is expandable with an optional 4K gimbal camera or AI spatial interaction sensor to enhance autonomous perception. Magnetic ecosystem accessories such as wireless charging phone mounts, can be placed around the central display for easier operation. In addition, nine new magnetic points have been added throughout the cabin, all fully compatible with existing Xiaomi YU7 magnetic accessories, enabling seamless cross-model ecosystem integration. The Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi AI Voice Assistant has also undergone a major overhaul with the addition of a new companion chat mode for more natural, intuitive interaction . The assistant now includes long-term conversation memory that remembers beyond single sessions, as well as extend scenario coverage and real-time web search. Updates to voice navigation improve understanding of vague or complex instructions and allow for multiple rounds of conversation, enabling drivers to easily plan routes and adjustments waypoints with greater accuracy and flexibility. The voice assistant can now perform tasks across multiple apps with a single command, leveraging its understanding of on-screen content to execute actions across popular in-car and phone apps. Its visual understanding also enables recognition of vehicles, buildings, road signs, and common plants and animals, making interactions faster and more intuitive. Exterior XiaoAi voice control further combines voiceprint recognition with advanced ASR models to accurately identify owners' commands. The system can listen for the owner's commands without repeated wake-ups, filter out surrounding noise, and allow interaction from any position — creating a more natural, convenient, and secure in-car experience. The new cabin is purpose-designed to be more engaging for both drivers and passengers. New virtual interactive companions let passengers select from five animals to accompany them for the ride. Supporting voice interaction and personalization, the companions can also be used in tandem with two magnetic physical plushies that use NFC to integrate with the vehicle system. Dynamic Photos capture has also been added to the car cameras, expanding the range of shooting angles and improving content quality to help capture every moment on the road in stunning detail. Full upgrades to Xiaomi HyperTask include support for more than 40 new atomic capabilities and seamless integration with smartphones while leveraging in- and out-of-car sensing to create and execute tasks automatically. The task management system has been optimized for more efficient and convenient operation. The Discover page interface has been refreshed with a more flexible new feature recommendation mechanism, and task popularity and reference counts are now displayed, helping new users quickly identify trending tasks and providing greater emotional engagement. Other upgrades to vehicle intelligence include: An all-new urban navigation system supports full-scenario lane-level navigation and display of landmarks and real-time traffic events in 3D for improved intuition and usability. The customizable HUD navigation (the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 Max only) includes Immersive, Combined and Persistent modes for more accurate and immersive navigation. A new Transparency Mode enhances safety during low-speed driving and reversing, using omnidirectional sound penetration to enable communication between the interior and exterior without opening windows. The mode also provides 3D position alerts that can accurately identify hazard directions, effectively improving car and pedestrian safety. The upgraded off-board security protection includes a reconstructed vehicle vibration detection algorithm that identifies abnormal vibrations with 100% accuracy. Sentry Mode adds real-time Exterior XiaoAi voice alerts, high-risk event playback and intelligent annotation review to protect the vehicle when parked and unattended. Assisted driving with 360° perception and faster response now standard on all models Featured as standard across the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 lineup is the NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor™ in-vehicle computing platform. With up to 700 TOPS of computing power, the platform delivers a 37.8% increase in power over the previous generation, while the Blackwell architecture enhances parallel computing performance and deep learning capabilities. With support for higher-speed data transmission, more connectivity options, and a high-performance DDR cache, the system delivers significantly improved response speeds and efficiency. Feeding into this system, the updated sensor suite features LiDAR, a 4D millimeter-wave radar, eleven high-definition cameras, and twelve ultrasonic radars, enabling higher perception coverage and faster, more reliable assisted driving performance across virtually all scenarios. Perception is further improved by upgraded ALD-coated ultra-transparent anti-glare cameras that reduce the effects of daytime backlight and nighttime glare to improve image capture accuracy and overall system stability. All models come with front and rear camera dirt detection as standard. Linked to the assisted driving system, the detection model compares consecutive frames captured by the camera to quickly identify dirt and runs an automatic 2.5 bar high-pressure wash for class-leading cleaning. Xiaomi Assisted Driving upgraded with XLA Architecture The new XLA Architecture marks a major upgrade of Xiaomi's assisted driving architecture, evolving from "imitating humans" to "truly understanding the world". Built on the Xiaomi MiMo-Embodied foundation model — the first base model to unify cognition across assisted driving and embodied robotics — Xiaomi XLA enables bidirectional knowledge transfer between the two domains. The model integrates multi-modal and multi-embodied data to enhance general understanding, strengthening performance in spatial perception, spatial reasoning, and physical-world comprehension. To ensure coverage of rare events, the XLA architecture moves beyond the limitations of traditional data-driven imitation learning, enabling contextual understanding and reasoning. It can infer and respond to corner cases, empowering the system to progressively develop human-like decision-making capabilities. Powered by Xiaomi MiMo-Embodied model, Xiaomi XLA introduces voice-controlled assisted driving , allowing users to perform lane changes, adjust speed, and modify following distance via voice commands. With enhanced understanding of complex environments, the system supports defensive driving through real-time risk prediction and proactive response, identifying potential hazards in advance and improving overall driving safety. A new voice parking feature is also introduced, enabling users to set parking styles through in-car voice commands or initiate parking directly through exterior voice interaction. The XLA architecture also achieves parking spot-level navigation in commercial parking garages for the first time in the industry, enabling precise routing to specific destinations such as elevators and charging stations, completely redefining the standard for smart parking. Setting a New Benchmark in Safety for Confidence in Every Journey Enhanced safety with 2,200 MPa ultra-high strength steel, upgraded protection and new escape design Continuing Xiaomi's uncompromising commitment to safety, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 continues to be developed to the highest industry standards, exceeding both C-NCAP and C-IASI safety ratings and undergoing full-scenario, all-seat crash testing with female dummies. Xiaomi's proprietary 2,200 MPa ultra-high strength steel and aluminum alloy accounts for 90.3% of the body structure across the full lineup, significantly enhancing structural safety, while key structural upgrades further improve body safety performance. Using hot gas forming technology, the high-strength steel has been molded to form an new integrated roll cage from the A-pillar to the C-pillar. At 2,200 MPa, the steel features 40% greater tensile strength compared with 1,500 MPa materials , providing better resistance to deformation in extreme events such as underride collisions and rollovers. On the sides, newly added 2,200 MPa ultra-high strength steel four-door impact beams increase load-bearing capacity by over 28% compared with 1,500 MPa materials, effectively reducing cabin intrusion during side impacts and improving occupant protection. Rear passenger safety is also comprehensively upgraded, with 9 airbags included as standard across the lineup for enhanced rear-passenger safety in side-impact scenarios and broader overall accident coverage. In addition, the full lineup features an integrated mechanical cable mechanism for the door handles and dedicated backup power supply that is fully compliant with upcoming 2027 Chinese national safety standards. Even in extreme cases where the 12V battery is disconnected after a collision, doors can still be unlocked from both sides, allowing occupants to exit the vehicle safely. Full battery protection, engineered for every journey Drawing on Xiaomi’s world-leading in-house battery pack development and manufacturing, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 features enhanced structural safety , with full physical protection of the battery pack covering the top, sides, and underside to ensure structural integrity under extreme impacts and complex road conditions. All models come with 1,500 MPa anti-scratch crossbeams and Xiaomi SU7 Ultra's "bulletproof coating" as standard, delivering enhanced resistance to abrasion and puncture, and significantly improving safety on complex terrains. The battery system also meets the industry's highest standards for thermal management, ensuring no permeation, no fire, and no explosion, even if a single cell undergoes thermal runaway at full charge. On top of this, the full lineup is equipped with an ASIL-D rated battery system that can perform an emergency power cutoff within 4ms, supported by a 24-hour vehicle-to-cloud monitoring system for continuous safety alerts. To further ensure safety, the battery pack has undergone some of the most rigorous safety testing, with the battery exceeding national standard requirements in 96% of all 1,231 test items . Among the twenty-four tests defined by the latest Chinese national standards, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 meets validation criteria significantly beyond regulatory requirements in eleven tests. Enhanced safety for owners To reduce risks associated with vehicle sharing or valet use, Xiaomi SU7 also introduces an Owner Management Mode accessible via the central display or Xiaomi Auto app. Through the new mode, owners can perform functions like limiting power output across all drive modes while still enabling core functionalities, enabling one-tap toggle for high-performance features like Boost, Launch Control, specialized tuning to mitigate risks from accidental operation, and the ability to set flexible speed limits to ensure the vehicle remains in a safe and controllable state at all times. Price and Availability The new-generation Xiaomi SU7 is launched in Standard, Pro, and Max, prices starting from RMB 219,900, RMB 249,900, RMB 303,900 respectively. After two years of meticulous development, the new-generation Xiaomi SU7 offers improved design, driving experience, intelligence, and safety. Pre-orders are now available via the Xiaomi Auto WeChat Mini Program and Xiaomi Auto App. Product images and videos available here: New-generation Xiaomi SU7 Series *Xiaomi SU7 Series is not for sale outside of Chinese Mainland. text: [Barcelona, Spain, February 28, 2026] – Xiaomi today announced its latest ecosystem lineup, featuring Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Series, Xiaomi Watch 5, Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W, Xiaomi Tag, and REDMI Buds 8 Pro, bringing together intelligent performance, refined design, and seamless connectivity for daily life. Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Series, Built for EverydayRiding Designed to meet diverse riding needs and lifestyles, Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Series offers a comprehensive lineup spanning high-performance, portable, and entry-level models. The series includes Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Ultra, Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Max, Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Pro, Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6, and Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Lite, each engineered to deliver a smooth, comfortable ride while combining everyday practicality with reliable safety, making urban mobility effortless and enjoyable for riders of all levels. Leading the series, the flagship Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Ultra sets a new benchmark for high-performance commuting. Powered by a 1200W peak power¹ with Boost mode², it delivers confident acceleration and hill-climbing ability on bridges, ramps, and inclines. Large 12-inch all-terrain tires and a dual-swing-arm suspension provide stability and comfort across varied surfaces, while a maximum range of up to 75km and fast charging that restores up to 30km in one hour support extended daily rides with minimal downtime.³ Designed for confident everyday riding, Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Ultra features front and rear disc brakes, E-Brake, E-ABS, TCS, and IPX6 water resistance,⁴ while intelligent connectivity via the Xiaomi Home app and Apple Find My⁵ integration adds convenience and peace of mind. Rider comfort and usability are enhanced by ergonomic curved handlebars, a widened deck, a dual-mode thumb & twist throttle, a physical four-direction control button, and a 3-inch color TFT display, all wrapped in a distinctive Lightning Yellow finish. Xiaomi Watch 5: Flagship Experience Powered with Wear OS by Google™ Powered with the latest version of Wear OS by Google (Wear OS 6), Xiaomi Watch 5 delivers a flagship smartwatch experience, combining intuitive interaction with seamless access to Google services. Optimized Google apps, including Google Calendar, Play, and Maps, enable efficient wrist-based use, while Google Wallet with NFC supports fast, convenient contactless payments. As the first Xiaomi smartwatch to feature Google Gemini out of the box, Xiaomi Watch 5 enables natural, hands-free assistance for everyday tasks, information, and navigation — all without reaching for a phone.⁶ Interaction is enhanced by advanced quick gestures powered by EMG, IMU, and PPG sensors⁷, allowing essential actions to be completed with simple hand or wrist movements. Through 2 general gestures (Pinch Twice and Rub Twice) and 3 customized gestures (Snap Fingers, Shake Wrist, and Rotate Wrist), users can dismiss calls, silence alarms, launch workouts, remotly control camera for photos and recordings,⁸ or access compatible Google apps such as Google Gemini, Google Wallet, and YouTube Music,⁶ delivering a more fluid and hands-free experience throughout the day. Seamless cross-device control is further enabled by Xiaomi HyperConnect, such as remote accessing the phone camera for photo and recordings,⁸ and connected-device management via Xiaomi Smart Hub.⁹ Built to support extended daily use, Xiaomi Watch 5 features a 930mAh battery with 10% Silicon-Carbon content¹⁰ enhanced by Xiaomi Surge Battery technology and a dual-chip architecture powered by Snapdragon® W5 Gen 1 and BES2800 low-power co-processor, delivering up to 6 days of battery life in smart mode or up to 18 days in power saver mode.¹⁰ Encased in a stainless-steel frame, Xiaomi Watch 5 features a 1.54-inch ultra-large display with an ultra-thin bezel, protected by sapphire glass on both the front and back for long-term durability.¹⁰ Comprehensive health and fitness tracking includes one-tap health checks,¹¹ advanced training insights, and precise outdoor tracking with dual-band GNSS for offline maps.¹² Designed to balance performance, intelligence, and premium craftsmanship, Xiaomi Watch 5 delivers a fully connected smartwatch experience built for modern lifestyles. Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W: Ultra-Slim Power for Life on the Move Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W redefines portable charging with an ultra-slim, lightweight design built for everyday mobility. Measuring just 6mm thin and weighing 98g,¹³ its compact, card-sized form fits easily into pockets or small bags, making it a convenient companion for commuting, travel, and extended days on the go. Designed for modern lifestyles, the power bank supports fast charging via wireless and wired methods, and offers simultaneous wired and wireless output. With up to 15W wireless fast charging¹⁴ and high-speed USB-C wired charging,¹⁵ it delivers efficient power when time is limited, while magnetic alignment ensures stable charging and comfortable one-handed use. Despite its minimal profile, Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W features a high-density 5000mAh battery with 16% silicon-carbon content,¹⁰ supported by advanced thermal management and multiple safety protections for reliable, stable performance. Finished in a refined aluminum alloy body with sleek color options, it balances portability, performance, and durability—making dependable power effortless to carry wherever the day leads. Xiaomi Tag: Seamless Tracking for Everyday Essentials Xiaomi Tag delivers a simple, reliable tracking experience that integrates seamlessly into daily life. Compatible with either Apple Find My or Google Android Find Hub, Xiaomi Tag works within the user's chosen iOS or Android ecosystem,¹⁶ enabling easy location tracking of everyday items such as keys, bags, or luggage through familiar platforms. Equipped with intelligent tracking capabilities, Xiaomi Tag supports remote item finding,¹⁷ lost mode, collaborative finding, and enhanced privacy protection. When connected to a smartphone and within Bluetooth range, users can locate Xiaomi Tag easily and trigger a sound through Apple Find My app or Google Android Find Hub¹⁷ Lost mode allows users to mark an item as missing and add contact information to facilitate recovery, while collaborative finding further enhances retrieval by enabling secure location sharing within the network when needed. To better protect user privacy and prevent unwanted tracking, the phone automatically alerts users when an unknown tracking tag is detected moving with them.²⁸ Designed for everyday use, Xiaomi Tag features a compact and lightweight form with a metal outer ring and a minimalist body. Weighing approximately 10g,¹⁰ it attaches easily to keys, backpacks, or luggage without adding bulk, while the built-in hanging and labeling design ensures it is ready to use straight out of the box. Built for real-world reliability, Xiaomi Tag offers up to over one year of battery life¹⁸ with a replaceable CR2032 battery and IP67 dust and water resistance.¹⁹ REDMI Buds 8 Pro: Immersive Sound with Intelligent Noise Control Engineered to deliver rich, detailed sound and immersive listening in everyday scenarios, REDMI Buds 8 Pro features an upgraded coaxial triple-driver configuration that delivers deeper bass, clearer vocals, and balanced audio across frequencies. With support for Dolby Audio,²⁰ REDMI Buds 8 Pro can add dimensionality and clarity to your audio experience for entertainment like movies, videos, and games, and deliver dialogue with crisp clarity, making it more vivid and true to life. The surround sound performance is further enhanced by an independent sound processing unit integrated into each earbud, ensuring consistent audio quality across different smartphone brands and applications. In addition, REDMI Buds 8 Pro features Xiaomi dimensional audio,²¹ offering multiple dedicated spatial audio modes tailored to different listening scenarios — including Standard mode for balanced everyday use, Music mode for enhanced vocals and bass, Video mode for a more cinematic soundstage, Game mode for precise spatial cues, and Audiobooks mode for clearer, more focused voice playback. Designed to maintain focus in complex environments, REDMI Buds 8 Pro supports up to 55dB active noise cancellation with an extended bandwidth of up to 5kHz,²² reducing both low-frequency rumbles and higher-pitched ambient noise effectively. An advanced adaptive noise-reduction algorithm samples environmental sound up to 32,000 times per second,¹⁰ enabling real-time adjustment for smoother, more consistent quietness. For calls, the triple-microphone AI noise-reduction system effectively minimizes ambient noise, ensuring reliable communication indoors and outdoors. A dedicated wind-noise-resistant design further enhances call clarity, providing clear voice pickup even in winds up to 12 m/s.²³ Built for everyday convenience, REDMI Buds 8 Pro supports fast charging, delivering up to 2 hours of listening from just 5 minutes of charging,²⁴ alongside long-lasting battery performance of up to 8 hours of continuous playback on a single charge, or up to 33 hours with the charging case.²⁵ Intuitive touch controls, dual-device Bluetooth connectivity, and IP54 dust and water resistance²⁶ enhance usability across work, travel, and workouts. Together, REDMI Buds 8 Pro combines immersive sound, intelligent noise control, and practical design to deliver a premium wireless listening experience.
