text: [ Barcelona, Spain, February 28, 2026 ] - Xiaomi today unveiled its next-generation Xiaomi 17 Series, showcasing the company's latest advances in mobile technology. Xiaomi Pad 8 Series, Xiaomi's latest flagship tablets, and a selection of Smart on the Go AIoT products were also introduced — including Xiaomi Scooter 6 Series and Xiaomi Watch 5 — further expanding Xiaomi's connected ecosystem. Showcasing its design ambition, Xiaomi also introduced Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo, a visionary electric hypercar concept created for the legendary Gran Turismo franchise. As a core focus of today's announcement, Xiaomi also unveiled a major evolution of its partnership with Leica. The collaboration has been elevated from a highly successful Joint R&D framework to a new Strategic Co-creation Model, reflecting a deeper, end-to-end partnership. Built under this upgraded model, Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Leica Leitzphone powered by Xiaomi set a new benchmark for mobile photography, combining flagship-level imaging performance with sleek form factors and durable, ergonomically refined designs. Backed by over a century of Leica imaging expertise, the Xiaomi 17 Series delivers a complete flagship smartphone experience, with industry-leading photo and video capabilities at its core. Timeless Design Behind Unparalleled Xiaomi Guardian Structure The Xiaomi 17 Series features a minimalist design that prioritises elegance and a professional look. Clean lines, smooth edges, and a streamlined layout create a simple, confident appearance that reflects the series' refinement. Wrapped in Golden Arc curves refined through countless iterations, Xiaomi 17 Series' form factor contributes to a comfortable, reliable in-hand feel. Thanks to elevated design and cutting-edge LIPO manufacturing techniques, ultra-thin bezels ensure Xiaomi 17 Series is both comfortable and easy to hold securely while enjoying a near-borderless display. The thinnest and lightest Xiaomi Ultra yet,¹ Xiaomi 17 Ultra measures just 8.29mm² thick and weighs as little as 218.4g², sporting a refined, all-flat body with ultra-thin bezels and a newly repositioned, smaller, less intrusive camera deco housing. Available in White, Black, or stunning Starlit Green,³ it offers premium looks befitting a truly top-of-the-line device. Beyond its stunning appearance, Xiaomi Guardian Structure ensures robust durability with Xiaomi Shield Glass 3.0, offering 30%² greater drop resistance than Xiaomi 15 Ultra, a high-strength fiberglass back, an aluminum alloy frame, and an IP68⁶ rating for comprehensive protection against dust and moisture. For an even more compact imaging and technology experience, Xiaomi 17 measures at 8.06mm² in thickness and weighs just 191g², despite packing high-end computational power, advanced imaging capabilities, and a robust battery. Available in striking color options, Venture Green, Alpine Pink, Ice Blue, and classic Black,³ it features a redesigned camera deco, significantly reduced curvature in the frame transition, and ultra-slim 1.18mm bezels². In addition to a sleek, bold, visually striking design, Xiaomi 17 is built to last, with Xiaomi Guardian Structure featuring a 6M42 aluminum frame, Xiaomi Shield Glass, and IP68⁶ certification, ensuring durability and peace of mind. Xiaomi × Leica: A Visionary Imaging Collaboration Xiaomi continues its partnership with Leica to deliver a professional imaging experience on the Xiaomi 17 Series. Built on Leica UltraPure optical lens treatment and configuration, the Xiaomi 17 Series performs reliably across a wide range of lighting conditions, preserving detail in both bright and low-light scenes. A high-end lens configuration with multi-layer coating helps reduce reflections and optical interference, allowing cleaner light to reach the sensor. Imaging across the series is supported by tools such as AI Creativity Assistant and Xiaomi HyperConnect features, including file sharing and Multicam setup, enabling a more flexible shooting and editing workflow. Engineered for powerful, versatile image capture, Xiaomi 17 Ultra breaks new ground with Xiaomi's first 1" LOFIC main camera sensor. The Light Fusion 1050L image sensor uses cutting-edge capacitor technology to significantly increase full-well capacity and enable next-generation HDR performance. Another key breakthrough is the Leica 200MP 75–100mm camera, featuring a 75–100mm mechanical optical zoom. Built to Leica APO optical references, the telephoto camera maintains high image quality with minimal ghosting and colour fringing across the entire zoom range, and expands to a 400mm (17.2x) equivalent focal length thanks to advanced sensor technology for outstanding long-range photography. In addition to its advanced still photography capabilities, Xiaomi 17 Ultra offers ultra-dynamic videography with cinema-grade recording, color, and stabilization features, including Dolby Vision® or ACES Log recording at up to 4K 120fps on both the main and telephoto cameras. Meanwhile, the Xiaomi 17 compact imagery flagship boasts a versatile imaging system, centered around the top-of-the-line Light Fusion 950 image sensor with a 1/1.31" size and 2.4μm 4-in-1 Super Pixel, delivering an impressive 13.5EV high dynamic range for rich, true-to-life images in any lighting. Complementing this is a Leica 60mm floating telephoto lens, offering 60mm portrait photography, 5x optical-level zoom, precise 10cm macro, and 20x AI Ultra Zoom. For self-portraits, a new 50MP front camera features improved autofocus at both short and long distances. Videography is equally robust, supporting 4K 60fps Dolby Vision® and 4K 60fps Log recording for crisp detail, consistent color, and impressive stability, enhancing clarity and streamlining workflow for professional-grade capture. In the spirit of Leica's rich photography legacy, Xiaomi 17 Ultra's industry-leading camera system can be further enhanced with two upgraded photography add-ons. The new Xiaomi 17 Ultra Photography Kit features a significantly lighter, more compact design, including a wrist strap, a customizable two-stage shutter, a dedicated video button, and an IP54¹⁴ rating, all inspired by professional cameras and available in various colors. For dedicated enthusiasts, the Xiaomi 17 Ultra Photography Kit Pro elevates the experience with a premium, slip-resistant PU leather grip reminiscent of iconic Leica bodies, an integrated 2000mAh (typ) battery, a detachable shutter button for customized ergonomics, and a unique Fastshot mode UI, offering comprehensive control for professional shooting. Elite Performance Meets Cutting-Edge Power Behind each member of Xiaomi 17 Series lies the industry-leading Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform, delivering unmatched performance and the most advanced feature set found on a mobile SoC. The high-performance custom-built 3ʳᵈ Gen Qualcomm Oryon™ CPU, next-generation Qualcomm® Adreno™ GPU, advanced Qualcomm® Hexagon™ NPU, RAM, and storage are suited to the most demanding mobile tasks and easily meet user needs, including rapid-fire photo and video capture, high-clarity video calls, high-productivity multitasking, and resource-intensive gaming. Xiaomi 17 Series introduces up to 100W HyperCharge and,⁴ in addition, 100W PD-PPS charging, which opens up a wide range of compatible chargers.⁵ Xiaomi 17 Series introduces a new generation of power with its revolutionary Xiaomi Surge Battery, featuring an industry-leading 16% silicon content for remarkable energy density and longevity. Xiaomi 17 Ultra houses a massive 6000mAh (typ) battery capacity, supporting 90W wired HyperCharge and 50W wireless HyperCharge, while Xiaomi 17 boasts an even larger 6330mAh (typ) battery capacity with 100W wired HyperCharge and 50W wireless HyperCharge.⁴ These advanced battery technology contributes to the series' slim and lightweight design, ensuring a smooth, feature-packed experience with rapid power delivery. Refined Display Technology Emphasizing Color, Clarity, and Efficiency Equipped with displays designed to match its imaging and performance capabilities, the Xiaomi 17 Series features custom-built OLED panels with up to 3,500 nits peak brightness, ensuring clear visibility in any lighting condition. The 1–120Hz LTPO refresh rate, combined with DC dimming, delivers smooth, comfortable visuals with minimal eye strain during extended use. The series introduces the Xiaomi-custom M10 display panel, offering higher brightness with improved power efficiency. Xiaomi 17 Ultra also debuts Xiaomi HyperRGB technology, a redesigned OLED subpixel layout that enhances clarity and further optimizes power use, reinforcing Xiaomi's reputation for sharp, vibrant displays. Introducing Leica Leitzphone powered by Xiaomi Marking the 100-year anniversary of Leica, the company partnered with Xiaomi to bring its iconic heritage and design philosophy to a cutting-edge mobile device. This industry-first co-development places Leica's classic image capture approach at the heart of the device, combining a century of expertise with modern technology. Leica Leitzphone powered by Xiaomi features a durable aluminum-alloy body with a nickel-anodized finish, reflecting Leica's heritage in every detail. On the software side, a refreshed Leica-tuned interface offers performance- and artistry-focused imaging that is intuitive and enjoyable for both casual photographers and seasoned professionals. Notably, Leica Leitzphone powered by Xiaomi features an innovative Leica Camera Ring, a physical dial with a knurling finish that makes it feel just like a real zoom camera in the hand. The phone also introduces Leica Essential mode, recreating the image quality and photographic style of iconic Leica cameras, including Leica M9 and Leica M3 (with MONOPAN 50 film). Xiaomi Pad 8 Series: designed for powerfully productive moments on the go Xiaomi also announces Xiaomi Pad 8 and Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro,¹⁵ its latest line of AI-powered light productivity tablets, offering the most powerful and thinnest tablets Xiaomi has ever launched to the international market. Designed for professionals and everyday users alike, this new series combines flagship performance with sleek portability, making it an ideal companion for staying productive on the go. As part of Xiaomi's broader smart hardware ecosystem, Xiaomi Pad 8 Series inherits the cutting-edge technology developed for Xiaomi smartphones. Xiaomi Pad 8 Series comes with stunning visuals on the 11.2-inch 3.2K display,¹⁶ offering up to 800 nits¹⁸ of brightness and a buttery-smooth 144Hz refresh rate¹⁷. Whether you're diving into work, editing photos, or streaming your favorite shows, every detail comes to life with remarkable clarity and fluidity. With an ultra-thin profile of just 5.75mm and weighing only 485g,¹⁹ these tablets are built to go wherever you go, slipping easily into your bag, yet packed with power. Despite being thinner and lighter than the last generation, both models are equipped with a large 9,200mAh battery,²º offering even greater capacity for longer use. Running on Xiaomi HyperOS 3, Xiaomi Pad 8 Series offers a more elegant and refined aesthetic, PC-level productivity, and system-level intelligence powered by Xiaomi HyperAI.²¹ The new interface features updated lock screens, wallpapers, and desktop elements, all enhanced with subtle animations and customizable widgets. Beyond design, Xiaomi HyperOS 3 also empowers users to maximize productivity, enabling effortless multitasking and offering a PC-like experience. The updated split-screen layout now supports a 5:5 vertical split view, enabling users to maximize the large display for efficient multitasking, and introduces the new horizontal 1:9 split ratio for more flexible window management. Workstation Mode on Xiaomi Pad 8 Series has been upgraded, expanding the number of apps that can be retained in the Dock to display more quick-access apps. Xiaomi HyperOS 3 takes multitasking a step further by supporting PC-Level Browser on Xiaomi Pad 8 Series.³³ Featuring intuitive mouse-hover previews, right-click functionality, and an enhanced toolbar, it facilitates smoother interaction with online tools and platforms, making it easier to work, create, and collaborate across the web. Professional workflows are further supported by integrated WPS Office PC,²³ ensuring seamless compatibility with WPS Docs, WPS Slides, WPS Sheets, and WPS PDFs for document creation and editing directly on the device. These functions are specifically tailored to enhance productivity on Xiaomi devices. Additionally, Xiaomi HyperAI²¹ and enhanced interconnectivity will help boost user productivity, enabling smooth transitions between tasks, effortless collaboration across devices, and uninterrupted workflow. At the top of the line, Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro is powered by Snapdragon® 8 Elite Mobile Platform²⁴, offering top-tier performance for users who need to power through intensive tasks, with CPU performance increased by 81% and GPU performance boosted by 103%.³¹ With 67W HyperCharge,²º your Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro powers up quickly, whether you're at a coffee shop or in between meetings, keeping you on track without delay. A 50MP rear camera and a 32MP front camera are designed for professionals who require detailed image capture and high-quality video calls. For those with larger storage needs, this model offers up to 512GB of storage, providing ample space for extensive project files, high-res media, and apps. And, for a more versatile premium experience, Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro is also offered in a Matte Glass version with the next-gen nano-texture-etched display driven by anti-reflective coating technology,²⁵ which drastically improves sparkle resistance by 44% compared to the last generation and provides superior tactile performance,³⁸ particularly when using a stylus for creative or professional tasks. For those seeking a more streamlined yet still powerful experience, Xiaomi Pad 8 , Xiaomi's most powerful standard model to date globally, offers a high-performance alternative powered by the Snapdragon® 8s Gen 4 Mobile Platform.²⁴ CPU performance increases by 32%, while GPU performance jumps by 67%,³² making it the perfect choice for users who rely on multitasking. 45W turbo charging ensures you're always ready to go,²º even during busy days. A 13MP rear camera and an 8MP front camera deliver crisp, clear visuals for everyday tasks. With up to 256GB of storage, Xiaomi Pad 8 gives users enough room for daily apps, photos, and media without the excess capacity needed for high-end projects. Xiaomi Pad 8 Series introduces the all-new Xiaomi Focus Pen Pro,¹⁵ a premium stylus weighing only 17.5g.¹⁸ It features pressure-sensitive control for precise input, along with intuitive pinch and double-tap gestures for seamless interaction with documents and artwork. This series is also supported by a range of productivity accessories, including Xiaomi Pad 8 / 8 Pro Focus Keyboard, Xiaomi Pad 8 / 8 Pro Keyboard, and Xiaomi Pad 8 / 8 Pro Cover, all designed to elevate your workflow and turn tablets into powerful, all-in-one tools. Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo: A Hypercar Sculpted by Wind and Intelligence As a continuation of its collaboration with Gran Turismo 7 and Polyphony Digital Inc., a subsidiary of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc., Xiaomi has unveiled its first hypercar for the renowned racing simulation platform. Following an invitation from Kazunori Yamauchi, Producer of the Gran Turismo series, Xiaomi joins the Vision Gran Turismo project, becoming the first technology brand to contribute to this elite virtual collection of dream cars crafted by the world's most visionary automakers. During the launch event, Tianyuan Li, Design Head of Xiaomi EV, unveiled Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo, the 36th brand to join the project and the 51st Vision Gran Turismo concept vehicle created for the legendary franchise. Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo is a concept electric hypercar sculpted by the wind. Its teardrop-shaped cockpit is embedded within a body sculpted with cutouts and airducts, forming aerodynamic channels throughout the vehicle. The signature halo-shaped taillight serves as both a visual icon and a massive air outlet. Together with innovations like the Active Wake Control System and Accretion Rims, the car achieves a drag coefficient of 0.29, downforce of -1.2, and an aerodynamic efficiency rating of 4.1 through iterative simulated testing, reaching new heights in balancing low drag and high downforce for electric hypercars. "Electric hypercars must answer a fundamental question," said Li. "Do we pursue extreme low drag for straight-line speed, or maximum downforce to conquer corners? The optimal solution lies in finding the perfect balance between the two." This approach impressed Yamauchi: "When I saw that Xiaomi had resolved the contradiction between low drag and high downforce, I was truly amazed." Inside, Xiaomi introduces the "Sofa Racer" concept. The dashboard, door panels, and seats flow together as one cohesive loop, a cocoon-like cabin that gently envelops the driver. Equipped with intelligent features including Xiaomi Pulse, which interacts with the driver through light and sound, the space creates an experience best described as racing on a sofa. True to the Xiaomi family, it is fully integrated into the "Human x Car x Home" smart ecosystem. Sensing the driver's state and adapting to their mood, it transforms the car from a mere tool into an intuitive companion. Following Xiaomi SU7 Ultra's record-setting Nürburgring performance and its integration into Gran Turismo 7, this latest creation represents the next chapter in the collaboration. It forges a path distinct from the fuel-powered past, one that Yamauchi believes "will become a role model for this era." Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo will be on display at Xiaomi's booth (Hall 3, 3M30) at Mobile World Congress 2026. text: Beijing, CHINA, January 15, 2026 - Xiaomi today announced the launch in international markets of REDMI Note 15 Series, comprising five models — REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G, REDMI Note 15 Pro 5G, REDMI Note 15 Pro, REDMI Note 15 5G, and REDMI Note 15. Defined by REDMI Titan Durability, the lineup highlights long-lasting battery performance, reinforced drop resistance, and enhanced dust and water protection, alongside upgraded imaging capabilities, flagship-level performance, and a seamless user experience. In addition to the series, Xiaomi also introduced Mijia Smart Audio Glasses and REDMI Buds 8 Lite, further expanding its ecosystem lineup. REDMI Titan Durability, Engineered for Everyday Challenges Spanning every model, REDMI Titan Durability integrates a long-lasting battery experience, enhanced drop resistance, and comprehensive dust and water resistance — establishing a new durability standard for REDMI Note Series. REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G and REDMI Note 15 Pro 5G lead the lineup with the most advanced durability features, while all models are engineered to meet the demands of everyday use. At the core of this upgrade is an enhanced battery experience. REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G features a 6500mAh Silicon–Carbon (SiC) Battery with 10% SiC content,¹ paired with 100W HyperCharge³ and 22.5W reverse charging⁴, delivering flagship-level endurance and fast charging. Making its debut in REDMI Note Series, SiC battery technology enables higher energy density within a compact form factor. Across all Pro models, the SiC battery works alongside Xiaomi Surge battery management system, retaining 80% or more capacity after 1,600 charge cycles, equivalent to approximately six years of typical use.² Despite being the slimmest REDMI Note device to date, REDMI Note 15 5G with an ultra-thin 7.35mm profile²¹, houses a robust 5,520mAh SiC battery.¹ Alternatively, REDMI Note 15 features an upgraded 6,000 mAh battery.¹ Reverse charging support across the lineup, including 22.5W or 18W depending on model, adds everyday convenience and flexibility.⁴ Structural durability is reinforced across the series. REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G and REDMI Note 15 Pro 5G have achieved SGS Premium Performance Certification,⁵ verifying resistance to drops, crushing, and bending. Built on REDMI Titan Structure, both models combine a high-strength motherboard, reinforced mid-frame, and multi-layer shock-absorbing design, complemented by Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus® 2 — together enabling certified drop resistance from heights of up to 2.5 meters.⁷ REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G further incorporates an ultra-tough fiberglass back panel²² to improve impact absorption⁴⁴ without adding unnecessary weight. The rest of the lineup features a durable structural design that has passed the SGS Comprehensive Shock and Drop-Resistance test,⁶ delivering dependable protection in real-world use. To deliver comprehensive everyday protection, REDMI Note 15 Series raises the bar for dust and water resistance. REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G and REDMI Note 15 Pro 5G meet IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K standards⁸ and are certified to withstand immersion at depths of up to 2 meters for 24 hours⁹. Verified by the TÜV SÜD Smartphone Water-Resistant Endurance Certification,¹⁰ these models incorporate 17 precision-engineered waterproof elements to ensure long-term reliability. REDMI Note 15 Pro, REDMI Note 15 5G, and REDMI Note 15 also feature enhanced dust and water resistance designed to handle splashes, spills, and challenging environments. Across the entire lineup, Wet Touch 2.0 ensures the display remains responsive even when the screen or fingertips are wet, allowing smooth operation in everyday conditions. Elevated Imaging System with Advanced AI Engineered to deliver exceptional clarity in every shot, REDMI Note 15 Series brings a holistic imaging upgrade to the entire lineup. By combining high-resolution sensors, versatile focal lengths, and advanced AI-empowered photography within its segment. At the center of this upgrade, REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G and REDMI Note 15 Pro 5G feature a new 200MP ultimate-clarity camera, powered by the global debut of a 200MP HPE image sensor. This large 1/1.4-inch sensor, together with 2× and 4× optical-level in-sensor zoom, triple-focal-length DAG HDR, and advanced AI processing, delivers detailed, true-to-life images across a wide range of lighting conditions. The Pro models support five focal lengths from 23mm to 92mm through a single lens, enabling flexible framing for landscapes, street photography, portraits, and close-ups. Meanwhile, REDMI Note 15 5G and REDMI Note 15 feature a 108MP super-clear camera system, offering a 3× optical-level telephoto experience that covers perspectives from wide-angle shots to portrait close-ups. Across the series, imaging is further enhanced with creative and AI-powered tools, including an ultra-clear portrait algorithm, Dynamic shots 2.0 for motion effects, and easy editing with direct sharing to Instagram.²³ Post-processing is easier than ever, with REDMI Note 15 Pro models featuring AI Creativity Assistant¹¹, while REDMI Note 15 5G and REDMI Note 15 offer a suite of AI image editing tools¹² designed for everyday creativity. Across the entire series, AI Remove Reflection and AI Beautify are supported, enabling cleaner images and one-tap enhancements with minimal effort. Upgraded Performance and Smarter Connectivity Beyond durability and imaging, REDMI Note 15 Series delivers balanced performance for a wide range of usage scenarios. At the top of the lineup, REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G is powered by Snapdragon® 7s Gen 4 mobile platform and introduces Xiaomi IceLoop cooling system to REDMI Note Series, standing out as the only LHP cooling solution in its price segment and delivering triple the heat-transfer efficiency.⁴⁴ Across the lineup, a new generation of Snapdragon and MediaTek chipsets delivers faster performance, smoother graphics, and improved energy efficiency. All models support Google Gemini¹³ and Circle to Search with Google¹⁴, delivering personalized interactions and convenient search. At the top of the series, REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G further integrates Xiaomi HyperAI,¹² delivering more personalized and intelligent AI experiences. For enhanced connectivity, the flagship-level Xiaomi Offline Communication is introduced on the Pro models,¹⁵ enabling kilometer-level voice transmission even without network coverage. REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G further benefits from Xiaomi Surge T1S Tuner, delivering stronger and more stable connectivity across Wi-Fi, Bluetooth®, GPS, and cellular networks.⁴⁴ Immersive Experience With Large Display and Powerful Audio REDMI Note 15 Series offers an upgraded immersive viewing experience with larger displays and improved clarity. REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G and REDMI Note 15 Pro 5G feature 6.83-inch displays, while REDMI Note 15 Pro, REDMI Note 15 5G, and REDMI Note 15 come equipped with 6.77-inch displays, delivering wide, near-borderless views. With up to 3,200 nits peak brightness, 3840Hz PWM dimming, and triple eye-care certifications, the series ensures both visibility and comfort in various lighting conditions. Complementing the display, REDMI Note 15 Pro+ 5G and REDMI Note 15 Pro 5G introduce a 400% volume boost,¹⁶ while the rest of the lineup offers a 300% volume boost, delivering louder, clearer audio for movies, music, and games.¹⁷ Positioned to meet the diverse needs of users worldwide, REDMI Note 15 Series delivers a well-rounded combination of durability, imaging, performance, and display enhancements. Built on the trusted foundation of REDMI Titan Durability, the lineup is designed to withstand the demands of daily use while delivering high-quality imaging, smooth performance, and a seamless user experience. Adventure Meets Titan Durability: REDMI Note 15 Series Teams Up with the Discovery Channel and Ed Stafford REDMI Note 15 Series has partnered with Discovery Channel and renowned explorer Ed Stafford to bring viewers worldwide Discovery's new documentary series Ed Stafford's Rite of Passage. In collaboration with the new series, Ed not only brings the real-world toughness of the REDMI Note 15 Series to life but continues to explore how people around the world confront challenge, resilience, and transformation in their environment. Inspired by the themes of Ed Stafford's Rite of Passage, an upcoming short film follows Ed back into the wild as he reflects on the endurance, discipline, and quiet strength embodied in cultural initiation journeys, while the REDMI Note 15 Series stands alongside him as a modern tool built to withstand the same elemental conditions, thanks to REDMI Titan Durability and reliable everyday performance. Stay tuned for the full story on Ed Stafford's official channels. Unveiling Mijia Smart Audio Glasses, merging style with convenience In addition to the launch of REDMI Note 15 Series, Xiaomi today added to its ecosystem lineup with its latest audio glasses, Mijia Smart Audio Glasses. Blending timeless eyewear design with open-ear audio technology, these glasses house a speaker system and 4 built-in microphones. This enables users to stay aware of their surroundings while enjoying crystal-clear audio with 4.5m/s wind noise reduction,²⁴ making the glasses ideal for city walks or outdoor travel. Moreover, for those more discreet meetings or calls, a new privacy mode²⁵ has been introduced, leveraging a customized algorithm to ensure clear audio, while significantly reducing sound leakage. Available in three classic options, namely Titanium, Pilot-Style, and Browline,²⁶ Mijia Smart Audio Glasses combine convenience and endurance in a stylish frame. Although all lenses can be replaced with prescription ones if needed, both Browline and Titanium²⁶ come with up to 25% blue light protection lenses.²⁴ In comparison, Pilot-Style features UV400-protection sunglasses with an up to 99.99% blocking rate of ultraviolet light.²⁷ Each style is slim and lightweight, particularly the Titanium model,²⁶ which is equipped with ultra-light 27.6g²⁸ frames. For those seeking to mix and match, Browline and Pilot-Style include a quick-release mechanism for effortless style changes.²⁶ Not only do the glasses offer ultimate convenience, but they also provide lasting durability. Reinforcement by a piano-wire hinge capable of withstanding up to 15,000 flexes,²⁴ and an IP54 dust and splash resistance certification²⁹ help to ensure protection against a wide range of conditions, from humidity to light rain. Inside the glasses' sleek silhouette lie a pair of compact 114mAh custom non-coaxial steel-cased batteries. By placing these batteries towards the ends of the temples, a down-to-5mm profile³⁰ is achieved near the frames, alleviating pressure on the ears and ensuring absolute comfort throughout the day. With fast charging, a brief 10-minute top-up provides around 4 hours of playback,²⁴ while a full charge from 0 to 100% takes roughly one hour,²⁴ keeping the glasses ready whenever needed. 100% charge enables up to 13 hours of continuous music playback.³¹ With this generation of smart audio glasses comes the Xiaomi Glasses app, which offers greater customization, more features, and even more control. Audio and other functions are primarily controlled via a touch panel on the temples of the glasses. Within the app, users can customize gesture controls to suit their preferences. For example, a long press on the glasses' temple can be set to activate the smartphone's voice assistant,³² enabling quick, hands-free responses to messages, calls, and more. The app can also help locate misplaced glasses. Furthermore, a wide range of recording functionality is available, including the ability to record audio, media files, and face-to-face conversations.³³ An LED indicator automatically lights up on the glasses' temple during recordings to ensure privacy. Moreover, users can seamlessly switch between audio playback on a smartphone and a laptop, thanks to dual-device connectivity support in the app. Combining stylish design, convenience, and clear audio, Mijia Smart Audio Glasses bring a new perspective to audio entertainment, phone calls, and everyday life. REDMI Buds 8 Lite, where practicality meets value Also launched in global markets to extend Xiaomi's wide ranging AIoT portfolio were the company's latest entry-level earbuds, REDMI Buds 8 Lite. Offered in Black,²⁶ White²⁶ or Blue,²⁶ REDMI Buds 8 Lite are built for those who seek practicality and ease of use with fast charging, all encased in a strong exterior design. At the core of these is a large 12.4mm titanium-diaphragm driver, bringing sound clarity combined with rich detail. Through a Bluetooth® 5.4 connection, they support both AAC and SBC audio codecs, delivering clear, high-quality audio across a range of devices. Alongside Transparency mode for maintaining awareness of surroundings, the buds feature up to 42dB wide frequency hybrid active noise cancellation (ANC).³⁴ Using a combination of talk and feedback microphones, ANC mode effectively detects and suppresses a broad range of low-frequency ambient noise. For outdoor calls, dual-mic AI environmental noise cancellation (ENC) comes into play, leveraging the microphone array and AI algorithms to focus on the user's voice, even against up to 6m/s wind speeds.²⁴ Further echoing user preferences is the flexibility to select between 5 pre-installed EQ modes³⁵ to enhance bass, voice or treble, for example, and even to customize EQ tuning via Xiaomi Earbuds app. With practicality and convenience at the forefront, REDMI Buds 8 Lite can connect to two devices simultaneously, such as a phone and a laptop, and automatically switch between these based on the call source. Moreover, designed for fast-paced lifestyles, REDMI Buds 8 Lite let the user listen to up to 2 hours of music after just 10 minutes³⁶ connected to a charger. Not only is fast charging offered, but REDMI Buds 8 Lite also provide long-lasting battery life, specifically up to 36 hours with the charging case.³⁷ Blending fast charging, classic design and convenient connectivity, REDMI Buds 8 Lite are a practical option for those seeking a value-for-money audio device for everyday use. headings: Refined Elegance in an Ultra-Slim Form
Flagship Experiences in Every Aspect
Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica: A Tribute to Masterful Image Creators
Xiaomi Watch 5 Series: Dual Sapphire Design Meets Advanced Gesture Control
Xiaomi Buds 6: Lighter Fit, Lossless Audio, and Smarter AI Features
text: [Beijing, China, December 25, 2025] - Xiaomi today officially unveiled Xiaomi 17 Ultra on its new product launch event held in Beijing, alongside wearable offerings such as Xiaomi Watch 5 Series and Xiaomi Buds 6. The launch event also introduced a series of smart home appliances such as Xiaomi Smart Home Screen 11, Mijia Diffused Ceiling Light, and Mijia Central Air Conditioner Dual Fan Pro. At the launch event, Xiaomi also announced the upgrade of the Global Imaging Strategic Cooperation between Xiaomi and Leica. Building upon the highly productive "Joint R&D" foundation, the two parties are introducing a new "Strategic Co-creation Model", with Xiaomi 17 Ultra being the first product born from this new collaborative framework. The "Strategic Co-creation Model" is the result of a close and multi-level collaboration, aiming to break conventional thinking and application limitations in mobile imaging by engaging in deep co-creation from the product's inception. This approach integrates Leica's century-old expertise in professional optics, aesthetic philosophy, and interaction principles from camera manufacturing to thoroughly reinvent the mobile imaging experience. Refined Elegance in an Ultra-Slim Form Xiaomi 17 Ultra is the first model in the Ultra line to feature a flat display, while continuing the overall design language of Xiaomi 17 Series. The ultra-thin bezel display and clean, linear form give the device a more streamlined appearance. With a thickness of 8.29mm, it is the thinnest Ultra model Xiaomi has released to date. Design refinements, including a micro-curved aluminum alloy frame, greater body curves, a reduced camera deco diameter, and a higher camera module placement, all contribute to improved ergonomics and a more balanced in-hand feel. Xiaomi 17 Ultra is available in four color options, including White, Black, Purple, and Green. For photography enthusiasts, Xiaomi introduces two updated sets of photography kits. Both feature a redesigned ergonomic form factor for improved handling and now support magnetic attachment. For daily usage, Xiaomi also launches an ultra-thin composite fiber case, designed to preserve a case-less feel. Setting New Standards in Mobile Optical Performance Xiaomi 17 Ultra is equipped with a triple-camera system consisting of a 14mm ultra-wide lens, a 23mm Leica 1-inch ultra dynamic camera, and a Leica 200MP 75-100mm optical zoom telephoto camera, designed to cover a wide range of shooting scenarios, including landscape, portrait, and street photography. Improvements in optical design and image processing enable cleaner and more accurate night photography, supporting more consistent results in low-light environments. The Leica 1-inch ultra dynamic camera is built on a Light Fusion 1050L sensor that incorporates LOFIC HDR technology, delivering a full well capacity 6.3× greater than the previous generation 1-inch sensor. This allows for improved highlight control and shadow detail in high-contrast scenes, including backlit and night environments. The Leica 200MP 75-100mm telephoto camera adopts three precisely matched lens groups and a prism, addressing traditional limitations in mid-to-long focal length image quality. Its second and third lens groups can move independently to adjust focal length and focus, enabling optical zoom across the 75-100mm equivalent range. Throughout this range, Xiaomi 17 Ultra fully utilizes its 1/1.4" large telephoto sensor and supports native 200MP image quality without digital cropping. This telephoto features a Leica APO optical lens design, using 3 custom glass material lenses to reduce chromatic aberration at the hardware level. This design ensures that all colors converge at the same point of focus, eliminating color fringing and delivering sharper, more accurate images. The lens significantly reduces purple and green fringing, even in high-contrast telephoto images. The exceptional optical quality of this lens also makes Xiaomi 17 Ultra the first Xiaomi flagship to receive Leica APO certification. Across the entire camera system, Xiaomi 17 Ultra features a Leica UltraPure optical design with G+P lens group, significantly minimizing linear arc ghosting and contributing to more stable and consistent image quality in challenging lighting conditions. Flagship Experiences in Every Aspect As Xiaomi's flagship model, Xiaomi 17 Ultra delivers premium and exceptional capabilities in multiple perspectives. In terms of performance, Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform features an improved CPU structure and an Adreno 840 with ultra-large graphics cache, ensuring smooth handling of complex tasks. Empowered by Xiaomi 3D Dual-Channel IceLoop System and a new capillary structure, Xiaomi 17 Ultra achieves a 50% improvement in thermal conductivity compared to the previous generation. Xiaomi 17 Ultra is equipped with a state-of-the-art display to ensure professional-level experience, featuring 120Hz LTPO refresh rate and 3500 nits peak brightness. Xiaomi HyperRGB significantly enhances screen power efficiency — with the clarity matching 2K displays with a power consumption lower than typical 1.5K displays, balancing display quality and battery life. Backed by the latest Xiaomi Shield Glass 3.0, the screen's drop resistance is up to 20 times that of ordinary strengthened glass. Featuring the latest Xiaomi Surge Battery, Xiaomi 17 Ultra perfectly balances a slim body with an ultra-large battery, with a massive 6800mAh battery packed into the thinnest Xiaomi Ultra body ever, without compromising 90W wired HyperCharge, 50W wireless HyperCharge, and 90W universal PD PPS charging. Xiaomi 17 Ultra further supports a total of 51 4G and 5G bands, covering roaming networks in up to 210 countries, ensuring seamless connectivity even during cross-border trips. The integration of UWB technology enables the device the function of a digital car key, as it could automatically unlock the car as people approach, and lock when they leave. It's currently compatible with Xiaomi YU7, as well as certain models from XPeng, allowing more car owners to enjoy a seamless experience. For more solid sound performance, Xiaomi 17 Ultra applies upgraded dual stereo speakers with brand-new AI noise reduction to deliver excellent noise suppression and crystal quality for two-way calls. Additionally, IP66, IP68, and IP69 certification ensures adequate water and dust resistance, allowing worry-free usage under complex environments. Xiaomi 17 Ultra comes pre-installed with Xiaomi HyperOS 3, elevating cross-ecosystem connectivity to new heights. It supports iPhone Home screen+ and comprehensive support across Apple devices, delivering a consistent mirroring experience. If you are a dual-Xiaomi phone user, the "two-in-one" connectivity offers more flexibility — supporting two-way Mirror Desktop, enabling mutual mirroring and control between two devices. Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica: A Tribute to Masterful Image Creators As the inaugural flagship of Xiaomi and Leica's upgraded strategic partnership, Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica transcends a single product. It stands as the realized expression of the Strategic Co-creation Model, uniting concept, design, and technology through deep, end-to-end collaboration. Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica was designed with direct involvement from the original Leica team, and inspired by the classic Leica M-series cameras. The back panel features a dual-tone design, where the textured leather complements a matte finish. The meticulously knurled middle frame, engraved with "LEICA CAMERA GERMANY," provides an exceptional anti-slip grip. For the first time, the prestigious Leica red dot badge graces the body, embodying the most iconic imaging design as well as certifying its imaging prowess. The exclusive Leica Camera Ring inherits the classic operational logic of cameras and reimagines in a new form for the smartphone, with the embedded 20 high-strength ball bearings adding an extra smooth tactile feel. It all fosters an immersive, intuitive interaction on focus, allowing the capture of every extraordinary moment in a state of creative flow. An internal optical displacement sensor detects movement as minute as 0.03mm, enabling precise focus adjustment with the ring. A dedicated sealing design ensures the device maintains its IP66 / IP68 / IP69 dust and water resistance ratings. Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica features the exclusive Leica Essential mode, which uses innovative technical approaches to recreate the legendary image qualities of two iconic Leica cameras within a phone. For the Leica M9 style, Xiaomi trained a "RAW-to-RGB" Style Transfer model based on hundreds of thousands of photos captured by actual Leica M9 cameras. The Leica M3 style digitally models the color response, tonality, and grain of Leica MONOPAN 50 film, producing authentic black-and-white film-like images beyond what ordinary filters can achieve. Furthermore, Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica introduces the mobile industry's first CAI Photo Authenticity Protection technology, which is realized by a digital signature to every photo through a dedicated security chip, ensuring its real origin instead of an AI-generated one. Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica is also exclusively equipped with a dual-satellite system, supporting both Tiantong and Beidou networks. When under weak cellular signals or even in remote wilderness, the system automatically prompts users with a pop-up, allowing one-tap access to the satellite interface for easy messaging and calling. Pricing & Availability Xiaomi 17 Ultra: 12GB+512GB - RMB 6999 yuan, 16GB+512GB - RMB 7499 yuan, 16GB+1TB - RMB 8499 yuan Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica: 16GB+512GB - RMB 7999 yuan, 16GB+1TB - RMB 8999 yuan Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Xiaomi 17 Ultra by Leica will go on sale on Mi.com , Xiaomi Store, and other official channels at 10AM on December 27th, 2025. Xiaomi Watch 5 Series: Dual Sapphire Design Meets Advanced Gesture Control Aside from Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Xiaomi also unveiled Xiaomi Watch 5 Series at the launch event, introducing a new flagship smartwatch with significant upgrades in design, health and fitness management, and smart performance. Featuring a 47mm case, Xiaomi Watch 5 is protected by sapphire glasses on both the front and back, paired with a unibody 316L stainless steel frame for a premium yet durable finish. It is equipped with a 1.54-inch AMOLED ultra-large display offering a 78.28% screen-to-body ratio and up to 1,500 nits peak brightness, ensuring excellent readability in bright outdoor conditions. Along with the debut of Xiaomi Watch 5 Series also comes a 3D-printed titanium strap with a weight of just 43g, which is about 50% lighter than that of traditional stainless steel. Under the hood, Xiaomi Watch 5 Series features a rare dual-chip architecture, combining a 4nm Snapdragon® W5 platform with a 6nm BES2800 low-power chip to balance performance and energy efficiency. Powered by a 930mAh battery, the watch delivers up to 6 days in Performance Mode or 18 days in Power Saving Mode. Another key highlight is the newly introduced EMG sensor, working alongside PPG and inertial acceleration sensors to enable Xiaomi's most precise gesture control to date, supporting seven gestures and cross-device interactions. Health and fitness capabilities include ECG analysis, 150+ sports modes, 3D animated workout guidance, and round-the-clock health monitoring. Xiaomi Watch 5 starts at RMB 1999 yuan, while Xiaomi Watch 5 eSIM is priced at RMB 2299 yuan. Xiaomi Buds 6: Lighter Fit, Lossless Audio, and Smarter AI Features Xiaomi also introduced Xiaomi Buds 6, a new generation of premium semi-in-ear wireless earbuds designed to deliver enhanced comfort and upgraded audio performance. Each earbud weighs just 4.4g, with ergonomic refinements on 11.3% reduced nozzle thickness, 12% narrowed stem connection, and 8.8% increased contact area, together improving stability for long listening sessions. Xiaomi Buds 6 is available in four color options—Black, White, Titanium Gold, and Nebula Purple — strengthening their appeal as both a digital gadget and a chic accessory. For improved sound performance, Xiaomi Buds 6 features a custom triple-magnet gold-plated acoustic driver with an ultra-wide 16Hz–40kHz frequency response and 7% increased driving force, paired with an 11mm dynamic driver and 0.5mm large-amplitude design for deeper bass and clearer highs. Built on Qualcomm audio platform, the earbuds support end-to-end lossless audio transmission with bitrates up to 2.1Mbps, along with multiple Harman-tuned sound profiles, customizable EQ, and adaptive audio. A triple-microphone system with AI wind noise reduction ensures clear calls even at wind speeds up to 12m/s. Additional features include Independent Recording 2.0, real-time interpretation, face-to-face translation, and compatibility with Apple's Find My network, marking a significant step forward in cross-platform integration. Available in four variants, including Black, Purple, Gold, and White, Xiaomi Buds 6 starts at RMB 699 yuan. text: Quarterly Revenue Hits RMB113.1 Billion, Topping RMB100 Billion for 4th Straight Quarter; Xiaomi Smart EV Business Achieves Positive Quarterly Income from Operations for the First Time Beijing, Hong Kong, November 18, 2025 — Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”; stock code:1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things (“IoT”) platform at its core, announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months ended September 30, 2025 (“2025 Q3” or “the Period”). The Group's third quarter performance continued its strong growth momentum. Total revenue for the third quarter reached RMB113.1 billion, representing an increase of 22.3% year-over-year, marking the fourth consecutive quarter that revenue has surpassed RMB100 billion. Adjusted net profit reached RMB11.3 billion, surging 80.9% year-over-year, significantly beating market expectations and hitting a record high. Total revenue for the first three quarters of this year reached RMB340.4 billion, approaching last year's full-year level, and adjusted net profit reached RMB32.8 billion, already exceeding last year's total. Guided by the “Human × Car × Home” corporate strategy, all business segments of the Group demonstrated strong growth resilience. Among them, the smart Electric Vehicle (“EV”), AI and other new initiatives segment achieved a historic breakthrough in the third quarter, recording positive income from operations for the first time. Revenue from this segment was RMB29.0 billion, surging over 199% year-over-year. Revenue from the smartphone business reached RMB46.0 billion, with global shipments maintaining a top-three global ranking for the 21st consecutive quarter. Revenue from the IoT and lifestyle products segment was RMB27.6 billion, and the number of connected IoT devices on Xiaomi’s AIoT platform exceeded 1.0 billion. Internet services revenue was RMB9.4 billion, up 10.8% year-over-year, reaching a record high. The robust performance of all business segments fully demonstrates the Group's excellent execution capabilities. Xiaomi’s premiumization across all product categories is accelerating. Notably, the Xiaomi YU7 , launched this year and positioned as a "high-performance luxury SUV," has been widely popular and has ranked No. 1 in sales volume among mid-to-large SUVs for three consecutive months. In October, it further became the best-selling SUV across all categories in the Chinese Mainland. Xiaomi’s premium flagship smartphone, the Xiaomi 17 , also garnered significant attention. During the Double 11 period, the Xiaomi 17 Pro Max secured dual championships in sales volume and sales revenue for domestic smartphones priced above RMB6,000 across all e-commerce platforms in the Chinese Mainland, becoming a blockbuster product in the premium market. Xiaomi Smart EV Business Achieves Positive Quarterly Income from Operations for the First Time with Quarterly Deliveries Topping 100,000 Units Xiaomi’s smart EV, AI, and other new initiatives segment maintained rapid growth, with revenue reaching RMB29.0 billion in the third quarter. The business posted its first-ever positive income from operations of RMB0.7 billion, signaling a new phase of healthy and sustainable development. In the third quarter, Xiaomi smart EV deliveries continued to climb, with quarterly deliveries surpassing 100,000 vehicles, reaching a record high of 108,796 vehicles. In the first three quarters of this year, cumulative Xiaomi smart EV deliveries exceeded 260,000 vehicles. The Group continued to expand its sales and service network. As of September 30, 2025, Xiaomi opened 402 smart EV sales centers across 119 cities in the Chinese Mainland. Xiaomi’s Smartphone Business Achieves Steady Progress, Premium Smartphone Market Share in the Chinese Mainland Rises by 5.6 Percentage Points In the third quarter, Xiaomi’s smartphone business maintained steady performance, with revenue reaching RMB46.0 billion. Global smartphone shipments totaled 43.3 million units, achieving year-over-year growth for 9 consecutive quarters. According to Omdia data, Xiaomi’s global market share by smartphone shipments reached 13.6% in the third quarter of 2025, securing a top-three global ranking for the 21st consecutive quarter. Xiaomi smartphones ranked among the top three in 57 countries and regions globally. In the Chinese Mainland, Xiaomi ranked No.2 in terms of smartphone units sold, with a market share of 16.7%, ranking among the top two for 6 consecutive quarters. The Group's premiumization strategy achieved significant breakthroughs. According to third-party data, in the Chinese Mainland, Xiaomi's market share in smartphone sales within the RMB4,000-6,000 price segment reached 18.9%, an increase of 5.6 percentage points year-over-year. Xiaomi's competitiveness in the premium smartphone market significantly strengthened. The premium flagship Xiaomi 17 Series , launched in September, performed brilliantly, with first-month sales increasing by approximately 30% compared to the Xiaomi 15 Series year-over-year. Among these, the Xiaomi 17 Pro and Xiaomi 17 Pro Max models accounted for over 80% of sales, further optimizing the product structure. Number of Connected IoT devices on Xiaomi’s AIoT Platform Exceeds 1 Billion; First Smart Home Appliance Factory Officially Commences Operation The Group’s IoT and lifestyle products business achieved steady growth, with revenue reaching RMB27.6 billion in the third quarter, up 5.6% year-over-year; gross profit margin increased by 3.2 percentage points year-over-year to 23.9%. In October this year, the first Xiaomi Smart Home Appliance Factory officially commenced operation, signifying the Group's establishment of a complete industry chain covering design, R&D, manufacturing, and verification for its large home appliances business. The factory has a designed peak annual production capacity of 7 million air conditioners and will fully support the Group's premium home appliances business. During the period, Xiaomi continued to enrich its tablet product lineup. According to Omdia data, Xiaomi tablet products ranked among the top five in global shipments and among the top three in Chinese Mainland’s shipments. Xiaomi's wearable band devices maintained a leading position, with shipments ranking No. 1 globally and No. 2 in the Chinese Mainland. TWS earbud shipments ranked No. 2 globally and No. 1 in the Chinese Mainland. As of September 30, 2025, the number of connected IoT devices (excluding smartphones, tablets and laptops) on its AIoT platform increased to 1,035.5 million, up 20.2% year-over-year; the number of users with five or more devices connected to its AIoT platform (excluding smartphones, tablets and laptops) reached 21.6 million, up 26.1% year-over-year. In September 2025, the MAU of its Xiaomi Home App grew to 114.6 million, up 14.4% year-over-year. Internet Services Revenue Hits Record High with Global MAU Exceeds 740 Million The internet services business maintained steady performance, with revenue reaching RMB9.4 billion in the third quarter, up 10.8% year-over-year. The segment’s gross profit margin remained at a high level of 76.9%. Xiaomi’s overseas internet services revenue reached RMB3.3 billion, up 19.1% year-over-year. As the user base for internet services continued to expand, both MAU globally and in the Chinese Mainland reached new record highs. In September 2025, global MAU reached 741.7 million, an 8.2% increase year-over-year. MAU in the Chinese Mainland reached 187.3 million, up 11.6% year-over-year. Doubles Down on Foundational Core Technologies with Quarterly R&D investment Surges to All-Time High of RMB9.1 Billion Xiaomi continued to significantly increase its R&D investment in foundational core technologies. R&D expenses for the third quarter reached RMB9.1 billion, a year-over-year increase of 52.1%, setting a new record high. Total R&D expenses for the first three quarters reached RMB23.5 billion and the Group anticipates its total R&D investment for 2025 will exceed RMB30.0 billion. As of September 30, 2025, Xiaomi’s total R&D personnel reached a record high of 24,871. Xiaomi has achieved a significant breakthrough in the field of AI large models. In September, it unveiled Xiaomi-MiMo-Audio, an open-source large voice model, establishing its holistic strategic ecosystem spanning the core modalities of foundation models. In November, Xiaomi unveiled its futuristic smart home solutions, Xiaomi Miloco, marking an industry-first effort to explore smart home living powered by large-model technologies and reshape the experience of smart home living interaction. Meanwhile, Xiaomi officially launched its new generation operating system, Xiaomi HyperOS 3, achieving comprehensive upgrades in fundamental experience, functionality, and AI capabilities. The new OS provides enhanced technological support for the company's premium smartphones, EVs, and ecosystem products. The launch of its Smart Home Appliance Factory completes Xiaomi’s smart manufacturing trifecta, bolstering its production capabilities across smartphones, smart EVs, and smart home appliances and cementing its leadership in the sector. text: Beijing, CHINA, September 25, 2025 – Xiaomi Auto today announced the launch of the Xiaomi Customization Service, starting with the Xiaomi YU7 Max and Xiaomi SU7 Ultra. Building on the strong market reception of Xiaomi YU7, acclaimed as a premium high-performance SUV that combines sophisticated design with advanced intelligence, this new program offers an extensive range of personalized options. The inaugural collection features 26 exclusive selections, including advanced paint finishes, curated interior themes, unique decorative components, and more. Each option is meticulously engineered, providing discerning customers with a deeply personalized and high-quality ownership experience. Democratizing Luxury: Curated Experiences with Exceptional Value While efficiency remains paramount in modern manufacturing, true customization demands a different approach, one centered on artisanal craftsmanship and meticulous attention to detail. Confronting the inherent challenges of low-volume, high-complexity production, Xiaomi has leveraged its expertise in supply chain integration and smart manufacturing to make personalized luxury accessible. The core mission of Xiaomi Customization Services is not merely to offer an extensive menu of options, but to deliver a curated, high-quality, and personalized experience typically offered by ultra-luxury cars. By providing exceptional value without compromise, Xiaomi Auto empowers discerning customers to express their individuality, transforming their vehicle into an authentic reflection of personal taste. Extensive Personalization: A Portfolio of 26 Meticulous Choices The initial phase of Xiaomi Customization Services combines technical innovation with meticulous detail across a spectrum of 26 choices. These options facilitate extensive customization, spanning significant elements such as vehicle paint and refined touches like embroidery, collectively engineered to meet the sophisticated aesthetic demands of users. Artisan-Grade Paints: Unmatched Depth and Manual Craftsmanship Xiaomi Auto offers five initial premium paint options, which are defined by complex application techniques and unique effects. Amethyst Purple: This flagship color achieves an exceptional mirror-like finish, renowned for its depth and clarity. The development process required nearly 50 hours of meticulous manual spraying and polishing across five distinct stages to create a surface virtually free of orange-peel effect. The finish incorporates a double-layer clear coat applied through a 4C3B process (four coats, three bakes), resulting in a 31% thicker paint film compared to standard Xiaomi production models. This enhanced thickness creates profound visual depth, where perfect surface reflections merge with internal light refraction, resulting in a truly three-dimensional, jewel-like appearance. Buttercup Yellow: This high-saturation sports car color captures the vitality of spring's first buds. Its unique vibrancy is achieved by layering white, lemon yellow, and green pigments within the color base. This sophisticated formulation creates a dynamic, multi-dimensional hue that offers subtle variations in different lighting conditions. Velocity Red: This finish is distinguished by its outer layer of tinted red clear coat, a feature that makes it four times more expensive than a standard clear coat. Unlike transparent variants, this nano-grade coating acts like a red filter, creating a purer and more intense hue that appears vividly bright under light and boosts color saturation by 20%. The base coat itself utilizes a pure red pigment for high color purity, enhanced with red aluminum and red pearl flakes so that even the sparkle reflects a true red tone. This multi-layered application creates a profound and variable red that captivates from every angle. Nightfall Rose: True to its name, this exceedingly rare color evokes a rose blossoming at the precise moment sunset meets dusk — elegant yet never overwhelming. It is an exceptionally uncommon finish in the automotive world, renowned for its unique color-flip effect. Under direct light, it shimmers with vibrant red particles, while in shaded areas, it reveals a cooler, muted rose-toned depth. Dawn Pink (Matte): This is a matte pink with a powerful presence. Its factory-applied matte finish is achieved by incorporating matting agents into the top clear coat, precisely controlling the gloss level. By minimizing light reflection, the matte layer eliminates the interference of light and shadow, ensuring every body line and contour appears sharply defined, much like a sculptural masterpiece. The color coat is further infused with Xiaomi's most exquisite pearlescent pigments, which contain mineral particles of varying hues and sizes to create a remarkably rich depth. Curated Interiors: A Symphony of Color, Material, and Craftsmanship With five striking exterior colors, each with a strong personality, the collection's bold spirit carries into the interior. Here, four industry-scarce color schemes break free from conventional black, white, and gray. Through expert design curation, these interiors harmonize contrasting hues to create unique atmospheres ranging from vibrant and energetic to elegant and retro, or from understated and profound to outright luxurious. Iris Blue & Onyx Black Dual-Tone: A primary highlight is this blue and black two-tone scheme. It features blue Alcantara®, challenging the traditional bias toward black. This treatment transforms Alcantara® from a "performance material" into an "artistic expression medium." The diverse color options of colored Alcantara® fully showcase an ultra-luxurious interior design. Polar Night Black & Neon Yellow Dual-Tone: This combination offers a sportier feel. The yellow brilliantly accents the black, which provides a subdued foundation for the vibrant color. For Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, two color combinations are offered: Polar Night Black & Glacier Blue Dual-Tone: This pairing emphasizes sophisticated design, evoking the moment a glacier meets the night sky, creating a restrained yet powerful presence. Moonshadow Gray & Charcoal Black & Yellow Accent Tri-Tone: This is a three-tone interior typically found only in ultra-luxury brands. Here, yellow represents courage and vitality, gray signifies stability and depth, and black adds a profound, low-key base. Together, they achieve a perfect balance of bold expression and refined restraint. Material Artistry: Innovative Surfaces and Exquisite Details Beyond its masterful use of color, Xiaomi Auto demonstrates profound thoughtfulness and creativity through its material artistry, exemplified by the exquisite Ash Wood Veneer. Inspired by the mountainscapes of traditional ink-wash paintings, each panel is crafted using a rotary-cutting technique that reveals unique, layered grain patterns, ensuring no two pieces are alike. This commitment extends to an advanced aluminum-dust inlay process. After painting, artisans manually rub micron-level dust into the wood's grooves using suede leather, then remove excess particles with an electrostatic brush. This technique accentuates the natural texture of the wood. The result is a trim of exceptional depth and sophistication, where light catching the metallic particles enhances its three-dimensional luxury and artistic presence. Following the 24K gold emblem, Xiaomi Auto again redefines material boundaries by uniting ceramic with gold to create its innovative ceramic emblem, available in 24K gold with black or white ceramic. Using precise magnetron sputtering plating technology, the gold application creates a luxurious visual experience reminiscent of "gold-inlaid-jade." Ceramic, a material signature of high-end watches and jewelry, represents an ultra-luxury symbol in automotive customization. By introducing it to automotive design, Xiaomi Auto creates enduring components with unique texture and timeless beauty. The collection also features a distinctive 24K gold & carbon fiber emblem, as well as a matte black emblem, each embodying sophisticated luxury. Sculpted Form and Function: Forged Wheel Artistry and Brake Accents Moving beyond the limitations of traditional cast wheels, Xiaomi Auto employs forging technology combined with milling to create the 21" 5 Double-Spoke Forged Wheels, available in four colors: Amber Gold, Lunar Silver, Mirror Silver, and Charcoal Black. The ultra-lightweight design features slender spokes, complex hollows, and sharp surface cuts. An extensive milling process, utilizing over 20 tools, requires nearly three times the machining time of mass-produced forged wheels, resulting in an immediately recognizable forged appearance. The Mirror Silver version undergoes precision diamond cutting for a flawless, sharp mirror finish. Each wheel serves not only as a performance component but as a work of art that combines mechanical aesthetics with aerodynamic efficiency, achieving a level of sophistication unattainable with cast or conventional forged wheels. They are complemented by calipers in three bold colors for both Xiaomi YU7 Max and Xiaomi SU7 Ultra : Red, Blue, and Green. The blue and green options feature high-saturation metallic paint with a shimmer effect, while the red caliper forgoes metallic shine to emphasize pure performance. All three colors create distinctive combinations with the body paint and wheels. Luxury Craftsmanship: Signature Finishes and Meticulous Detailing Drawing on techniques synonymous with high-end luxury artisanship, these meticulously crafted details elevate the entire ownership experience. The seats feature specialized quilting, a technique revered in ultra-luxury automotive interiors not only as a mark of craftsmanship but also as a narrative of sophistication. Inspired by the tailored quilting found in high-fashion garments, the design introduces a sense of dynamic elegance. The quilting ribbon innovatively employs an advanced seven-needle synchronous technique with a precise 1/8-inch stitch spacing for flawless uniformity. This dedication to precision extends to the custom door panel quilting, where exceptionally tight and parallel stitching demands extreme accuracy and expert hand-assembly for perfect alignment. Further enhancing the customization nature is the embroidered logo, crafted with 1862 stitches of soft thread to form a distinctive "M + ∞" motif, which symbolizes the promise of infinite possibilities. A custom plaque on the interior of the front door, exclusive to Xiaomi YU7 Max, is available in either matte or high-gloss finishes and crafted using a precision electroforming technique borrowed from the luxury goods industry. This method achieves micron-level accuracy in reproducing intricate textures, such as fingerprints or relief patterns, thereby enhancing the item's uniqueness and collectibility. Unlike standard plating, it produces a dense, pore-free surface that yields a mirror-like, high-gloss finish. Signature Experiences: Thoughtful Touches and Personalized Elements Extensive yet meticulous, Xiaomi Customization Services go far beyond the obvious to transform even nuanced, interactive elements into personalized expressions of luxury and exclusivity. Seatbelts: The seatbelts continue the interior’s bold color palette. Available in Iris Blue, Neon Yellow, and Glacier Blue, these special colors serve as vibrant accents that harmonize with the cabin’s design. Nebula-shaped Door Light: A starlight welcome light projects an intricate pattern inspired by the concept of a futuristic wormhole, turning each arrival and departure into a moment of ceremony and distinction. Bolt Livery: "Classic Bolt Livery", inherited from Xiaomi SU7 Ultra Prototype, is available in yellow, blue, or black. This decorative element carries symbolic weight, celebrating Xiaomi’s high-performance DNA while offering a distinctive visual statement. 1.7㎡ Carbon Fiber Roof (exclusive option for Xiaomi SU7 Ultra): The expansive 1.7㎡ carbon fiber roof appeals to driving enthusiasts, enhancing the vehicle’s overall sporty character. Front Compartment Plaque: A hidden surprise awaits under the front hood. Unlike production versions that display motor power, this plaque is engraved with a special message for cars that are part of the customization program, adding a layer of understated exclusivity. A Class Exclusive: A Dedicated Customization Service Center Xiaomi Auto has inaugurated an exclusive, over 400-square-meter customization center at its factory store. This dedicated facility, the first of its kind in the segment, offers customers a unique journey blending advanced technology with personalized luxury. The center features an integrated layout with display, production, and hands-on workshop zones. This environment is designed to rival the private ateliers of ultra-luxury brands, allowing for an immersive appreciation of details down to every thread and piece of leather. Customers can observe master craftsmen handcrafting seats through the process of upholstery and embroidery, providing a transparent view into the artisanal process. A DIY leather workshop further enhances the experience. Here, guests can create personalized items, such as keychains or card holders, from the same leather used in the vehicle's interior. The workshop is fully equipped with professional tools from heat-pressing to laser engraving. With guidance from expert artisans, visitors can imprint set designs or unleash their own creativity, resulting in a deeply engaging and memorable hands-on experience. Availability Xiaomi Customization Service is crafted for those who reject the ordinary and pursue aesthetic excellence, achieved through significant investment in rare materials. The development path encountered numerous challenges over the past two years. Each customized vehicle relies on small-batch production and extensive handcrafting by experienced artisans. text: [Beijing, China, September 25, 2025] - Xiaomi today held the 2025 Lei Jun Annual Speech and officially unveiled the new Xiaomi 17 series, along with Xiaomi Pad 8 series and a wave of new home appliances, at its annual flagship launch event held at the Beijing National Convention Center. In his sixth annual keynote titled "Change", Lei Jun highlighted Xiaomi's endeavors and resolution to advancing its "Human × Car × Home" smart ecosystem. The new Xiaomi 17 series comprises three models — Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Pro, and Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. A compact 6.3-inch flagship, Xiaomi 17 debuts the Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform, a 7000mAh Xiaomi Surge Battery, and a Leica Summilux imaging system. Additionally, The 6.3-inch Xiaomi 17 Pro and the 6.9-inch Xiaomi 17 Pro Max also feature a revolutionary Dynamic Back Display, next-generation LOFIC High Dynamic Technology, and a 5x optical zoom lens. Xiaomi 17: Five Major Upgrades for Comprehensive Advance Compact Craftsmanship, All-Round Quality Upgrade Xiaomi 17 combines a refined 6.3-inch compact design with flagship capabilities. It features a sleek body at just 191g weight and 8.06mm thick, offering an ergonomic grip. The specially-designed large rounded corner features a super-elliptical design for a smoother, more refined feel. The subtly adjusted 19.6:9 screen ratio, complemented by a minimalist hole-free top design, offers a harmonious visual and handling experience. The new lightweight camera design along with matte glass also creates a light, smooth feel of the back. Innovative M10 Display Panel and SuperRED Luminous Material Xiaomi 17 further narrows bezels to just 1.18mm by adopting LIPO display packaging technology. It boasts a peak brightness of 3500 nits, ensuring a clear and readable viewing experience even in bright outdoor environments. Xiaomi 17 also incorporates innovative M10 Display Panel and SuperRED luminous material, a technology breakthrough leading in more advanced luminous efficiency. Leica Summilux System for Excellent Imaging Strength Featuring the Leica Summilux imaging system, Xiaomi 17 main camera uses a 50MP Light Fusion 950 sensor with ƒ/1.67 aperture and OIS, and the telephoto lens adopts a Leica 60mm floating lens design with ƒ/2.0 aperture and 10cm close-focus capability, delivering clear and vivid images across various harsh lighting conditions. Moreover, the new Master Portrait Mode offers professional-grade imaging with natural skin tones and detailed hair rendering. 7000mAh Xiaomi Surge Battery, Large Capacity in Compact Size Xiaomi 17 features a massive 7000mAh battery, the largest capacity among current 6.3-inch flagship phone lineup, breaking the trade-off between compact size and large capacity. Stemed from major innovations in the latest-generation Xiaomi Surge Battery, the battery achieves an ultra-high energy density of 894Wh/L, along with extended battery lifespan and excellent low-temperature endurance. The charging experience has also significantly upgraded, supporting 100W wired fast charging, 50W wireless charging, and compatibility with the 100W PPS universal charging protocol. Comprehensive Flagship Experience, Industry-Leading Communication Capabilities Xiaomi 17's communication capability reaches an industry-leading performance with global network coverage in over 210 countries and regions, ensuring stable and smooth network experience across various environment. The USB 3.2 Gen 1 high-speed port facilitates easy transfer of large files, significantly improving work efficiency. Xiaomi 17 Pro Series: Redefining the Next Generation of Premium Smartphones Xiaomi 17 Pro series, comprising Xiaomi 17 Pro and Xiaomi 17 Pro Max, embody Xiaomi's most revolutionary innovations, featuring a seamless symphony of dual displays and intelligent connection, powered by Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform and an industry-leading powerhouse endurance. Xiaomi 17 Pro series enjoy a sleek 8mm-thick body design, and available in four colors — Black, White, Purple, and Green. Groundbreaking Dual-Screen Design Revolutionizes Mobile Interaction Xiaomi 17 Pro and Xiaomi 17 Pro Max introduce a revolutionary dual-screen design that blends sophisticated aesthetics with intuitive, intelligent functionality. The Dynamic Back Display enhances lifestyle and efficiency under various scenarios: customizable watch faces, AI wallpapers, virtual pets, dynamic information notifications, sticky notes, and so much more. In particular, users can enjoy the fun of creativity through various customized approaches — photos of pets or people can be processed into AI wallpapers and displayed on the back screen, supporting even dynamic wallpaper and with fun choices of portrait style. Moreover, the upgraded virtual pet feature introduces the third-generation pet — "Pangda" the panda, which could perform rich actions based on different scenarios and can also interact with user gestures. Meanwhile, the Dynamic Back Display provides a wide range of real-time notification, such as flight notifications, train ticket updates, takeaway delivery or ride-hailing status, music playback... the list goes on. The flexible pin feature allows users to pin schedules, QR codes, and even emojis on the secondary screen. Moreover, the back display supports both preview and selfie functions, allowing users to shoot selfies directly using the main cameras. It is also enhanced with advanced beauty algorithms and wide choices of filter for clearer, more natural-looking shots, along with unlimited imagination to shoot with the dual display. Close the main displays, this device will instantly transform into Handheld-Console Mode. It fits comfortably in one hand without missing any notifications shown on the back, and with the exclusive case connected via Bluetooth, it turns into a retro gaming console. Innovative Breakthrough in OLED Screen Technology Xiaomi 17 Pro series features the innovative M10 Display Panel and SuperRED luminous material, achieving excellent efficiency with ultra-high brightness and ultra-low power consumption. Additionally, Xiaomi 17 Pro Max exclusively adopts the independent pixel array technology, achieving sharper clarity while consuming less power than conventional 2K displays. Xiaomi 17 Pro Max is also equipped with Xiaomi Shield Glass 3.0, a super solid display glass to secure safe, sturdy use of the screen. Leica Summilux and LOFIC Technology to Achieve Pro-level Cinematic Imaging Xiaomi 17 Pro series features the Leica Summilux imaging system, meeting full creative camera needs. The main camera meets all-round optical capability upgrades, with an f/1.67 large aperture, a 1G+6P lens, and anti-glare lens coating, powered by Light Fusion 950L with a large 1/1.28-inch size sensor and next-generation LOFIC High Dynamic technology, achieving an ultra-high 16.5EV sensor dynamic range. Xiaomi 17 Pro debuts an inverted floating telephoto lens and supports 20cm telephoto macro shots. Xiaomi 17 Pro Max features a powerful 5x periscope telephoto lens with an expanded 1/2-inch sensor, an f/2.6 large aperture, and hardware-level HDR support. Its new light-gathering prism structure significantly enhances light capture, resulting in a 30% increase in light intake. Slim Design and Long Battery Life Showcasing Battery Tech Prowess Incorporating Xiaomi Surge Battery, Xiaomi 17 Pro series features a high 16% silicon content for high energy density, and L-shaped stacked battery maximizing internal space utilization to significantly boost energy density while maintaining a slim form factor. The breakthrough results in a 6300mAh battery for Xiaomi 17 Pro, while Xiaomi 17 Pro Max reaches 7500mAh. Xiaomi 17 Pro series models support 100W wired charging, 50W wireless charging, and the 100W PPS universal fast charging protocol, enabling convenient charging experience. Furthermore, with UWB-enabled smart car key functionality for keyless access and barrier-free interactions, the phone series redefines intelligent and integrated digital living with a previously unseen level of smart connectivity.
