text: [Barcelona, Spain, March 2, 2025] – Xiaomi today announced the release of its latest flagship smartphone lineup, Xiaomi 15 Series, at an exclusive launch event held in Barcelona, Spain. Positioned as the ultimate professional imagery flagship, Xiaomi 15 Series empowers users worldwide to capture stunning photos and videos in any scenario with Leica Summilux optical lens. Powered by the latest Xiaomi HyperOS 2, Xiaomi 15 Series introduces a comprehensive upgraded system experience, optimizing performance, connectivity, and AI capabilities for a seamless next-generation mobile experience. Alongside Xiaomi 15 Series, Xiaomi also unveiled other exciting products, including Xiaomi Pad 7, Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro, Xiaomi Buds 5 Pro, Xiaomi Buds 5 Pro (Wi-Fi), Xiaomi Watch S4, Xiaomi Electric Scooter 5 Max, and Xiaomi Smart Band 9 Pro in a new color variant. Xiaomi 15 Ultra: Pinnacle photography, incredible visuals Drawing inspiration from classic camera design, Xiaomi 15 Ultra combines supreme build quality with a sense of refined sophistication. Available in three captivating finishes - Black, White, and Silver Chrome - each variant exudes a unique blend of strength and elegance.³ The Silver Chrome model seamlessly blends aerospace-grade glass fiber and PU leather, further enhancing material strength. Its PU leather finish and retro image stitching further elevate the classic aesthetic of this iconic camera - a design that has defined a generation. Xiaomi 15 Ultra boasts a stunning WQHD+ 6.73-inch AMOLED display, delivering a crystal-clear resolution of 3200 x 1440 and an impressive pixel density of 522 ppi. With an impressive 3200 nits multi-scenario peak brightness, the display ensures crystal-clear visuals in any lighting condition, from bright sunlight to dim environments. The 1Hz Always-active Display keeps essential information like time, date, and notifications visible at a glance, combining convenience with efficiency. For enhanced security and convenience, Xiaomi 15 Ultra introduces an upgraded ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, which enables faster and more reliable unlocking, even with wet or dirty fingers, and performs exceptionally well in low-light conditions. Durability is at the core of the Xiaomi 15 Ultra's design. The device incorporates the advanced Xiaomi Guardian Structure, which includes the latest Xiaomi Shield Glass 2.0 for up to 16 times better drop resistance.² The high-strength CNC-crafted aluminum frame ensures a lightweight yet robust build, while Corning® Gorilla® Glass 7i protects the camera deco with improved resistance to drops and scratches. Designed for creative professionals who aspire to elevate their mobile photography, Xiaomi 15 Ultra is equipped with all focal lengths ranging from 14mm to 200mm optical-level zoom. Its pinnacle optical design features a main camera equipped with Leica Summilux lenses and an 8P aspherical high-transmittance lens, enhanced with dual anti-reflection (AR) coating to bring users a pure optical performance. At the heart of the Xiaomi 15 Ultra camera system is the industry-leading 23mm Leica 1-inch main camera, equipped with a 50MP Sony LYT-900 image sensor for exceptional clarity and detail. Paired with a Leica Summilux optical lens, it features a large ƒ/1.63 aperture, variable focal lengths of 23mm, 28mm, and 35mm, and an impressive 14EV high dynamic range. Together, these elements ensure stunning performance in low-light and night-time scenarios, capturing vivid and true-to-life images. For portrait and street photography, a 70mm Leica floating telephoto camera operates at the golden focal length, delivering natural and flattering shots. Its large sensor also excels in macro photography, allowing users to capture intricate details from as close as 10cm. An industry-leading 100mm Leica 200MP ultra telephoto camera makes it easy to capture shots of distant objects with a focal length of 100mm, extendable to 200mm using in-sensor zoom technology. The 1/1.4" large sensor, combined with ƒ/2.6 aperture, captures 136% more light than Xiaomi 14 Ultra.¹ Completing the quad camera system is the 14mm Leica ultra-wide camera, offering expansive perspectives for capturing breathtaking landscapes and group shots. Xiaomi 15 Ultra is set to push the boundaries of videography standards, allowing users to enjoy exceptional cinematic slow-motion videography with both main and periscope telephoto cameras capable of shooting 4K video at 120fps. Equipped with Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) and Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS), the main camera effectively minimizes shake, ensuring that videos maintain a professional quality, even in challenging environments. Beyond its impressive video capabilities, Xiaomi 15 Ultra supports Dolby Vision® video recording at 4K 60fps and 10-bit Log video recording across all focal lengths. As an Android's first ACES Product Partner, it further enhances professional videography, ensuring industry-grade color accuracy and cinematic-quality footage. A 4-Mic array offers immersive audio recording with omni-directional, forward, rear and trajectory recording modes available. These features provide users with the tools necessary for high-quality editing and color grading, facilitating a more creative approach to video production. Launched alongside Xiaomi 15 Ultra, the classically styled Xiaomi 15 Ultra Photography Kit Legend Edition is a treat for photography enthusiasts. Inspired by the timeless design of cameras, it features a signature red decorative ring, a custom-designed UI under camera's Fastshot mode, detachable thumb support and shutter buttons, a multifunctional 67mm filter adapter ring, and an integrated 2000mAh battery for extended usability. Xiaomi 15: All-round flagship excellence in compact form Crafted for optimal convenience and portability, Xiaomi 15 is available in four colors - Black, White, and Green pure color models, plus Liquid Silver, which boasts attractive shimmering curves from heat-bent glass.³ Featuring an integrated volcano-shaped deco, Xiaomi 15 has a fluid design that feels solid and durable, with a micro-curved aluminum frame offering up to 33% improvement in strength.¹ An impressive screen-to-body ratio of 94%,⁴ and ultra-thin bezels of only 1.38mm are made possible with the latest LIPO technology,¹ ensuring precise molding between body and frame. Xiaomi 15 boasts a versatile triple-camera system that delivers exceptional image quality. Spanning extended focal lengths from 14mm to 120mm, it provides remarkable clarity and versatility for every shot. The main camera of Xiaomi 15 features a Leica Summilux optical lens, incorporating a 7P aspherical high-transmittance with an anti-glare coating and a large ƒ/1.62 aperture for superior light capture and exceptional clarity in various lighting conditions. Equipped with the Light Fusion 900 high dynamic sensor, it delivers a professional-grade photography experience across three key focal lengths: 23mm, 28mm, and 35mm. For detailed telephoto shots, Xiaomi 15 features a Leica 60mm floating telephoto camera, utilizing a 50MP sensor, capable of capturing intricate details from afar and delivering stunning macro shots at distances as close as 10cm. Additionally, the Leica 14mm ultra-wide camera, with a 50MP resolution and a large ƒ/2.2 aperture, unlocks new creative possibilities, enabling breathtaking wide-angle photography. Designed for speed and precision, Fastshot mode enables ultra-fast street photography with an impressive capture speed of just 0.6 seconds across all focal lengths,¹ ensuring that every fleeting moment is preserved. Xiaomi Master Videography empowers users with studio-quality video capabilities, with the main camera supporting 8K recording at 30fps and Dolby Vision® video at 4K 60fps across all focal lengths. A 4-Mic array enhances the experience by delivering immersive, spatial audio recording for a truly cinematic touch. Xiaomi 15 incorporates a compact 6.36-inch CrystalRes AMOLED (2670 x 1200) display with a pixel density of 460 ppi. It boasts an impressive 3200 nits multi-scenario peak brightness that covers 25% APL (Average Picture Level) to deliver a clear, vivid viewing experience in the brightest of conditions. Leveraging a Xiaomi-custom M9 display panel, the screen gives a 10% reduction in power consumption,⁵ resulting in more colorful and more vibrant visuals, enabling users to enjoy content comfortably while enhancing overall efficiency. Additionally, Xiaomi 15 is TÜV Rheinland certified for Low Blue Light (Hardware Solution), Flicker-Free and Circadian Friendly, featuring DC dimming across all brightness levels to ensure a comfortable viewing experience even during extended use. Feel the full power of the latest high-performance hardware Xiaomi 15 Series enhances the mobile user experience by integrating a next-generation processor platform with advanced cooling technology and cutting-edge battery optimizations. Xiaomi 15 and Xiaomi 15 Ultra are both powered by the Snapdragon® 8 Elite Mobile Platform, delivering an impressive 45% CPU performance boost and a 52% reduction in power consumption,¹ along with a remarkable 44% GPU performance boost and a 46% power consumption decrease,¹ compared to the previous generations. Equipped with the Xiaomi IceLoop cooling system, both devices achieve an unmatched level of smoothness in challenging tasks such as video recording, computational photography, real-time AI, and intensive gaming. Based on an innovative wing structure design, the cooling array ensures improved contact with the frame, effectively reducing operating temperatures. In terms of battery and charging, both Xiaomi 15 and Xiaomi 15 Ultra utilize the Xiaomi Surge Battery Management System to ensure extended performance throughout the day and beyond.⁷ Xiaomi 15 Ultra features a 5410mAh (typ) Xiaomi Surge Battery with ultra-high energy density, thanks to a 10% silicon carbide (SiC) content level, offering a larger capacity within the same dimensions and weight. Xiaomi 15 Ultra supports HyperCharge at 90W, along with fast 80W wireless HyperCharge charging.⁷ Meanwhile, Xiaomi 15 is equipped with a 5240mAh (typ) Xiaomi Surge Battery, supporting 90W HyperCharge and 50W wireless HyperCharge.⁷ Xiaomi 15 Series utilizes the latest LPDDR5X system memory, with Xiaomi 15 featuring UFS 4.0 storage technology, while Xiaomi 15 Ultra is equipped with UFS 4.1 storage technology. Xiaomi 15 Ultra is available in 16GB+512GB and 16GB+1TB configurations.⁹ Xiaomi 15 in both 12GB+256GB and 12GB+512GB models.⁹ Augment your life with upgraded Xiaomi HyperOS 2 Xiaomi 15 Series is powered by the latest Xiaomi HyperOS 2, showcasing three key technological innovations: Xiaomi HyperCore, Xiaomi HyperConnect,¹⁵ and Xiaomi HyperAI.¹º These innovations give users an enhanced mobile experience in functionality, system fluidity, cross-platform connectivity, security, privacy, and access to next-generation AI interactions and AI-driven productivity tools. Xiaomi HyperAI enhances user productivity and creativity with a powerful suite of AI tools. This includes features such as AI Writing¹² and AI Speech Recognition¹², along with several other tools designed to boost efficiency. To help users unlock their full creative potential, AI Creativity Assistant offers next-generation photographic and videography tools.¹³ These tools include AI Image Enhancement, ¹⁴ AI Image Expansion, ¹⁴ AI Eraser Pro, ¹⁴ AI Reflection Removal, AI Magic Sky, and AI Film, enabling users to achieve professional-quality results swiftly and effortlessly. In collaboration between Google and Xiaomi, Google Gemini can now find and take actions across Xiaomi apps, ³º giving users direct access to Xiaomi Notes, Xiaomi Calendar and Xiaomi Clock in Gemini, for the first time. At its foundational core, Xiaomi HyperOS 2 features Xiaomi HyperCore technology, a self-developed technology platform that guarantees optimal system fluidity and performance, system-level application upgrades and more. ¹⁵ Boasting new and updated aesthetics, Xiaomi HyperCore boasts a new lock screen design with updated templates and styles that express cinematic elements from the film world. With new motion effects that take advantage of an improved graphics subsystem, an all-new home screen design gives users a more seamless, elegant experience. Xiaomi HyperConnect breaks down the barriers between devices, platforms, and ecosystems, including tablets and iOS/macOS platforms. ¹⁶ New features such as Cross-device Camera allow users to access another device's camera while retaining the exceptional image processing capability of Xiaomi 15 Series. Users can also use Combined Cameras to combine and display video feeds from multiple devices - an advantage when shooting live events, lectures, or tutorial videos. Xiaomi Pad 7 Series: Unleash AI-Powered Productivity on a Flagship Display Xiaomi also introduces Xiaomi Pad 7 Series, featuring Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro and Xiaomi Pad 7. These tablets redefine productivity and entertainment, catering to professionals and everyday users. Xiaomi Pad 7 Series is an AI-powered productivity tablet designed to empower users seeking efficient productivity and seamless multitasking. Both models share a striking 11.2-inch 3.2K crystal-clear display with a 3:2 aspect ratio,³² adaptive HDR, and TÜV Rheinland certifications for superior visual comfort. The display supports a refresh rate of up to 144Hz,²¹ ensuring smooth visuals for work and entertainment. With a high pixel density of 345 ppi, the display delivers razor-sharp text and vibrant images. Studio-grade color calibration ensures accurate and lifelike colors, while the wide color gamut supports 68 billion colors for enhanced realism. They're also lightweight, weighing in at just 500g and 6.18mm thin.¹ Quad speakers with Dolby Atmos® provide immersive audio, while Xiaomi HyperOS 2 takes productivity to the next level with Xiaomi HyperAI and Xiaomi HyperConnect.¹º Xiaomi HyperAI ¹º boosts productivity with intelligent tools like AI Writing¹² for text composition, AI Speech Recognition¹², and AI Art with Mi Canvas¹². Additionally, AI Calculator¹⁴ offers innovative problem-solving capabilities, leveraging AI to handle complex calculations easily. Empowered by Xiaomi HyperOS 2, Xiaomi HyperConnect offers a refreshed, intuitive experience, enabling effortless cross-device integration. Using NFC Sharing, you can easily access Xiaomi Share which allows instant file transfers and device pairing by simply tapping devices together, and Home screen+ 2.0 which lets you access up to 2 smartphone apps directly from Xiaomi Pad 7 Series.¹⁵ Combined cameras enhances presentations and creative workflows by allowing cameras of your smartphone and tablet to be activated simultaneously within an app.¹⁵ This functionality is perfect for delivering dynamic, multi-angle video content. Xiaomi Pad 7 Series also features workstation mode, transforming the tablet into a desktop-like interface, offering floating windows, adjustable app sizes, and effortless multitasking for professional-grade efficiency. Together, these features make Xiaomi Pad 7 Series a powerful tool for productivity and creativity. Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro takes performance to the next level with the Snapdragon® 8s Gen 3 Mobile Platform, delivering seamless multitasking and efficiency. Its 32MP AON front camera and 50MP rear camera enable professional-grade photography and videography. Unique to Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro, Wi-Fi 7 ensures lightning-fast connectivity,¹¹ and the side fingerprint sensor enhances security. The 8850mAh battery supports 67W HyperCharge,²² achieving a full charge in just 79 minutes.¹ Its sleek aluminum unibody design blends durability with sophistication, making it the ultimate choice for professionals. Additionally, Xiaomi Pad 7 is designed for those seeking a balance of work and play. It comes with 13MP rear camera for high-quality photos and 8MP front camera for clear video calls and selfies. Powered by the Snapdragon® 7+ Gen 3 Mobile Platform, it delivers reliable performance for multitasking and entertainment. Xiaomi Pad 7 features Wi-Fi 6E¹¹ for efficient connectivity and 45W turbo charging,²² ensuring a full charge in just over 103 minutes.¹ Both Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro and Xiaomi Pad 7 are complemented by a range of thoughtfully designed accessories that offer professionals and everyday users the tools to elevate their productivity and creativity.²³ Xiaomi Pad 7 / 7 Pro Focus Keyboard enhances usability with backlit keys, adjustable angles, and a comfortable typing experience. text: Xiaomi, a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform at its core, today announced five new products that expand its evolving AIoT and personal health device portfolio. These new additions include Redmi Buds 6, Redmi Buds 6 Pro, Redmi Watch 5, plus Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000 and Xiaomi 165W Power Bank 10000. Designed to enhance and improve how users live, work, and play, these new additions make combining a flagship audio experience with personal health regimes easier than ever. The latest Redmi Buds 6 and Redmi Buds 6 Pro make it easier to enjoy a rich, high-end audio experience with high-end features, including upgraded noise cancellation, multi-dimensional audio and head tracking, and more interactions. Users can pair this intelligent high-fidelity audio experience with the new Redmi Watch 5, an attractively built wearable that compliments your lifestyle with its ultra-thin bezel display, long battery life, and improved heart rate and sleep tracking support. The new Xiaomi Power Bank 10000 charging solutions have you covered during long workouts and trips on the road. Offering large-capacity batteries that deliver on every level in terms of fast charging, versatility, and ease of use, these new Xiaomi charging solutions ensure that all your electronic devices stay within distance. Redmi Buds 6: Immersive Audio Meets Style and Sophistication Redmi Buds 6 are designed to deliver superior audio performance and personalized immersion. Featuring advanced Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) with a depth of up to 49dB¹ and 2kHz bandwidth, they effectively reduce noise from light rain, typing, and traffic. The dual-driver system ensures a rich and dynamic sound, supported by multiple ANC modes and adaptive transparency settings that intelligently adjust to the environment. For clear communication, the dual-mic AI noise reduction minimizes background noise, even in winds up to 9m/s¹. Additionally, the built-in immersive sound with 360° audio effect places users at the heart of their viewing or listening experience. Available in Cloud White, Night Black, and Coral Green, Redmi Buds 6 gives you real-time, visible battery levels and delivers up to 10 hours² of playback on a single charge or up to 42 hours² with the case. Smart connection options let you share audio³ seamlessly or use the earbuds for hands-free photo-taking⁴ with customizable gestures. Redmi Buds 6 Pro: Welcome to Industry-leading Audio Redmi Buds 6 Pro brings an unmatched audio experience to discerning users on a budget and boasts industry-leading coaxial triple drivers that are Hi-Res Audio Wireless Certified⁵. PZT dual tweeters combine with an 11mm driver with a titanium diaphragm to deliver deeper bass and sharper highs. For an immersive listening experience, built-in dimensional audio⁵ offers adjustable modes, including head tracking, perfect for music, videos, gaming, and audiobooks. Flagship-grade 55dB⁶ Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) includes ultra-wide 4kHz coverage that effectively blocks mid-to-high frequency distractions. With an increased total ANC of up to 14.16%⁷ compared to previous generation products, the multi-level ANC ensures clarity in outdoor environments at all times. Available in three vibrant colors — Glacier White and Space Black — Redmi Buds 6 Pro are also available in Lavender Purple with excimer coating that ensures skin-friendly usage over long periods. Users can enjoy up to 9.5² hours of playback on a single charge or up to 36 hours² with the charging case, alongside intuitive touch controls for managing calls, audio playback, volume, and ANC modes. To further personalize the experience, the customizable equalization (EQ) feature offers four preset modes and one custom mode, allowing users to fine-tune sound to their preferences. Redmi Watch 5: Enjoy a Flagship-Level Smartwatch Experience Featuring the largest and brightest display ever on Redmi watch, Redmi Watch 5 gives users an incredible 2.07-inch AMOLED display that ensures visibility on the sunniest days. Its 1500 nits brightness, 60Hz refresh rate, and vibrant 324 ppi clarity provide a flagship-grade experience enhanced further with ultra-thin 2mm bezels and an impressive screen-to-body ratio of just 82%⁸. 24-day battery life ensures a reliable health monitoring experience that can be customized regarding watch strap options, with a premium aluminum alloy frame and updated crown optimized for comfort and fashion². Its built-in linear motor provides quiet, precise haptic feedback, while Bluetooth® phone call support and dual-mic noise reduction provide clear calls in noisy or windy outdoor environments⁹. Redmi Watch 5 features a new in-house designed heart rate algorithm that improves heart rate monitoring accuracy to give users all-day tracking for heart rate¹⁰, blood oxygen, and sleep quality¹¹. With more than 150 sports modes Redmi Watch 5 is the ultimate workout partner, featuring a built-in 5-system GNSS designed for precise outdoor activity tracking, while 5ATM water resistance¹² makes it ideal for aquatic sports enthusiasts¹². Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000: Compact, Versatile Charging on the Go The perfect charging companion for people on the move, Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000 delivers fast and convenient charging in a compact form that easily slips into your bag or pocket. Its built-in USB-C cable gives users easy access to a 10,000mAh¹³ capacity power cell capable of charging a compatible Xiaomi smartphone to 45% in just 30 minutes¹⁴. Hitting a sweet spot in size and power, Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000 weighs 210 grams, making it lightweight enough to hold with one hand, eliminating hand strain or discomfort during charging. Its additional USB-C port offers 33W¹⁵ charging with an additional USB-A port supporting dynamic power allocation of up to 22.5W¹⁶ per device, with triple device charging bolstered with the ability to simultaneously self-charge at 30W. Xiaomi 165W Power Bank 10000: Ultra-Fast Full Power Charging For users seeking the absolute pinnacle of portable device charging, Xiaomi developed Xiaomi 165W Power Bank 10000. Convenient, fast, and versatile, it features dual ports capable of delivering a combined output of up to 165W¹⁷. Suited for charging smartphones, tablets, and laptop PCs, it can simultaneously charge two devices at charging speeds of up to 120W¹⁷ and 45W¹⁸. Tech-savvy Xiaomi device users can look forward to using 120W¹⁷ charging to achieve a full charge in as little as 23 minutes¹⁹. Housed in a sleek design and weighing only 318 grams, Xiaomi 165W Power Bank 10000 also features a built-in USB-C charging cable, making it ideal for users on the road. It features a smart display with colored icons that convey real-time power levels at a glance. Adaptable and versatile, Xiaomi 165W Power Bank 10000 supports the latest charging protocols. It offers dual port charging of up to 110W¹⁸ (65W + 45W) for non-Xiaomi devices, plus 90W self-charging²⁰ to achieve a 75% charge in just 15 minutes and a full charge in only 35 minutes²¹. Price and Availability Redmi Buds 6, Redmi Buds 6 Pro, Redmi Watch 5, Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000, Xiaomi 165W Power Bank 10000 will be available through Xiaomi's official channels and authorized retailers²². headings: Redmi Note 14 Series Quick Specs
text: Beijing, CHINA, January 10, 2025 - Xiaomi Corporation ("Xiaomi" or the "Group"; stock code:1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things ("IoT") platform at its core, today announced the launch in international markets of Redmi Note 14 Series. This latest line-up includes five devices that take Redmi Note to the next level: Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G, Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G, Redmi Note 14 Pro, Redmi Note 14 5G, and Redmi Note 14. With a high-resolution AI camera system, all-star durability, and impressive experience, Redmi Note 14 Series comes with all-round upgrades to bring flagship-level features to a wider audience. Capture life's moments in extraordinary detail with powerful AI camera systems The camera system at the heart of Redmi Note 14 Series is crafted for flagship photography. Leading the way, the Pro variants feature a powerful 200MP pro-grade AI camera system with optical image stabilization (OIS), enabling users to capture incredible detail. Moreover, the advanced zoom options provide exceptional versatility—from capturing the smallest details with 2x and 4x optical-grade lossless zoom, to reaching distant subjects with up to 30x digital zoom on Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G and Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G, and unlocking new creative possibilities with 20x digital zoom on Redmi Note 14 Pro. Meanwhile, Redmi Note 14 and Redmi Note 14 5G are equipped with a 108MP AI camera system that delivers vibrant colors and sharp detail, making high-quality photography accessible at every price point across the series. To further elevate the photography experience, the Redmi Note 14 Series’ front cameras have been upgraded to at least 20MP. Redmi Note 14 Pro, in particular, stands out with its 32MP front camera. Thoughtfully designed with 0.8x wide-angle zoom across the entire series, the front cameras make it easier than ever to include everyone in a group selfie, capturing and preserving shared moments effortlessly. More than this, Redmi Note 14 Series is designed to offer a complete photography experience, blending cutting-edge performance with intuitive versatility. To this end, various creative features have been introduced, such as Dynamic shots, bringing each image to life with subtle movement, and Dual video on many of the models, which allows users to simultaneously record from both the front and rear cameras to capture multiple perspectives. Editing has also been transformed on the Pro models with advanced AI features, such as AI Image Expansion¹, which extends the background for a more immersive shot, and AI Erase Pro¹, which enables easy removal of unwanted objects without third-party apps. In addition to AI Erase, the base models also feature AI Sky to swap backgrounds easily. This seamless integration of AI tools² enhances photos' quality and streamlines the editing process, bringing professional-level results within reach. Tough and resilient, designed for everyday life Redmi Note 14 Series is built to meet the demands of everyday life with robust drop, splash, and scratch resistance. This begins with an All-Star Armor Structure consisting of helpful additions like a high-strength aluminum composite frame, energy-absorbing foam, and polymer buffering material, present in Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G and Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G for enhanced drop resistance. Meanwhile, the Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus® 2 display lends the Pro models an extra boost in scratch resistance. This is paired with either a Corning® Gorilla® Glass 7i or vegan leather battery cover on Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G for all-round assurance⁷. For the rest of the series, Corning® Gorilla® Glass 5 provides the display with solid protection, contributing to a strong and resilient design across the entire lineup. Beyond drop and scratch resistance, Redmi Note 14 Series is also designed to withstand the elements. With an IP68 rating⁴, Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G and Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G offer exceptional protection against dust and water, making them ideal for whatever the day brings—whether that is unexpected rain or a rugged adventure. Meanwhile, Redmi Note 14 Pro and Redmi Note 14 5G feature an IP64 rating⁵, defending against dust and splashes, and Redmi Note 14 offers an IP54 rating⁵ for splash and dust resistance. Moreover, the entire lineup has an optimized display to ensure increased responsiveness and accuracy to touch input, even in wet or oily conditions. Combined with these all-star durability features, Redmi Note 14 Series is ready to take on whatever life throws. Power through the day with seamless performance Redmi Note 14 Series offers robust performance and long-lasting battery life. Thanks to the advanced chipsets inside, these devices effortlessly handle multitasking, from video calls to gaming and everything in between. The highest-tier model, Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G, is equipped with the globally debuting, advanced 4nm Snapdragon® 7s Gen 3 processor, bringing speed and responsiveness. Meanwhile, its 5110mAh battery⁶ with 120W HyperCharge provides lasting power from start to finish. Designed to handle extreme conditions, Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G's high-density battery also functions in temperatures as low as -20°C, delivering a reliable experience even in sub-zero environments—perfect for users who need to stay connected whatever the weather. Meanwhile, Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G and other models feature the MediaTek Dimensity 7300-Ultra and MediaTek Helio G100-Ultra chipsets, offering a smooth experience for gaming, streaming, and quick app switching. Paired with large batteries from 5110mAh to 5500mAh⁶, these devices keep you moving through the day without interruptions, whether you're finishing a work project or unwinding with your favorite show. Beyond sheer battery capacity, all models feature long-cycle batteries designed for long-term reliability, retaining up to 80% of their capacity after 1,600 charge cycles³. To further enhance battery longevity, Smart Charging, and big-data-based aging prediction work together, optimizing the charging process and proactively maintaining battery health for consistent performance. Additionally, all Pro models include a quick turn-on function, offering the convenience of powering up within seconds after the battery is drained³. Taking performance to the next level, Google Gemini¹ ⁷ is available across the series, enhancing the experience with personalized interactions. Furthermore, Circle to Search with Google², featured on Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G and Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G, allows users to search for information around them more quickly, making everyday tasks simpler and faster. In a world where staying connected is more important than ever, Redmi Note 14 Series is designed to balance performance and efficiency, offering all-day usage with the convenience of fast charging when needed most. Immersive viewing with an advanced eye-care display With a vibrant 120Hz eye-care display, Redmi Note 14 Series offers an immersive experience via smooth transitions that bring content to life, whether scrolling through social media, watching videos, or gaming. Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G and Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G elevate the experience even further, offering sharp 1.5K resolution that makes every detail pop. As a result of eye-care technology, prolonged use is more comfortable. The display minimizes blue light exposure with TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light (Hardware Solution), Flicker Free, and Circadian Friendly certifications across all devices. This results in a more pleasant experience during late-night work or extended streaming sessions. The experience remains just as enjoyable when stepping outside, with the display on Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G and Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G featuring a peak brightness of 3000 nits, significantly higher than the previous generation. This allows content to remain clear even under strong outdoor light, providing a vibrant and immersive viewing experience, whether night or day. With Redmi Note 14 Series, Xiaomi delivers a remarkable blend of powerful performance, stunning photography, and robust durability, all designed to meet the needs of modern life. From the high-resolution camera systems with advanced AI tools, to the rugged dust and water-resistant design, powerful performance and long-lasting battery, Redmi Note 14 Series sets a new standard in its category by bringing premium features to a wider audience, offering exceptional value in every aspect. Price and availability⁹ Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G comes in Midnight Black, Lavender Purple, and Frost Blue,⁷ with three storage variants⁸. Suggested retail price starts from 449 USD . Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G is offered in Midnight Black, Lavender Purple, and Coral Green⁷, with three storage variants⁸. Suggested retail price starts from 399 USD . Redmi Note 14 Pro comes in Midnight Black, Aurora Purple, and Ocean Blue⁷, with four storage variants⁸. Suggested retail price starts from 299 USD . text: Record Results Mark New Milestone in Premiumization Strategy “Human x Car x Home” Smart Ecosystem Drives Growth Momentum Beijing, Hong Kong, November 18, 2024 — Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”; stock code:1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things (“IoT”) platform at its core, announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months ended September 30, 2024 (“2024 Q3” or “the Period”). The revenue for the Period reached a new record high, marking a third consecutive quarter of robust growth. In Q3 2024, revenue reached RMB92.5 billion, representing a year-over-year (“YoY") increase of 30.5%. Adjusted net profit reached RMB6.3 billion, maintaining historically high levels. The premiumization strategy made significant strides, with the overall gross profit margin at 20.4%, remaining elevated. Xiaomi’s three core businesses - smartphones, IoT and lifestyle products, and internet services - achieved revenues of RMB47.5 billion, RMB26.1 billion, and RMB8.5 billion, respectively. Revenue from the smart Electric Vehicle (“EV”) and other new initiatives business reached RMB9.7 billion, nearing the RMB10 billion milestone, with overall performance exceeding expectations. The growth underscores Xiaomi’s “Human x Car x Home” smart ecosystem as a new growth engine, driving the Group to achieve record results. In Q3, Xiaomi’s cash resources continue to exhibit an upward trend, reaching a new high of RMB151.6 billion as of September 30, 2024. During this year’s Double 11 shopping festival, Xiaomi’s omnichannel cumulative gross merchandise value (“GMV”) surpassed RMB31.9 billion, reaching a record high. As its business segments thrive, Xiaomi has strengthened its competitive edge, embarking on a new development stage. Xiaomi's smartphone market share in mainland China up for third consecutive quarter; while Xiaomi 15 Series sales top 1 million units Xiaomi’s global smartphone shipments reached 43.1 million units in Q3, up 3.1% YoY. According to Canalys, Xiaomi’s global smartphone shipments ranked among the top three smartphone brands globally for the 17th consecutive quarter, with a market share of 13.8%. In particular, Xiaomi’s smartphone shipment ranking in mainland China rose to No. 4, with its market share increasing by 1.2 percentage points YoY to 14.7%, marking three consecutive quarters of market share growth. In Q3, Xiaomi’s smartphone revenue reached RMB47.5 billion, an increase of 13.9% YoY. It continued to make significant progress in its smartphone premiumization strategy. According to third-party data, Xiaomi’s smartphones priced at RMB3,000 and above accounted for 20.1% of total smartphone shipments in mainland China, representing an increase of 7.9 percentage points YoY. By price segment, Xiaomi achieved YoY increases in market share across three smartphone price segments in mainland China in 2024 Q3. In the RMB3,000 - 4,000 segment, Xiaomi’s market share reached 18.1%, up 9.3 percentage points YoY. In the RMB4,000 - 5,000 segment, Xiaomi’s market share reached 22.6%, up 9.7 percentage points YoY. In the RMB5,000 - 6,000 segment, Xiaomi’s market share reached 6.9%, up 2.4 percentage points YoY. Xiaomi's premium smartphone lineup continues to exhibit robust growth, with the Xiaomi 15 Series achieved 1 million unit sales volume faster than the previous generation. Since its debut, the series has consistently been a bestseller, setting new records for initial sales of flagship smartphones. During the 2024 Double 11 shopping festival, it led both sales volume and revenue across mainstream e-commerce platforms in the RMB4,000 - 5,999 price segment. IoT business gross profit margin reaches a new high, with air conditioner and washing machine shipments growing by over 50% Xiaomi IoT and lifestyle products business maintained its strong growth momentum in Q3, with its revenue reaching RMB26.1 billion, up 26.3% YoY and gross profit margin reaching a record high of 20.8%, up by 2.9 percentage points YoY. Leveraging proprietary technology to develop innovative products, Xiaomi’s IoT ecosystem achieved growth in both volume and value. Shipments of both refrigerators and washing machines reached record highs, with air conditioner shipments exceeding 1.7 million units, up over 55% YoY; refrigerator shipments surpassed 810,000 units, up over 20% YoY; and washing machine shipments exceeded 480,000 units, up over 50% YoY. According to Canalys, Xiaomi's global tablet shipment continued to achieve rapid growth, maintaining No. 5 ranking globally and No. 3 ranking in mainland China. The shipment of Xiaomi’s global wearable products increased by over 50% YoY, and both its smart watch and TWS earbuds shipments reached record highs. Internet services revenue hits new high with gross margin remaining elevated During the Period, the internet services business continued its rapid growth, with revenue increasing by 9.1% YoY to RMB8.5 billion, reaching a record high. The gross profit margin of the internet services reached 77.5%, an increase of 3.1 percentage points YoY. Xiaomi’s internet user base continued to expand. The MAU globally and in mainland China both hit record highs. In September 2024, the global MAU reached 685.8 million, an increase of 10.1% YoY, while the MAU in mainland China reached 167.9 million, up 10.6% YoY. Xiaomi SU7 achieved delivery target of 100,000 vehicles with smart EV revenue nears RMB10 billion Xiaomi Auto has once again achieved growth beyond expectations. In 2024 Q3, revenue from smart EV and other new initiatives business reached RMB9.7 billion, approaching the RMB10 billion milestone, with the business gross profit margin rising to 17.1%. Xiaomi continued to ramp up production, with the deliveries of the Xiaomi SU7 Series reaching 39,790 vehicles in the quarter. As of September 30, 2024, Xiaomi delivered 67,157 vehicles of the Xiaomi SU7 Series . In October 2024, the monthly deliveries of the Xiaomi SU7 Series exceeded 20,000 vehicles. Moreover, Xiaomi achieved a cumulative production of 100,000 vehicles on November 13, 2024 and the delivery target of 100,000 vehicles on November 18, 2024. Xiaomi will strive to achieve the delivering of 130,000 vehicles for the entire year of 2024. Xiaomi's sales and service network is also rapidly expanding, with 127 smart EV sales centres across 38 cities in mainland China as of September 30, 2024, driving the Group to speed up the delivery. In October 2024, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra Prototype completed its Nürburgring Nordschleife lap challenge, breaking the record for "The Nürburgring Nordschleife World's Fastest Four-Door Car" with a time of 6’ 46”874. Pre-orders are now open for the mass-produced Xiaomi SU7 Ultra , which is powered by a tri-motor system consisting of dual proprietary Xiaomi HyperEngine V8s and a Xiaomi HyperEngine V6s. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra reaches a maximum designed speed of 350 km/h. Priced at RMB814,900, the pre-orders of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra reached 3,680 vehicles within the first 10 minutes. The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra is scheduled for official release in March 2025. Committed to becoming a global leader in the evolving realm of cutting-edge technologies with Increased R&D Investment Xiaomi is committed to investing sustainably in foundational core technologies and becoming a global leader in the evolving realm of cutting-edge technologies. In 2024 Q3, Xiaomi’s research and development (“R&D”) expenses reached RMB6.0 billion, up 19.9% YoY. As of September 30, 2024, Xiaomi had 20,436 R&D personnel. Xiaomi has obtained more than 41,000 patents worldwide. In 2024, the Group’s ranking in the valid global patent families of declared 5G Standard Essential Patents (“SEPs”) improved to 8th worldwide. On November 14, 2024, Xiaomi Auto unveiled its smart chassis pre-research technology, showcasing four core technologies: Xiaomi Full Active Suspension, Xiaomi Quad-HyperEngine, Xiaomi 48V Electric Mechanical Brake and Xiaomi 48V SbW System. Additionally, Xiaomi's smart driving system will fully embrace the end-to-end large model and rebranded as HAD, with the pioneer version of the product set for launch by the end of December 2024. To date, Xiaomi's smart driving system has covered over 75 million kilometers, with NOA accounting for 81% of this distance, spanning 333 cities nationwide with the presence of Xiaomi SU7 . This demonstrates Xiaomi's significant advancements in the smart driving sector. Starting October 30, 2024, Xiaomi SU7 Pro and Xiaomi SU7 Max began a phased rollout of the city navigation assistance feature (urban NOA), marking a new phase for Xiaomi's smart driving. In October 2024, Xiaomi officially launched Xiaomi HyperOS 2, marking a significant step towards building a comprehensive AI ecosystem. It features three core technological innovations - HyperCore, HyperConnect, and HyperAI - offering a fresh and advanced experience for global users in fundamental functionality, cross-device smart connectivity, and AI interactions. text: Baku, Azerbaijan, November 12, 2024 – During the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP29), the year's most prominent climate summit, Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things (“IoT”) platform at its core, introduced its strategy for sustainable development driven by its foundational core technologies. The company also showcased the latest advancements in carbon management in its "Human x Car x Home" smart ecosystem – another strategic upgrade for Xiaomi in climate governance. In a speech at the China Pavilion of the Conference here, Alain Lam Sai-wai, Vice President and CFO of the Group, and Chairman of Airstar Digital Technology, provided an in-depth analysis of Xiaomi's latest strategy for sustainable development driven by Xiaomi's foundational core technologies. He stated that Xiaomi’s goals are to make AI accessible to everyone, pursue sustainable development across its ecosystem, and take responsibility for its foundational core technologies. Xiaomi is committed to its "Human x Car x Home" smart ecosystem strategy, which aims to provide consumers with a sustainable, smart lifestyle via its foundational core technologies and AI innovation. He said: “Through smart manufacturing, AI innovation, and new retail models in our smart ecosystem, Xiaomi has not only enhanced its operational efficiencies and economies of scale in production but also enhanced the integration and efficiency of its supply chain, effectively optimizing resource utilization and energy consumption ratios.” Integrating AI with Foundational Core Technologies to Drive the Practical Application of Green Innovation Lam explained how Xiaomi leverages its "Human x Car x Home" smart ecosystem strategy to achieve a low-carbon, efficient, smart lifestyle and to empower ESG innovation through technologies. The Xiaomi HyperMind smart platform intelligently adjusts the operation modes of devices, such as air conditioners and refrigerators, in home environments. Through smart monitoring and adjustment, it ensures that each home appliance operates in a relatively low power consumption state, providing consumers with a smart, convenient, and low-carbon living experience. It leverages Xiaomi's foundational core technologies to strike a balance between comfort and environmental impact. Xiaomi smart manufacturing system also has achieved a high degree of automation in key areas. Xiaomi EV Factory utilizes its self-developed "Hyper Intelligent Manufacturing Platform" ("Hyper IMP") to streamline the entire smart manufacturing process, which covers everything from production management to detailed adjustments for autonomous optimization. This not only significantly enhances production efficiency but also reduces resource consumption in the various stages of manufacturing. This year, the Xiaomi SU7 Series won the "Low-Carbon Leader" award from the China Automotive Technology & Research Center. The vehicle's low-carbon secret is its strong technological capabilities. The drag coefficient of the Xiaomi SU7 Series, for example, is currently the lowest among mass-produced sedans worldwide, significantly reducing energy consumption and carbon emissions when it operates. The Xiaomi SU7 Max model supports 800V super-fast charging technology, enhancing charging efficiency. With the support of smart and automated technologies, Xiaomi cars are able to achieve more precise energy management and optimize driving modes, thereby reducing energy waste and minimizing environmental impact. Establishing a Carbon Management Standard for the "Human x Car x Home" Smart Ecosystem to Lead the Industry's Low-carbon Transformation At the presentation, Xiaomi released its organization standard for "The Construction of Carbon Management System for 'Human x Car x Home' Smart Ecosystem". The standard, which was formulated in October, is the first of its kind to focus on building a carbon management system for diverse enterprises in the "Human x Car x Home" smart ecosystem. Its main goal is to guide various enterprises in efficiently managing carbon emissions. Its secondary goal is to promote the creation of new quality productive forces through smart AI carbon management. The standard was devised to help these enterprises shift their carbon management approaches, drive carbon reduction throughout the value chain, and promote sustainable economic and social development. Envisioning Sustainable Development Driven by Foundational Core Technologies Xiaomi last year announced a technology strategy that focuses on fundamental technology and long-term investment in technologies that will benefit humanity. ESG practices play a crucial role in achieving this strategy. Xiaomi's long-term success depends on the short-term financial gains as well as its harmonious relationship with the environment, society, and governance. Xiaomi will continue to pursue technological advancements as a core value, prioritizing carbon neutrality in its operations through measures such as enhancing energy efficiency, applying clean energy practices, and innovating in smart manufacturing. Xiaomi also will actively lead the low-carbon transformation and upgrading of its entire value chain, providing customers and consumers with greener, smarter, and more sustainable products and services. Xiaomi's team is working together to build a better low-carbon future. Xiaomi Smart Band 9 Pro starts at 399 RMB, Xiaomi Magnetic Quick Release Strap at 169 RMB, and Xiaomi Leather Quick Release Strap at 99 RMB. Xiaomi Watch S4 Xiaomi Watch S4 combines stylish design with practical features, featuring a versatile bezel and rotating crown for enhanced usability. It sports a 1.43-inch AMOLED display and supports over 150 sports modes as well as comprehensive health monitoring, including heart rate, blood oxygen level, and stress tracking. For outdoor activities, its dual-mode walkie-talkie function and eSIM support allow users to enjoy music and make calls without a phone. Users can reply to messages, send emojis, and control smart home devices directly from the watch interface. Additional features include waterproofing, customizable watch faces, sleep monitoring, NFC car key functionality, and voice assistant support, making it an excellent choice for those seeking both style and functionality. It can reach up to 165W when both ports are used simultaneously, making it capable of charging smartphones and tablets and even providing emergency power to some laptops. This power bank also includes a colorful smart display to easily monitor charging and power discharge and check the current battery level. Supporting efficient discharge and fast recharging, it allows for 90W rapid self-recharging using the built-in cable, and its compact design makes it convenient to carry on airplanes. Xiaomi 165W Power Bank 10000 will be available from 199 RMB. Mijia Air Conditioner Top-Outlet Pro 1.5HP Level 1+ Energy Efficiency Mijia Air Conditioner Top-Outlet Pro is an innovative air conditioner with top-out airflow. A leading 20mm ultra-thin fan and low thermal-conductivity foaming technology ensure no sacrifice of storage space due to the dual system. The water molecular sieve for the fruit and vegetable drawer and full-range purification system for refrigeration and freezing further enhance overall performance in sterilization, purifying, and preservation. Mijia Multi-zone Refrigerator 4 Glass Door 508L Pro will be available from 3,999 RMB. Xiaomi TV S Pro Mini LED 2025 A newly upgraded offering of the S Pro series, Xiaomi TV S Pro Mini LED 2025 has dramatically improved Mini LED's basic partition and brightness configuration. The 85-inch model offers partitions reaching 2,880, and the peak brightness has been increased to 3,200 nits. An additional 30W bass unit has been added to the audio system to boost bass performance. Xiaomi TV S Pro Mini LED 2025 also introduces multiple software upgrades powered by an advanced picture engine, enabling more precise picture color accuracy and more delicate transitions from light to dark. Xiaomi HyperOS 2 further enhances the overall viewing experience and smart interaction capabilities. Xiaomi TV S Pro Mini LED 2025 series is available in four sizes: 65", 75", 85", and 100", and will be available from 4,599 RMB, 6,499 RMB, 8,499 RMB, and 12,999 RMB, respectively. The dual drum independent drying system allows simultaneous drying, setting a new trend in zoned washing and drying. Equipped with advanced features such as smart triple dispensing, steam sterilization, and dual essence quick wash, it guarantees no cross-contamination throughout the washing process. High-temperature steam technology eliminates bacteria, mites, and allergens, meeting modern needs for high cleanliness. Mijia Dual-drum Dual Washer Dryer 10kg will be available for 4,999 RMB. By combining mechanical, chemical, and electrochemical washing methods, this washing machine offers a comprehensive upgrade in cleaning power. The unique 525mm large drum diameter design and 3D cold water wash technology ensure deep cleaning. Additionally, the built-in detergent, fabric softener storage, and app-customizable dispensing features provide significant convenience for users. Mijia Advanced Washer Dryer 10kg Pro will be available for 2,999 RMB. text: Beijing, October 29, 2024 — Xiaomi launched the ultimate performance technology sedan -- Xiaomi SU7 Ultra. As the high-performance flagship EV of Xiaomi, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra is designed for high-performance driving by combining exceptional performance with cutting-edge technology to deliver an extraordinary driving experience. It is perfect for both daily driving and hitting the track. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra is equipped with the same tri-motor configuration and track-optimized battery pack as Xiaomi SU7 Ultra Prototype (prototype car), delivering a maximum horsepower of 1548PS. With 0-100km/h acceleration in only 1.98s (without one foot rollout), and a designed maximum speed of 350km/h, it is built to be the fastest four-door mass-produced car. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra features a track-optimized cooling system, ensuring it can complete two laps on the Nürburgring Nordschleife without overheating. It is also equipped with a top-level braking system, achieving a braking distance of only 30.8m from 100km/h to 0. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra also comes with a peak chassis system tuned for the Nürburgring Nordschleife, delivering better chassis control and a higher control ceiling. As a four-door "race car", it is track-ready straight from the factory. In addition, the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra offers multiple upgrades in smart driving, smart cockpit, safety and luxury experience. On October 28 (German time), Xiaomi SU7 Ultra Prototype completed its first Nürburgring Nordschleife lap challenge, breaking the seven-year record for the fastest four-door sedan with a time of 6'46"874 -- making the first time a Chinese brand has claimed the title of "The Nürburgring Nordschleife World's Fastest Four-Door Car". Xiaomi Auto will keep exploring breakthrough innovations in pure electric technology and validating its cars through the Nürburgring Nordschleife testing. The mass-produced version of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra will also challenge the Nürburgring Nordschleife next year. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra is now available for pre-order, with official release scheduled for March 2025. The pre-order price is set at 814,900 yuan, with a 10,000 yuan intention deposit required. Pre-orders receive priority delivery. Born for high-performance: From street to track, where beauty meets function The design of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra prioritizes peak performance, with each new design element serving functional purposes, free from unnecessary decoration. For exterior design, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra builds on Xiaomi SU7 Max with an added aerodynamic kit and larger body dimensions. At 5115mm length, 1970mm width, 1465mm height, and 3000mm wheelbase, the body is longer, lower, and presents a more aggressive, battle-ready stance. The front of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra features an oversized front splitter and air dam, along with "U-shaped" air curtains to effectively increase the downforce of the front of the car. The enlarged air intake grille opening allows the heat dissipation area to be increased by 10%. An active rear diffuser has been added, with two-speed adaptive adjustment, balancing wind resistance and downforce, and energy efficiency for daily driving. Additionally, a new carbon fiber fixed rear spoiler (1560mm wingspan, 240mm chord length) delivers considerable downforce at high speeds. Thanks to the new aerodynamic design, the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra achieves a maximum downforce of 285kg, comparable to that of a supercar. The interior of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra emphasizes sportiness through upgraded seats and steering wheel design. The new sports seats feature enhances active side support with faster response speed and larger support area, providing better body control during intense driving. The seats showcase exclusive track embroidery stripes and Ultra embroidered logo, adding to the sporty aesthetic. The steering wheel of Xiaomi SU7 features a completely new design, adopting a race-designed flat top and bottom. The material has been upgraded to carbon fiber. The grip is covered with Alcantara®️ microfiber fabric, which is not easy to slip. A yellow centering marker at the 12 o'clock aids steering wheel during intense handling. The new design, coupled with the yellow seat belts and the red Boost button on the steering wheel, creating a race-ready cockpit atmosphere at the interior of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra. The interior materials of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra are also further enhanced, with Italian Alcantara®️ microfiber fabric extensively used throughout the car, covering over 5m². The material wraps the full seat contact surfaces, steering wheel grip areas, dashboard stitching, and the interior door panels, delivering a premium feel and a more immersive driving environment. The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra extensively uses carbon fiber materials, enhancing sportiness and reducing weight. Interior carbon fiber elements include the front-seat back panels, center console panel, and door sill plates, reinforcing the athletic aesthetic. For exterior design, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra features a 1.7m² large carbon fiber roof*, reducing weight by 12kg. Carbon fiber appears in 17 locations, totaling 3.74m². 90% of these components are manufactured using premium hot press process, ensuring superior texture and quality. Peak performance: The Nürburgring Nordschleife world's fastest mass-produced four-door sedan with 1548PS, 0-100km/h sprint in 1.98 seconds, designed top speed of 350km/h As Xiaomi's high-performance EV flagship, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra shares the same power system with the prototype car, delivering peak performance. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra generates a maximum horsepower of 1548PS and accelerates from 0 to 100km/h in just 1.98s (without one foot rollout). It sets new benchmark as the world's first mass-produced four-door sedan to achieve 0 to 200km/h in just 5.86s and to reach a designed maximum speed of 350km/h. The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra's peak performance is backed by advanced technology. It shares the prototype's tri-motor configuration - two V8s e-motors and one V6s e-motor, marking the first mass production of Xiaomi's self-developed HyperEngine V8s. The HyperEngine V8s achieves a maximum revolution of 27,200rpm, making it the highest-revolution and most powerful mass-produced main drive e-motor available. Xiaomi Auto has consistently committed to research and development (R&D) investments and upheld innovation. As of today, it has applied for 242 patents in the field of electric motor and electric power control unit, of which 128 have been granted. Xiaomi's self-developed electric drive also won the "Global New Energy Vehicle Frontier and Innovation Technology Award" at the 2024 World New Energy Vehicle Conference. In terms of battery, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra features the same track-optimized, high-power battery pack as the prototype car, debuting CATL Qilin 2.0 battery. As one of the most powerful mass-produced battery packs available, it delivers a maximum discharge rate of 16C and a maximum discharge power of 1330kW. When the power is only 20% left, the discharge power can still reach 800kW. The highest charging rate is 5.2C, enabling 10% to 80% charging in just 11 minutes. The CLTC range reaches 630km, combing high performance and long range. Integrating Xiaomi’s CTB battery technology for higher volume efficiency, the battery pack features dual large-surface active cooling to ensure stronger battery heat dissipation capabilities and safety guarantees. For electric vehicles to achieve long-lasting and stable high performance, they require exceptional systematic cooling capabilities. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra has upgraded its cooling system in all aspects. The performance of the compressor, water pump, cooling fan and radiator have all been greatly enhanced. The maximum heat dissipation per minute reaches 2.7*10^6J, triple the heat dissipation capacity of an ordinary EV, effectively ensuring that it will not overheat during two consecutive hot laps on the Nürburgring Nordschleife. The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra is equipped with a top-level braking system, including carbon ceramic brake discs, high-performance fixed calipers, and high-performance brake pads. It achieves a braking distance from 100km/h to 0 in only 30.8m, and completes 10 consecutive 180km/h-0 braking tests without fading. The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra boasts the largest racing-grade carbon ceramic brake disc in a sports car. The diameter of the front brake disc reaches 430mm, which is the largest carbon ceramic disc currently equipped on a sedan. Compared with ordinary steel brake discs, carbon ceramic discs are more resistant to high temperatures, with a maximum operating temperature of more than 1300°C, which is more than twice that of ordinary steel brake discs. Carbon ceramic discs are also more wear-resistant and lighter. Its service life exceeds 500,000km, and it also reduces the weight of the entire vehicle by 57kg. The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra is also equipped with Akebono®️ high-performance brake calipers. The working areas of the fixed calipers with six pistons at front and four pistons at rear reach 148cm² and 93cm² respectively, delivering exceptional strong braking performance. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra also uses endurance racing-level ENDLESS®️ high-performance brake pads*, which can operate at a maximum temperature of 1100°C and keep the braking force stable. In addition, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra's efficient braking energy regeneration system provides a maximum deceleration of 0.6g and a maximum regeneration power of over 400kW, greatly reducing brake system load. Extraordinary driving experience: Track-tuned chassis system for the Nürburgring Nordschleife, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra comes track-ready straight from the factory Xiaomi SU7 Ultra features a peak chassis system tuned for the Nürburgring Nordschleife, delivering better chassis control and a higher control ceiling. As a four-door "race car", it comes track-ready straight from the factory. For suspension, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra uses dual-chamber air springs and high-performance continuous damping control (CDC), providing a larger spring stiffness and damping adjustment range, making the standard mode more comfortable and the sports mode more sporty. It also provides track players with a professional-grade Bilstein®️ EVO T1 coilover shock absorber kit*, with a maximum spring stiffness of 300N/mm and a maximum damping force of 9000N. With 10 levels of compression and rebound damping adjustment, it comprehensively enhances the upper limit of control during acceleration, braking, and cornering, providing unparalleled support when cornering on the track. Users can choose dual-chamber air springs or coilover shock absorbers according to their needs. When it comes to chassis control, the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra tri-motor configuration achieves torque-vectoring control. The torque of the three e-motors is independently and dynamically distributed, and the e-motor torque is adjusted at a frequency of 500 times per second, which greatly enhances the vehicle's handling and stability. During cornering, the system allocates more torque to outer wheels for faster steering response and corner exit speeds. When one side of the wheel encounters a slippery road, the system can automatically adjust the torque of the left and right wheels in milliseconds to help the vehicle pass more smoothly and quickly. This torque-vectoring control system is designed in accordance with the industry's highest ASIL-D functional safety standard, and the fastest fault coordinated shutdown time is only 14ms, effectively ensuring the safety of the vehicle. The chassis system of Xiaomi SU7 Ultra has undergone long-term tuning at the Nürburgring Nordschleife. Since June 11, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra has started real-car testing at the Nürburgring Nordschleife, accumulating over 3,000km across 6 weeks of tuning. By using the world's renowned Nürburgring Nordschleife as a proving ground, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra aims to provide users with peak handling performance. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra comes with Xiaomi tri-motor configuration, a high-power battery pack, a track optimized cooling system, a carbon ceramic brake system, dual-chamber air springs, and high-performance continuous damping control, so you can enjoy the fun of extreme speed on the track. Users who have more extreme track needs can choose top professional equipment such as Bilstein®️ coilover shock absorbers*, ENDLESS®️ high-performance brake pads*, etc. Unparalleled immersive experience: Exclusive cockpit UI and sporty sound, with a dedicated Racetrack Master app for competitive driving To complement its peak performance and chassis system, Xiaomi SU7 Ultra has created a new visual and auditory interactive experience with an exclusive Racetrack Master app to bring users an unparalleled immersive experience. The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra's central control screen, instrument screen and some UI interfaces of HUD have been upgraded, and the exclusive cockpit UI design is cooler and more sporty. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra offers three new sports sound waves: super power, super sound, and super pulse, and adds a 40W external speaker to support sound waves. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra has developed a powerful exclusive Racetrack Master app for track users. The Racetrack Master app can display full vehicle information, including real-time lap results, vehicle status, driving mode adjustment, etc. When drivers start racing, they can set a benchmarking lap time to display the difference between the current lap time and the benchmarking lap time in real time, maximizing competitive engagement. After the race, it supports historical lap statistics and visual analysis of results, and key parameters such as maximum speed, maximum G force, steering wheel angle, and braking force. Drivers are able to export and share their race videos with just one click. As of today, Xiaomi Auto has partnered with 20 professional tracks across China, adding track maps and rankings to the exclusive racetrack app. More professional tracks will be added in the future. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra offers comprehensive driving modes for both track safety and daily driving use. For track performance, there are endurance mode, qualifying mode, drift mode, and master custom mode to choose from, bringing endless driving fun. For daily driving, options include beginner mode, economy mode, wet mode, sport mode, and custom mode, among others. In order to ensure safe driving, to activate track mode for the first time in the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, drivers must obtain driving skills or qualification certifications. The daily driving mode includes power and speed limitations. Pre-order starts today with a pre-order price at 814,900 yuan Xiaomi SU7 Ultra, the ultimate performance beast, is one that speaks to the hearts of those who crave for the thrill of driving, who strive for the extraordinary, and who want to live every day to the fullest. It is perfect for both daily driving and hitting the track. It is a luxury tech sedan that exudes a strong sense of technology and luxury, suitable for daily use, whether for business commutes and meetings. It possesses top technological capabilities and offers unmodified track capability for high-speed excitement. Xiaomi SU7 Ultra is now available for pre-order, with official release scheduled for March 2025. The pre-order price is set at 814,900 yuan, with a 10,000 yuan intention deposit required. Pre-orders receive priority delivery. *Some configurations are optional and are subject to delivery. text: Beijing, China, October 29 2024 — Xiaomi held one of its most important domestic launch events of the year, officially introducing Xiaomi 15 Series, Xiaomi Pad 7, and Xiaomi HyperOS 2 to Mainland China. Xiaomi 15 series debuts Snapdragon® 8 Elite Mobile Platform. Recently announced by Qualcomm, Snapdragon® 8 Elite features the advanced second-generation 3nm process, PC-level dual primary core architecture, and includes two second-generation Oryon super cores, sharing the same foundation as the Qualcomm flagship PC platform, Snapdragon X Elite. This architecture brings the most significant performance leap of the last decade amongst Snapdragon’s flagship platforms, with CPU performance increasing by 42% and GPU performance by 44%. The NPU is capable of seamless integration with Xiaomi's HyperAI subsystem, delivering up to 80 TOPS of comprehensive computing power to enable on-device AI functions. Xiaomi 15 Pro: The Pinnacle of Smartphone Photography Xiaomi 15 Pro's design philosophy is to create the best in-hand feel flagship of this generation. It features a slightly curved display, aluminum frame, seamless camera design, and unified ceramic camera deco, all brought together in a sleek attractive design. Xiaomi 15 Pro is available in three base colors: Gray, White, and Green, alongside a unique Liquid Silver Edition. Pe ak perf ormance paired w ith a massive 610 0mAh batte ry ca pacity Xiaomi 15 Pro has a Snapdragon 8 Elite processor at its core, and Xiaomi’s self-developed HyperCore system kernel gives it even more incredible performance potential. It also features an upgraded cooling system with 14% more cooling area, enabling faster cooling of high-temperature areas. In addition to its impressive performance, the battery life provides exceptional peace of mind with its substantial 6100mAh battery capacity. Despite reducing device weight by approximately 10g, the battery capacity has been increased by 1220mAh when compared with the previous generation. Leica Summilux optical system with ultra-level telephoto Xiaomi 15 Pro is equipped with three Leica large-aperture lenses that cover focal lengths from 14mm to 120mm, making it versatile for various styles from portraits to landscapes. The main camera has an impressive ƒ/1.44 aperture, allowing more light, faster shutter speeds, and natural background blur. This creates an enhanced "main character" effect in portrait shots and emphasizes subjects in stills. The telephoto lens shares the same Sony IMX858 sensor as Xiaomi 14 Ultra. It features a periscope structure with an effective focal length of 120mm, delivering powerful zoom and intense image capabilities. It achieves 10x lossless zoom using high-pixel readout mode, extending focal range to 240mm. On the software side, Xiaomi AISP 2.0 computational photography platform incorporates multiple serial algorithms to produce UltraRAW digital negatives in a single step, while also enabling 20x UltraZoom. It also includes an advanced AI model for imaging, which covers the photo, video, and post-production workflow, greatly enhancing ease of use and creative possibilities. Xiaomi 15: The Ultimate Compact Flagship​ Xiaomi 15 continues the classic design language of Xiaomi series, with every detail meticulously refined. The device features a quad-curve middle frame design with clean edges that subtly curve on the rear, creating a smooth, rounded feel wherever your fingers touch. Adhering to a balanced 50:50 weight distribution, Xiaomi 15 feels exceptionally well-balanced in hand. Xiaomi 15 will be available in its domestic market in Black, White, Green, and Purple. All four colors use a glass material with a velvet-like sandblasting, offering a smooth yet textured finish. ​ ​ ​ ​ Also unveiled was a specially designed Liquid Silver Edition, which features a unique rear glass panel that has undergone an exceptionally refined hot-pressing process to create a textured ripple effect. Compact but full of power with a 5400mAh high-capacity battery Xiaomi 15 features a large 5400mAh battery, breaking expectations that compact phones must have small batteries. With a silicon content of up to 6% and industry leading energy density at 850Wh/L, the battery capacity has increased by 790mAh compared to the previous generation despite reducing the device weight by 2g. Charging is as convenient as ever with 90W HyperCharge and 50W wireless HyperCharge. Compact yet visually impactful, featuring a 6.36" display Xiaomi 15 features a 6.36-inch display with an ultra-narrow 1.38mm bezel, creating a stunning visual experience. This is made possible by Xiaomi's innovative LIPO three-dimensional packaging technology, which uses low-pressure injection molding to encapsulate the display's flex cable area. This allows the cable area to fit directly against the middle frame, significantly reducing the lower bezel of the display—marking another breakthrough in Xiaomi's display technology. The screen's brightness achieves a max of up to 3200 nits while featuring LTPO technology, allowing for a variable refresh rate of 1-120Hz and supporting partitioned refreshing, further reducing power consumption. Three Leica high-speed lenses, compact size with flagship optical system Xiaomi 15 is equipped with three Leica ultra-high-speed lenses, with the primary featuring a f/1.62 large aperture paired with a 1/1.31" Light Fusion 900 image sensor, offering faster speeds and superior image capabilities. The telephoto lens uses a new 28nm sensor, supporting richer features while implementing the highly-praised floating lens design. This telephoto achieves a super-large focus range from as close as 10cm to much larger ranges, allowing both telephoto portraits and magical close-up shots. The ultra-wide-angle lens has an equivalent focal length of 14mm and an ƒ/2.2 large aperture, capable of capturing landscape photos with exceptional visual impact. On the software front, Xiaomi AISP 2.0 platform has been upgraded and is capable of computing up to 4.3 billion pixels per second, speeding up the entire shooting process and capturing complex scenes vividly. Also launched were Xiaomi 15 Custom Edition and Xiaomi 15 Limited Edition. The Custom Edition offers a choice of black-and-white high-gloss frame and three color palettes for users to explore. Xiaomi has created 20 custom color options that can be freely combined with the frame to create 40 different color combinations. Xiaomi 15 Limited Edition is designed with premium in mind. The middle frame is inlaid with an eco-cultivated diamond, featuring 57 dazzling facets that shine brilliantly alongside the glossy metallic frame. The back panel is made from nano-tech vegan leather material and is available in three colors: White, Gray, and Orange. Each Xiaomi 15 Limited Edition includes a matching nano-tech vegan leather cardholder and passport holder. Price and availability Xiaomi 15 is available in four colors: White, Black, Green, and Purple. The prices are as follows: 12GB+256GB for 4,499 RMB, 12GB+512GB for 4,799 RMB, 16GB+512GB for 4,999 RMB, and 16GB+1TB for 5,499 RMB. Xiaomi 15 Pro comes in three colors: Gray, Green, and White. Its prices are 5,299 RMB for 12GB+256GB, 5,799 RMB for 16GB+512GB, and 6,499 RMB for 16GB+1TB. Both models have a Liquid Silver Edition, starting at 4,699 RMB for Xiaomi 15 and 5,499 RMB for Xiaomi 15 Pro. Xiaomi 15 Custom Edition, with a 16GB+512GB configuration, is priced at 4,999 RMB, and Xiaomi 15 Limited Edition, with a 16GB+1TB configuration, is priced at 5,999 RMB. Xiaomi Pad 7 Series Xiaomi Pad 7 Series is designed for AI-enhanced office productivity, marking a significant upgrade across the board. Featuring industry-leading displays and top-tier hardware, Xiaomi Pad 7 Series includes Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro and Xiaomi Pad 7. Both models boast an 11.2-inch 3.2K flagship screen with a new 3:2 aspect ratio, making them ideal for mobile work. The sleek all-metal design houses robust Snapdragon® 8s Gen 3 and Snapdragon® 7+ Gen 3, respectively. At the same time, Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro supports rapid 67W charging and features an impressive 8850mAh battery, along with Wi-Fi 7 connectivity for faster internet access. Running on Xiaomi HyperOS 2, users benefit from enhanced system fluidity and interactive features, enabling unprecedented interconnectivity for modern workflows. Xiaomi Pad 7 Series is available starting at 1,999 RMB in Black, Blue, and Green. Xiaomi HyperOS 2 Xiaomi HyperOS 2 introduces three core technological innovations to its Mainland China devices—HyperCore, HyperConnect, and HyperAI—offering a fresh, advanced experience in fundamental functionality, cross-device smart connectivity, and AI interactions for domestic market users. It will be featured on newly released products, including Xiaomi 15 Series, Xiaomi Pad 7 series, and Xiaomi Watch S4, with official rollouts to additional models starting in November 2024. Xiaomi HyperCore: Powerful System Performance Xiaomi HyperCore supports the new Xiaomi HyperOS 2 with an improved smooth and stable system foundation. Earlier this year, Xiaomi formed a dedicated team of over 3,000 engineers to optimize for more than 25,000 scenarios. This led to the creation of Xiaomi HyperCore, Xiaomi's proprietary core technology platform, enhancing performance, graphics, network, and security. HyperCore kernel introduces an in-house microarchitecture scheduler, which analyzes instruction pipelines directly from the chip's architecture. By optimizing task cycles and memory latency, it reduces CPU idle time by 19%. With Xiaomi's new dynamic memory and Storage 2.0, Xiaomi 15 series powered by HyperCore offers ultra-fast app launch speeds, low gaming power consumption, and unrivaled smoothness even in intensive scenarios. Xiaomi HyperConnect: Seamless Connectivity and Compatibility Xiaomi HyperOS 2, powered by HyperConnect, enables seamless, real-time integration across the Xiaomi ecosystem. With "Home Screen+," users can drag phone apps onto Xiaomi tablets or add them as native apps. HyperConnect also supports dual-camera streaming between Xiaomi tablets and phones. Now fully compatible with Apple devices in Mainland China with Xiaomi Interconnectivity Services installed, Xiaomi HyperConnect allows Apple users to browse files, share photos, and access Keynote, Pages, and Numbers files on Xiaomi devices, enabling fluid productivity across ecosystems. Xiaomi HyperAI: Redefining an Intelligent System Experience Xiaomi HyperAI, embedded in Xiaomi HyperOS 2, upgrades the AI experience with fresh, user-friendly functions, creating a dynamic, ever-evolving user experience. Xiaomi HyperAI offers a transformative aesthetic experience. It uses AI to analyze depth in user-selected videos frame by frame, creating cinematic depth effects on lock screens. With AIGC, static wallpapers of cities, plants, and more can be animated instantly. HyperOS 2 also reshapes system applications with AI, enhancing productivity and usability. AI writing lets users quickly refine or extend text on-screen. AI sound recognition enables transcribing and identifying speaker-specific audio in calls, recordings, or meeting apps, generating accurate summaries. AI subtitles provide real-time translation and interpretation in meetings, improving cross-language communication. On Xiaomi tablets, the "AI Art" function within Mi Canvas can transform sketches into customized artwork, unlocking new creative possibilities. About Xiaomi Corporation Xiaomi Corporation was founded in April 2010 and listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on July 9, 2018 ( 1810.HK ). Xiaomi is a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform at its core. Embracing our vision of “Make friends with users and be the coolest company in the users’ hearts”, Xiaomi continuously pursues innovations, high-quality user experience and operational efficiency. The company relentlessly builds amazing products with honest prices to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology. Xiaomi is one of the world’s leading smartphone companies, with its global smartphone shipments ranked among the top three and global MAU (including smartphones and tablets) reached 641.2 million in December 2023. The Company has also established the world’s leading consumer AIoT (AI+IoT) platform, reached approximately 739.7 million smart devices connected to its platform (excluding smartphones, laptops and tablets) as of December 31, 2023. In October 2023, Xiaomi upgraded its strategy to “Human × Car × Home” smart ecosystem, seamlessly merges personal devices, smart home products, and cars. Xiaomi always centers on humanity and is committed to providing comprehensive, better connected experiences. Xiaomi products are present in more than 100 countries and regions around the world. In August 2023, Xiaomi was included in the Fortune Global 500 list for the fifth year in a row, ranking 360th. Xiaomi is a constituent of the Hang Seng Index, Hang Seng China Enterprises Index, Hang Seng TECH Index and Hang Seng China 50 Index.
