text: Berlin, GERMANY, September 26, 2024 – Xiaomi, a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company, today announced seven new products expanding its AIoT portfolio: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Pro, Xiaomi TV Max 100 2025¹, Xiaomi TV Max 85 2025¹, Xiaomi Buds 5, Xiaomi Smart Band 9, and an updated Xiaomi Watch 2. These new devices are designed to simplify daily tasks, enhance personal health, and bring smarter solutions to the home. As a part of its Human x Car x Home strategy, Xiaomi continues to deliver innovations which seamlessly integrate advanced technology into daily life, while being more accessible and practical for users around the world. Xiaomi's new lineup of robot vacuums caters to different home cleaning needs. Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max offers expert cleaning with advanced features such as high-temp auto mop pad washing and rapid hot air drying, an extendable mop arm and anti-tangle hair-cutting brush, and a super powerful suction fan blower, making it ideal for users who prioritize deep cleaning and minimal maintenance. Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Pro focuses on powerful suction and intelligent features, including a precise obstacle avoidance system and smart carpet detection. Meanwhile, Xiaomi TV Max 100 2025 and Xiaomi TV Max 85 2025 deliver an exceptional home theater experience with ultra-large QLED displays, 4K UHD resolution, and 94% DCI-P3 (Typ.) color accuracy for vibrant visuals. With a 144Hz refresh rate and seamless playback, these TVs are perfect for movies, sports, and gaming. As the human element of its Human x Car x Home strategy, Xiaomi also introduces Xiaomi Smart Band 9 for advanced fitness and daily wellness tracking, Xiaomi Buds 5 for immersive audio, and the updated Xiaomi Watch 2, offering seamless connectivity and sports training features. Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max: Enhanced Power and Precision for Superior Home Cleaning Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max offers a powerful and intelligent solution for a spotless home with minimal effort. Designed for those who prioritize both efficiency and effectiveness, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max features an upgraded all-in-one base station with a high-temperature auto mop pad washing system. Users can customize water temperatures for washing the mop, ensuring optimal cleaning results. Additionally, the hot air drying feature dries the mop pads in as little as three hours², preventing odors. A standout feature is the innovative extendable mop arm, which reaches into corners and along edges for meticulous cleaning. With an impressive 8000Pa suction power³, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max effortlessly lifts and removes deep-seated dust, pet hair, and other debris, making it an ideal choice for households with pets or allergies. Advanced obstacle avoidance technology allows Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max to navigate seamlessly around furniture and other obstacles, minimizing the risk of collisions and ensuring a thorough clean every time. Powered by a robust 5200mAh⁴ battery, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max provides up to 120 minutes⁵ of continuous cleaning, making it perfect for large homes and multi-room sessions. Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Pro: Streamlined Cleaning for Busy Lives Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Pro offers a comprehensive and intelligent cleaning experience with its advanced features, ideal for busy professionals with large homes and apartments. The all-in-one base station simplifies maintenance by quickly auto-emptying its tank in just 13 seconds⁶, and automatically cleaning the mop pads, reducing the time and effort needed for upkeep. With a 7000Pa suction power⁷ and four adjustable suction levels, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Pro effectively handles dirt and pet hair on various surfaces, including carpets. Its smart carpet detection increases suction power where needed⁸, ensuring thorough cleaning. The vacuum's advanced obstacle avoidance technology navigates around furniture and obstacles, ensuring complete coverage of your home. Featuring a 5200mAh⁴ battery that delivers up to 160 minutes⁵ of continuous cleaning, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Pro is perfect for extensive cleaning sessions. Controlled via Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app, it offers a customizable and convenient cleaning experience that adapts to your home and lifestyle, making daily maintenance easier and more efficient. Xiaomi TV Max 100 2025 and Xiaomi TV Max 85 2025: Superior Smart Entertainment For Any Home Xiaomi TV Max 100 2025 and Xiaomi TV Max 85 2025 offer unparalleled home theater experience with ultra-large QLED displays, 4K UHD resolution, and 94% DCI-P3 (Typ.) color accuracy for vibrant visuals. With a 144Hz refresh rate and seamless playback, they are perfect for movies, sports, and gaming. Dolby Vision® and Dolby Atmos®¹³ provide cinematic visuals and immersive sound, while Filmmaker Mode and HDMI 2.1 with VRR and AMD FreeSync™ Premium ensures smooth gaming and authentic film quality. AI-enhanced processing, a bezel-less design, Google TV™ integration¹⁴, and Xiaomi Watch 2 control make Xiaomi TV Max 100 2025 and Xiaomi TV Max 85 2025 the ultimate entertainment hub for any home. Xiaomi Buds 5: Unmatched Sound and Comfort Xiaomi Buds 5 delivers flagship-level audio with 11mm dual-magnet driver, Harman AudioEFX tuning, Qualcomm® aptX™ Lossless and Hi-Res Audio certification⁹ for crisp, immersive sound. These lightweight earbuds feature advanced wide-frequency active noise cancellation with customizable modes and AI adaptive options, ensuring clarity in any environment. Designed for versatility, they offer crystal-clear calls even in 12m/s wind conditions with triple-mic¹⁰, built-in audio recording¹¹ ideal for content creators. With up to 39 hours of battery life¹² and smart force controls, Xiaomi Buds 5 blends premium designs with cutting-edge technology for an exceptional listening experience. Xiaomi Smart Band 9: A Dynamic Fitness Tracker for Every Lifestyle Xiaomi Smart Band 9 perfectly blends fashion and function, delivering superior performance for active lifestyles. Equipped with a powerful 233mAh battery that offers up to 21 days¹⁵ of typical use and features over 150 sports modes, Xiaomi Smart Band 9 is designed for fitness enthusiasts. Its enhanced health and sleep tracking features combined with stylish design and versatile accessories, make it a must-have for anyone looking to stay fit while making a fashion statement. Xiaomi Smart Band 9 also offers dynamic features such as linear motor for personalized vibrations and more than 200 band faces, allowing users to personalize their experience to suit various occasions. Xiaomi Watch 2: A Stylish Addition to Your Smartwatch Collection Xiaomi is expanding its smartwatch lineup with an updated Xiaomi Watch 2, introducing a sleek Titan Gray color variant. Xiaomi Watch 2 now includes updated software and features to optimize the wearing experience in various scenarios, with these advancements set to extend to previous models. Among the new features are 10 fun watch faces, including the new Pet Park feature, which encourages users to stay active by rewarding steps to 'nurture' a virtual pet on your watch. Users can enjoy watching their pets grow and evolve across stages based on their daily activities. Additionally, Xiaomi Watch 2 offers the ability to control Xiaomi TV Max Series 2025 via remote function and access interactive boxing lessons through Mi Fitness App. Price and Availability Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Max, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20 Pro, Xiaomi Buds 5, Xiaomi Smart Band 9, Xiaomi TV Max 100 2025, Xiaomi TV Max 85 2025, and the updated Xiaomi Watch 2 will be available for purchase through Xiaomi's official channels and authorized retailers. headings: Xiaomi 14T and Xiaomi 14T Pro Quick Specs
text: [Berlin, Germany, September 26th, 2024] – Xiaomi is proud to launch its latest flagship smartphone lineup, Xiaomi 14T Series, designed for photography enthusiasts pursuing top-tier imaging capabilities. Reimagining smartphone photography with a focus on exceptional night-time shooting, Xiaomi 14T Series is complemented by powerful AI features. With advanced AI-enhanced imaging technology, users can enjoy clear, vibrant shots at night or during the day. Combining sleek design, powerful MediaTek processors, and stunning AMOLED displays, Xiaomi 14T Series offers seamless integration of AI functionality for multiple use cases, delivering an unparalleled experience for those seeking the best from their devices. Alongside the launch of its latest smartphone series, Xiaomi is introducing the highly stylish and durable Xiaomi MIX Flip to the global market. Powered by the latest Xiaomi HyperOS, it delivers a seamless user experience across both its inner and outer displays. With professional-grade Leica imaging and flagship-level performance, Xiaomi MIX Flip matches the standards of non-foldable phones, offering exceptional functionality in a compact form. Redefining night photography with next-generation Leica optics Xiaomi 14T Series delivers an exceptional photography experience for any user. With exceptional low-light capabilities, Xiaomi 14T and Xiaomi 14T Pro capture breathtaking night scenes and vibrant cityscapes with extraordinary clarity. Powered by Xiaomi AISP, the AI LM computational photography platform, based on FusionLM, Xiaomi 14T Series enhances dynamic range and reduces noise for extraordinary detail and vibrant colors even in challenging lighting. Leveraging vast raw data from FusionLM, this series supports UltraHDR format, enhancing the HDR experience. Additionally, PortraitLM within the AISP platform enhances the Master Portrait mode, which covers a focal range of 23mm to 75mm, ensuring layered, detailed portrait photos with enhanced depth, clarity, and a natural bokeh effect. Xiaomi 14T Pro has a versatile triple camera system spanning five focal lengths—from 15mm to 120mm. This offers additional flexibility to cover various shooting conditions. Its 50MP main camera features a large ƒ/1.6 aperture and latest Leica Summilux optical lens, paired with the Light Fusion 900 image sensor. With a 1/1.31" sensor size, Dual Native ISO Fusion Max, and a 13.57EV high dynamic range, this advanced setup captures up to 32% more light than its predecessor,¹⁰ ensuring vibrant and detailed imagery. The device also includes a 7P aspherical high-transmittance lens to capture more light and support high dynamic range shooting. Xiaomi 14T features an advanced Sony’s IMX906 image sensor and a versatile triple camera system featuring three lenses with four focal lengths ranging from 15mm to 100mm. Its 50MP main camera, with a large ƒ/1.7 aperture and latest Leica Summilux optical lens, delivers vibrant colors and exceptional detail even in low light. The 12MP ultra-wide camera with a 15mm equivalent focal length also ensures crisp and detailed landscape shots. Beyond impressive photographic capabilities, Xiaomi 14T Series also excels in videography, making it effortless to capture cinematic videos. Movie mode defaults to a 2.39:1 aspect ratio and supports Cinematic Blur and Rack Focus switching for a cinematic feel, while Director mode introduces a professional cinematography interface with advanced parameter controls.¹⁵ Meanwhile, MasterCinema records HDR videos in the 10-bit Rec. 2020 format and offers up to 4K recording at 30fps, capturing more detail in light and shadow, presenting users with a dynamic range that closely resembles human vision. Harnessing advanced AI for everyday convenience Xiaomi 14T Series brings a new level of productivity and creativity with advanced AI capabilities across search, voice, text, image, and video, enhancing everyday tasks and with improving convenience.⁴ Harnessing the power of both on-device and cloud-based computing, Xiaomi 14T Series AI-capabilities empower users to enhance their productivity, travel smarter, and effortlessly create content. Taking collaboration with Google to new heights, Xiaomi 14T Series introduces Circle to Search with Google,³ becoming one of the first Xiaomi devices to offer this innovative feature. Users can instantly search anything they see on their phone without needing to switch apps. Additionally, Xiaomi 14T Series comes with the Google Gemini app.² Chat with Gemini to get help writing, learning, planning, and more.¹¹ For enhanced productivity, AI Interpreter overcomes language barrier to improve communication during meetings and calls.¹⁹ AI Notes and AI Recorder enhance efficiency with speech-to-text transcription, accurate speaker recognition, and quick summaries, while real-time translations ensure smooth multilingual interactions.¹⁹ On the creativity side, AI Image Editing intelligently expands images to elevate visual storytelling, while AI Eraser Pro removes unwanted elements for flawless photos.²⁰ AI Film makes creating cinematic short videos a breeze,¹⁹ and AI Portrait generates personalized avatars, empowering users to showcase their unique style effortlessly. Xiaomi 14T Series is committed to continuously enhancing the software experience, leading to over 600 software improvements since January 2024, which have resulted in a 9.8% increase in system speed.⁷ Improvements include improved multi-language optimization, feature synchronization with Android, and reduced entryways and app redundancy, resulting in a cleaner, more seamless, and more responsive experience. Xiaomi 14T Series also introduces three innovative features—call synchronization, app handoff, and playback transfer—that ensure seamless connectivity and effortless transitions between devices, significantly boosting productivity and convenience. Furthermore, the Link to Windows feature offers users an integrated PC computing environment, bridging the gap between mobile and desktop experiences. Users of Xiaomi 14T Series can enjoy 100 GB of Google One cloud storage for 6 months and 3 months of YouTube Premium with ad-free access to YouTube and YouTube Music.¹⁷ In selected markets, users can also enjoy 4 months of ad-free music streaming with Spotify Premium at no additional cost.¹⁸ Immersive visuals and ultra-smooth interactions Xiaomi 14T Series boasts a remarkable 6.67-inch AMOLED CrystalRes Display, offering stunning 1.5K resolution (2712 x 1220) with a pixel density of 446 ppi. This advanced display delivers vibrant visuals and smooth interactions, enhanced by impressive 12-bit color depth. With a high refresh rate of up to 144Hz,¹ users can enjoy ultra-smooth scrolling and responsive touch, ensuring fluid animations and seamless transitions for an elevated user experience. Offering DCI-P3 color coverage and peak brightness of 4000 nits,¹⁰ the display provides immersive visuals both indoor and outdoor, making every interaction more engaging and enjoyable. The next-generation AI display intelligently adjusts color temperature and brightness based on usage scenarios and time of day, ensuring optimal eye comfort. Xiaomi 14T Series delivers exceptional audio quality with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification and stereo speakers for immersive sound. Featuring Dolby Atmos® technology, users can experience rich, three-dimensional audio, elevating their enjoyment of movies, music, and games. Performance redefined with seamless speed and efficiency Xiaomi 14T Series delivers exceptional performance with cutting-edge processors and advanced cooling systems, elevating daily tasks with unparalleled speed and efficiency. Xiaomi 14T Pro redefines performance with the next-level flagship MediaTek Dimensity 9300+ processor, delivering a remarkable 37% boost in multi-core CPU performance.¹⁶ Paired with the advanced Immortalis-G720 GPU, which offers a 44% improvement in graphics performance,¹⁶ this powerful combination excels in AI applications and gaming, providing a seamless and superior experience. Enhanced by the Xiaomi Surge T1 Tuner for stable connectivity and improved cellular performance, and Xiaomi 3D IceLoop system for effective heat management, Xiaomi 14T Pro ensures peak performance without overheating, making it the ultimate choice for mobile gamers and power users. Xiaomi 14T, powered by the new AI processor MediaTek Dimensity 8300-Ultra, offers a 20% boost in CPU performance and a 60% improvement in GPU performance,⁵ making multitasking smoother and more efficient while extending battery life with improved power efficiency. Xiaomi 14T Series features powerful batteries and fast charging capabilities, ensuring rapid charging and reliable use. Xiaomi 14T Pro stands out as the first in Xiaomi T Series to introduce wireless charging, providing 50W wireless charging capability in addition to its 5000mAh battery. Additionally, 120W HyperCharge⁷ allows a full charge in just 19 minutes.¹⁰ Meanwhile, Xiaomi 14T is equipped with a robust 5000mAh battery and 67W HyperCharge⁶ for fast wired charging. Powerful performance meets stylish sophistication Xiaomi 14T Series seamlessly blends performance with elegant design, featuring a sleek metallic deco design and an ultra-narrow 1.7mm bezel that enhances the immersion of the display experience. Both devices boast an IP68 rating,⁹ ensuring water and dust resistance for durability and peace of mind. Xiaomi 14T Pro features a refined metallic frame that adds a touch of sophistication and offers up to 116% greater resilience¹⁰ against bending and damage compared to the previous generation. The 3D curved back enhances comfort and grip, while the metallic deco adds a touch of luxury. Xiaomi 14T Pro has three color options: Titan Gray, Titan Blue, and Titan Black. Xiaomi 14T is available in Titan Gray, Titan Blue, Titan Black, and Lemon Green.⁸ The Lemon Green variant is crafted from bio-based PU material with a four-layer structure, incorporating 50% bio-based materials, including lemon fiber and 100% recycled PET, making it an eco-friendly choice.¹⁰ Price and availability Xiaomi 14T Pro will be available in three color options: Titan Gray, Titan Blue and Titan Black. Xiaomi 14T will be available in four color options: Titan Gray, Titan Blue, Titan Black, and Lemon Green.⁸ Xiaomi MIX Flip will be available in two color options: Black and Purple. Xiaomi 14T Pro comes with three storage variants, starting from EUR 799. Xiaomi 14T comes with two storage variants, starting from EUR 649. Xiaomi MIX Flip comes with one storage variant, starting from EUR 1299. text: Beijing, CHINA, August 30, 2024 - Xiaomi today introduced Redmi 14C, seamlessly blending sleek design with impressive performance to enhance daily life. Its ultra-slim body adds a touch of sophistication, while its expansive display makes streaming, gaming, and multitasking more immersive. Powered by a robust processor and a long-lasting battery, Redmi 14C delivers seamless performance and reliable power. This helps users make the most of its creative camera, which offers various features and filters for capturing engaging photos and videos. Elegant design for everyday use Redmi 14C showcases how elegance and refinement come together in a smartphone designed to meet users' needs. Its 8.22mm ultra-slim body¹ features a flat frame and a newly designed, cutting-edge circular camera deco, offering a sleek and sophisticated look, while making this smartphone easy to handle for daily use. It comes with a classic glass finish, unique from previous generations, in Midnight Black or Dreamy Purple². Alternatively, users can choose Sage Green with a stylish matte texture, or Starry Blue with a star trail design². This range allows users to select the style best suited to their needs and preferences, thereby adding a touch of individuality to their everyday use. Immersive viewing supported by reliable performance Redmi 14C features a 6.88-inch display, the largest on Redmi number series to date, offering a spacious and immersive viewing area that transforms everyday activities. At the core of this smartphone lies a MediaTek Helio G81-Ultra octa-core processor and 5160mAh battery, which work together to enhance the user experience of its large display. Users can also enjoy an enhanced beautifier to highlight their best features in every shot. In addition to its advanced camera features, Redmi 14C features details that blend practicality with ease of use. headings: Xiaomi Corporation
Xiaomi leads growth among top five smartphone brands as global expansion accelerates
text: Revenue Growth Accelerates as Xiaomi Embarks on a New Growth Cycle Beijing, Hong Kong, August 21, 2024 — Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”; stock code:1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things (“IoT”) platform at its core, announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months ended June 30, 2024 (“2024 Q2” or “the Period”). Xiaomi reported double-digit year-over-year (YoY) revenue growth for the third consecutive quarter in 2024 Q2, with revenue reaching RMB88.9 billion, a 32% YoY increase. The adjusted net profit was RMB6.2 billion, marking a 20.1% YoY increase and underscoring robust growth. The overall gross profit margin remained strong at 20.7%. Xiaomi’s three core businesses — smartphones, IoT and lifestyle products, and internet services — outperformed market expectations with revenues of RMB46.5 billion, RMB26.8 billion, and RMB8.3 billion respectively. Revenue from the smart EV business and other new initiatives totalled RMB6.4 billion. The Group’s overall performance exceeded consensus expectations, marking a new phase of explosive growth. In Q2, Xiaomi's cash resources surged to RMB141 billion as of June 30, providing a crucial foundation for the sustained development of both core and new businesses, supporting its continued explosive growth. Driven by sustained investment in foundational core technologies. Xiaomi’s AI technology has notably empowered its business development, enhancing product capabilities and intelligent experience across Xiaomi smartphones and smart EVs, while also boosting operational efficiency of Xiaomi Smart Factory. The advancement of Xiaomi “Human x Car x Home” smart ecosystem is expected to further invigorate its businesses and reinforce the sustainability of future growth. Xiaomi leads growth among top five smartphone brands as global expansion accelerates In Q2, Xiaomi global smartphone shipments reached 42.2 million units, up 28.1% YoY. According to Canalys, Xiaomi has maintained its position among the top three smartphone brands globally for 16 consecutive quarters, with a market share of 14.6%. Xiaomi is the fastest-growing smartphone brand among the top five in terms of shipments. Xiaomi's smartphone business reported strong growth with Q2 revenue of RMB 46.5 billion, an increase of 27.1% YoY. According to Canalys, in Q2, the Group’s smartphone shipments ranked among the top three across 58 countries and regions globally and ranked among the top five across 70 countries and regions globally. The growth underscores Xiaomi’s growing influence in international markets, with accelerated expansion in Latin America, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa. In Latin America, Xiaomi’s smartphone shipments ranked among the top 2 for the first time. IoT business revenue soars; Q2 air conditioner shipments jump over 40% Xiaomi IoT and lifestyle products business maintained its upward trajectory in Q2, posting record-high revenue of RMB26.8 billion, a 20.3% YoY increase. The smart large home appliance segment also continued its robust performance, with revenue increasing by 38.7% YoY. According to Canalys, Xiaomi global tablet shipments in Q2 doubled YoY, making it the fastest-growing tablet brand among the top five in terms of shipments. Xiaomi wearables shipments ranked No. 3 globally and No. 2 in China, and its TWS earbud shipments ranked No. 3 globally and No. 1 in China. In Q2, Xiaomi air-conditioner shipments exceeded 3.3 million units, up over 40% YoY. During the Period, Xiaomi's refrigerators and washing machines also posted significant growth, with shipments surpassing 600,000 units and 400,000 units respectively. Robust growth in internet services business with global and mainland China MAU up over 10% respectively During the Period, Internet services sustained its rapid growth, with revenue increasing by 11% to a record RMB8.3 billion. As Xiaomi continues to deepen and expand its global partnership network, overseas internet services revenue increased 32.9% YoY to RMB2.7 billion in Q2, raising its share of total Internet services revenue to 32.1%. The Internet users base continued to expand, and the monthly active users (“MAU”) globally and in mainland China both hit record highs. In June 2024, the global MAU reached 675.8 million, an increase of 11.5% YoY, while its mainland China MAU reached 164.4 million, up 10.1% YoY. Smart EV business growth beats forecasts with over 27,000 vehicles delivered in Q2 Since the debut of Xiaomi first smart EV, the Xiaomi SU7 Series , market performance has significantly outpaced expectations. In Q2, revenue from the smart EV business and other new initiatives reached RMB6.4 billion. The Group is continuously ramping up production and delivery of the Xiaomi SU7 Series . In Q2, the deliveries of the Xiaomi SU7 Series reached 27,307 vehicles, with monthly deliveries surpassing 10,000 units for two consecutive months. The ramp-up in production capacity is outpacing that of its peers, showcasing strong competitive strength. Since June, Xiaomi Auto Factory has initiated double-shift operations, aiming to hit the Group’s target of delivering 100,000 vehicles by November, ahead of schedule. The Company will also target to deliver 120,000 vehicles of Xiaomi SU7 Series for the year 2024. As of June 30, 2024, Xiaomi has opened 87 smart EV sales centres in mainland China, driving continuous order growth and providing users with a full range of professional car protection. The Group's ample cash resources ensure that Xiaomi smart EV business can maintain its focus on technology and product development amid intense market competition, thereby boosting its influence and core competitiveness. Xiaomi continues to accumulate in-depth self-research capabilities, achieving new progress and breakthroughs in core technologies that significantly enhance product competitiveness. In July 2024, the Group unveiled the Xiaomi SU7 Ultra prototype , announcing plans to record an outstanding lap time at the Nürburgring Nordschleife circuit in October. The aim is to become the fastest four-door electric vehicle on the circuit within the next decade. AI fully empowers Xiaomi “Human x Car x Home” smart ecosystem, driving premium market growth The Group continued to embrace AI to enhance its “Human x Car x Home” smart ecosystem. In Q2, Xiaomi investment in R&D continued to expand, with expenses reaching RMB5.5 billion, up 20.7% YoY. Xiaomi AI technology has made innovative breakthroughs in several areas, notably the smart EV sector. This technology is widely applied, offering robust technical support for Autopilot, automated parking, and voice interaction via the Xiaomi AI assistant. In terms of smartphone products, Xiaomi has enhanced the multimodal recognition and understanding capabilities of its AI assistant, bringing users a host of features including AI document analytics and AI video generation. These innovations underpin Xiaomi's growth in the premium market. According to third-party data, in 2024 Q2, Xiaomi premium smartphone models priced at or above RMB3,000 accounted for 22.1% of total smartphone shipments in mainland China, marking a YoY increase of 2.0 percentage points. The market shares of smartphones in the RMB3,000 to 4,000, RMB4,000 to 5,000, and RMB5,000 to 6,000 price segments were 16.8%, 20.1%, and 8.9% respectively, all registering YoY growth. On July 19, Xiaomi unveiled its next-generation flagship foldable device, the Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 , along with its first compact foldable device, the Xiaomi MIX Flip , in mainland China. The performance of the two foldable smartphone models has significantly outpaced expectations, further enhancing Xiaomi's reputation in the premium market. The Xiaomi MIX Flip has garnered considerable acclaim for its unique foldable design and innovative [4.01-inch outer display featuring AI offline translation capabilities]. The company relentlessly builds amazing products with honest prices to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology. Xiaomi is one of the world’s leading smartphone companies. In June 2024, the MAU reached approximately 675.8 million globally. The company has also established the world’s leading consumer AIoT (AI+IoT) platform, reached approximately 822.2 million smart devices connected to its platform (excluding smartphones, laptops and tablets) as of June 30, 2024. Xiaomi products are present in more than 100 countries and regions around the world. In August 2024, Xiaomi was included in the Fortune Global 500 list for the sixth year in a row. headings: Xiaomi MIX Fold 4: Three major breakthroughs.
Xiaomi MIX Flip: Reaching the peak of flip smartphones
text: Beijing, China, July 19, 2024 - Xiaomi held the 2024 Lei Jun Annual Speech at the ShouGang Stadium, officially launching the new Xiaomi MIX lineup. Xiaomi has achieved further innovation in foldable phones, thanks to comprehensive technology covering materials, structure, and network functionality. Both products set new industry standards, with Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 offering core innovations in overall architecture, hinge, and battery. Additionally, it has been designed exceptionally thin without compromising strength or configuration. Also launched, Xiaomi MIX Flip excels in performance, battery, and network functionality, meeting standards of non-foldable phones and breaking the stereotype of flip phones offering reduced overall capabilities. With its sizable external display and innovative interactivity, most daily operations can be performed smoothly on the external display without opening the device. Xiaomi MIX Fold 4: Three major breakthroughs. New achievements in weight and versatility. As a leader in lightweight foldable smartphones, Xiaomi has integrated years of accumulated experience into developing Xiaomi MIX Fold 4. This incredible device has made significant breakthroughs, defying the common assumption that foldable smartphones are heavy or inconvenient. Three Key Technologies, Lightweight Design The new generation of Xiaomi's proprietary hinge has achieved remarkable weight reduction and compact breakthroughs. Using high-strength materials paired with a wear-resistant carbon ceramic steel transmission mechanism has improved hinge reliability. Overall thickness and weight have been significantly reduced, with the total hinge volume reduced by 34%². The new design has an unfolded thickness of just 4.59mm¹ and a folded thickness of 9.47mm¹. This design breakthrough provides users with an unprecedented, lightweight experience. For the first time, Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 fully adopts "all-carbon architecture". The hinge floating plate, display backing plate, and middle plate battery compartment are all precision-molded from T800H carbon fiber material. This significantly enhances overall strength and durability and considerably reduces weight. Carbon fiber's excellent tensile performance and reliability provide users with a safer and more lightweight experience, showcasing Xiaomi's innovative capabilities in optimizing material technology. Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 has achieved several technological breakthroughs in manufacturing processes. The innovative three-layer, five-surface motherboard design combined with large-area tin spraying technology achieves high-precision soldering, significantly improving circuit stability and reliability. Additionally for the first time, application of three-dimensional shaped battery technology and three-dimensional stacking process utilizes irregular space in the motherboard COP packaging area, increasing battery capacity by 260mAh to 5100mAh. These precise manufacturing processes advance manufacturing technology and provide users with longer-lasting battery life experience. Exceptional performance, long-lasting battery, strong network functionality, and overall excellence Featuring the latest Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 Mobile Platform and innovative 3D cooling system, the large-area cooling system measures 11,912 square millimeters¹. It uses advanced vapor chamber technology to quickly dissipate heat, which is then evenly distributed through multiple layers of graphite, effectively preventing heat buildup. The robust performance combined with excellent cooling ensures sustainable performance even under high load. In terms of battery, the 5,100mAh high-capacity battery features new-generation silicon-carbon anode technology, enhancing energy density. The self-developed Xiaomi Surge battery management system controls charging and discharging processes, effectively extending battery life, while 67W wired charging and 50W wireless charging balance fast charging with battery health. The new generation E7 luminous material and Pol-less Plus technology offer low-power consumption by the display, helping users ease battery anxiety. In terms of network functionality, Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 is equipped with powerful antenna architecture, including four industry-leading low-frequency receiving antennas and four Xiaomi Surge T1 signal enhancement chips. This is deeply integrated with the Xiaomi HyperOS network subsystem to ensure smooth communication in various holding positions and usage environments. Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 also supports two-way satellite communication, providing connectivity even in remote areas without cellular signal coverage. It fully supports mainstream global communication bands and includes a "Travel Assistant" feature to provide convenience for frequent travellers. Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 comes with two top-tier flagship displays. The inner display features a 7.98-inch Samsung E7 LTPO panel with a resolution of 2488x2244, supporting a 1-120Hz adaptive refresh rate and HDR10+ for unparalleled visual effects. The outer display is a 6.56-inch C8+ panel with a resolution of 2520x1080, which also supports a 120Hz high refresh rate and a P3 color gamut display. The inner display uses advanced Pol-less Plus technology, significantly reducing power consumption while enhancing brightness and color performance, ensuring the best visual experience possible in unfolded and folded states. Both Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 displays support Dolby Vision® technology, providing users an extreme HDR experience. Dolby Vision® enhances brightness and contrast, bringing more color layers and details, making each frame vivid. Users can enjoy cinema-grade visuals, whether watching movies or even video calls. Quad camera system with Leica Optical Lens and Master Portraits Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 features a Leica optical quad-camera system covering all focal lengths. Despite the device being thinner and lighter, its imaging capabilities have been significantly enhanced. The main camera uses a new 50MP Light Fusion 800 high dynamic range sensor, introducing "Dual Native ISO Fusion Max" technology for the first time in Xiaomi's foldable products. This technology provides more accurate color reproduction and better detail retention in high-contrast scenes. The 12MP ultra-wide-angle lens offers a 120° field of view, while the 50MP Leica floating telephoto lens delivers excellent portrait effects and macro photography capabilities. The 115mm Leica ultra-telephoto lens, with a periscope structure, also supports close-up shooting. These four lenses work perfectly, achieving seamless coverage across all focal lengths. The innovative Xiaomi AISP, powered by Snapdragon 8® Gen 3's processing power and the Xiaomi HyperOS AI, with up to 60TOPS AI processing speeds, supports complex imaging scenarios. The new "Master Portrait" combines the power of PortraitLM and aesthetics learned from real-life photographers, offering a look "a little more ideal than reality," enhancing portrait beauty without deviating from reality. Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 adheres to Leica's natural color science and classic tones, avoiding excessive sharpening and algorithms. Two Leica photographic styles with customizable features meet professional creative needs. The unique foldable form brings new shooting possibilities: hands-free hover selfies and external display framing when unfolded, transforming the flagship foldable phone into a portable professional imaging studio. This showcases Xiaomi's deep integration of foldable display and imaging technology. Regarding smart experience, Xiaomi HyperOS is deeply optimized for large-display scenarios and adds multiple AI functions. Innovations such as the AI conference assistant, multimodal capabilities, and AI integration in system applications comprehensively enhance user productivity and operational convenience. Reliability has been further improved with Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 using Xiaomi's composite fiber, providing sturdiness like never before. The mid-frame uses 6M42 aluminum alloy, significantly increasing strength; the outer display is equipped with Xiaomi Shield Glass, and the inner display uses UTG ultra-thin flexible glass, providing all-around display protection. The hinge is upgraded with 1800MPa ultra-strong steel, accounting for 82.6% of the hinge, with an opening and closing lifespan of 500,000 times², and has received SGS reliable folding certification. Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 also introduces the new Xiaomi Guardian Structure, woven with S2 premium glass fiber on a base of aramid fiber and ceramic fiber, offering excellent abrasion resistance, overall strength increased by 15%² compared to the previous generation, featuring a sturdy, wear resistance, and a pleasant hand feel. Xiaomi MIX Flip: Reaching the peak of flip smartphones Xiaomi is a newcomer in the compact foldable market, but features exceptional capabilities. Xiaomi MIX Flip leverages Xiaomi's years of technological experience to create a compact foldable device. It achieves breakthroughs in performance, battery life, and network functionality, even when compared to traditional flagship devices. A highly functional flagship outer display Outer display on flip devices have evolved from small to full display, but seamlessly using daily applications via the outer display required additional efforts. Xiaomi MIX Flip features a 4-inch All Around Liquid outer display with a quad-curved design, providing a smooth hand feel. The outer display interaction has been restructured, allowing it to function as a highly functional "compact phone" without opening the device. Xiaomi MIX Flip's outer display meets modern specifications: 1.5K resolution, 460PPI, 120Hz refresh rate, 3000 nits peak brightness, Original Color Pro, HDR support, and eye protection. These specifications stay consistent from inner to outer display to ensure a uniform experience. Based on the new display form and popular daily scenarios, Xiaomi HyperOS completely reimagines outer display features, making it possible for the outer display to meet most daily usage needs. Xiaomi MIX Flip outer display inherits the comprehensive display gestures and notification/control center swipe-down interaction logic of everyday flagships, with almost no learning curve. It supports auto-rotation, is suitable for both left and right hands, and features a full-display keyboard nearly as wide as the inner display for comfortable typing. Over 200 of the most popular applications run perfectly on the equivalent 3.5", 16:9 main application area, covering communication, entertainment, health, reading, shopping, and learning apps. Thanks to the flexible framework of Xiaomi HyperOS, applications display without obstructions or cropping, offering a smooth experience. Innovative partition design allows widgets to display time, weather, step count, music control, and recently used apps during daily use. In scenarios like calling taxis, food delivery, flights/trains, widgets will automatically switch to focus notification display, updating status information in real-time. This outer display integrates deeply with the「Human x Car x Home」eco-system. AI, Xiaomi EV, and Mi Home apps are deeply adapted to the outer display scenario, allowing users to manage personal daily affairs and control the status of their Xiaomi EV's and smart home devices. The Xiaomi HyperMind intelligent learning center is also adapted to the outer display, learning and recording users' smart home device usage habits and proactively executing them. AI Input Assistant, integrated into the outer display input method, can help users refine or generate text as needed, making text creation easier. Many compact foldable products only support hands-free calls when closed, which users often criticize. Xiaomi MIX Flip addresses the three core issues with a holistic approach, ensuring excellent call quality whether open or closed: Signal strength: X iaomi MIX Flip's antenna hardware architecture, combined with the intelligent tuning capabilities of the Xiaomi Surge T1 signal enhancement chip and grip recognition algorithm, smartly selects the optimal antenna, avoiding weak signals. A udio output: Xiaomi MIX Flip uses a dual dipole system, with one sound unit equipped with a diaphragm for both the inner and outer displays, supporting earpiece calls when open or closed. Leveraging the physical characteristics of the dipole speaker system's "opposite phase cancellation," it supports privacy calls, preventing call voice from spreading externally and ensuring privacy in any state. An independent noise-canceling microphone near the hinge and the top-frame ensure call quality when closed. True flagship performance when unfolded Xiaomi MIX Flip is powered by the Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 Mobile Platform, making it one of the few compact foldable devices using an up-to-date flagship chipset. To ensure comprehensive performance, Xiaomi has redesigned a 3D cooling system for Xiaomi MIX Flip: a large 3500mm² VC area with a unique "staircase" design that quickly dissipates heat from the SoC; heat is evenly conducted through double-layer graphite over the hinge, avoiding accumulation of heat. Xiaomi's SU7 "aerogel" thermal insulation material is used near the inner display side of the "staircase" structure, effectively blocking heat transfer to the display and improving the user experience when touching the display. Xiaomi MIX Flip features Xiaomi's Surge battery with 6% silicon content in the negative electrode. It achieves an energy density of 780Wh/L and an ultra-high capacity of 4780mAh, surpassing the flagship Xiaomi 14. The Xiaomi Surge battery management system precisely manages the charging and discharging process, extending battery life. Combined with the battery's self-healing properties, it can maintain at least 80% capacity after 1600 cycles². This gives Xiaomi MIX Flip a battery life performance comparable to non-foldable models, alleviating battery anxiety for compact foldable users. Xiaomi MIX Flip shares the same low-frequency antenna design as Xiaomi 14 Ultra and is equipped with the Xiaomi Surge T1 signal enhancement chip. The excellent antenna architecture and Xiaomi HyperOS's deep tuning and network self-learning capabilities ensure smooth communication in any holding position and scenario. It supports cutting-edge connectivity with Wi-Fi 7 and 5G-A, pushing connectivity speed further. Additionally, it fully supports global frequency bands and includes a "Travel Assistant" feature, providing timely reminders of crucial information during flights and train journeys for business travelers. Xiaomi MIX Flip also offers simultaneous display capabilities for AI offline translation on both the inner and outer displays, facilitating communication during foreign conversations by showing real-time bilingual translations on both sides. Xiaomi MIX Flip features Xiaomi's composite fiber material, providing sturdiness and protection. The middle frame uses the same 6M42 aluminum alloy as the MIX Fold 4, doubling the strength; Xiaomi Shield Glass and UTG ultra-thin flexible glass protect the outer and inner displays. The compact dual-link hinge's internal mechanism uses the same high-strength and wear-resistant materials as the MIX Fold 4, with a folding and unfolding lifespan of 500,000 times², certified by SGS reliable folding certification. It also offers a Xiaomi Nylon Fiber special edition of meticulously woven nylon fiber with excellent abrasion and stain resistance. Leica imaging in your pocket Xiaomi MIX Flip is equipped with Xiaomi x Leica next-generation Summilux lenses. The main camera uses the Light Fusion 800 high dynamic range sensor. It also features the unique 47mm Leica floating telephoto lens in a compact foldable device with a minimum focusing distance of 9cm. Xiaomi MIX Flip also incorporates the Xiaomi AISP large model computational photography platform, supporting advanced imaging scenarios with up to 60 TOPS of processing power. The new "Master Portrait" mode, based on the PortraitLM large model and guided by real-life photographers, enhances portrait beauty beyond reality while maintaining authenticity. The compact body, large outer display, and foldable form bring unprecedented freedom to the imaging capabilities of Xiaomi MIX Flip. When closed, the large outer display can be used with the two Leica optical lenses for photography and video recording, and it even supports a makeup mirror mode, allowing users to check their makeup using the floating telephoto lens. When in hover mode, it eliminates the need for a tripod, making it suitable for group photos, video recording, and time-lapse photography. It also supports outer display preview while taking pictures, enabling others to monitor and adjust their status in real time when helping capture the shot. Xiaomi has also specially designed the "Xiaomi Photography Kit," which, when connected, allows for instant shooting and printing, capturing memorable moments. The launch of Xiaomi MIX foldable series marks a new milestone, showcasing Xiaomi's effort to solve users' pain points and introduce new technology. It embodies Xiaomi's relentless pursuit of innovation and quality, promising an excellent user experience. Xiaomi MIX Fold 4 is available in White, Black, Blue, and Xiaomi composite fiber editions, with various memory versions starting at 8999 yuan. Xiaomi MIX Flip comes in White, Black, Purple, and Xiaomi nylon fiber editions, starting at 5999 yuan. After the launch event, it will be available simultaneously on Xiaomi Mall, Xiaomi Home, Xiaomi Tmall's official flagship store, and Xiaomi JD's flagship store. text: Beijing, CHINA, June 21, 2024 - Xiaomi today announced the addition of a brand-new color variant to its Redmi Note 13 Series — the Olive Green Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G. Redmi Note has built a solid reputation for delivering flagship-level features at accessible prices. Known for its powerful camera system, it has played a significant role in popularizing high-resolution photography in mid-range smartphones. In 2019, Redmi Note 7 pioneered high resolution in the mid-range smartphone segment with its 48MP camera. In the following years, Redmi Note 8 Pro introduced a 64MP camera, while Redmi Note 10 Pro advanced the trend with a 108MP camera, before Redmi Note 12 Pro+ 5G took this a notch higher, debuting Redmi Note's very first 200MP camera in 2023. The 200MP camera has extended to this year's Redmi Note 13 Pro models, while the Redmi Note 13 base models boast a 108MP camera. Furthermore, this ultra-high resolution camera in this year's Pro models is supported by optical image stabilization (OIS) for enhanced clarity and sharpness, along with 2x/4x in-sensor zoom for greater versatility in capturing distant subjects. Beyond its commitment to camera excellence, Xiaomi also prioritizes catering to user preferences with its Redmi Note series. Redmi Note 13 Series offers a range of colors ¹ to suit diverse tastes, including the special edition Mystic Silver Redmi Note 13 Pro+ 5G, launched in celebration of Xiaomi Fan Festival, and adorned with an embossed Fan Festival logo. Today's new Olive Green variant, featuring a glossy finish, adds to the aesthetic appeal of the Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G lineup, and expands the palette of colors available to users by joining existing options such as Midnight Black, Ocean Teal, and Aurora Purple. Not only does Redmi Note offer enhanced choice to users, but more importantly these devices have been designed with user needs in mind. To name one example, Redmi Note series introduced ultra-fast charging to save time, while adding in large battery capacities to allow for uninterrupted usage throughout the day. The introduction of a 120Hz AMOLED display in Redmi Note 10 Pro set the stage for seamless scrolling on a vivid screen, a feature that has carried through to all Redmi Note 13 models today. With a high peak brightness of 1800 nits on Redmi Note 13 Pro+ 5G, Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G, and Redmi Note 13, users can enjoy crystal-clear viewing, even in bright sunlight. Moreover, Corning ® Gorilla ® Glass Victus ® provides enhanced durability for Redmi Note 13 Pro+ 5G and Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G, offering peace of mind for users. Building on Redmi Note's commitment to offer flagship-level features at accessible prices, Redmi Note 13 Series presents a broad spectrum of options to cater to diverse user demands. Equipped with the same high-performance specifications as the other color options launched in January, the newest Olive Green Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G will be available in select countries and regions starting from 399 USD through Xiaomi's official sales channels, with pricing varying by region. text: Beijing, CHINA, June 5, 2024 - Xiaomi today unveiled Redmi 13, the latest member of its Redmi family, setting a new standard for entry-level smartphones. Crafted for discerning users seeking both style and substance, Redmi 13 delivers a sleek, stylish design packed with a host of enhanced capabilities that defy expectations. One example is its 108MP super-clear main camera, aimed at elevating the photography experience for avid enthusiasts, content creators, and those who prioritize capturing life's moments with exceptional clarity and detail. With a stylish glass back design, a large AdaptiveSync display with a refresh rate of up to 90Hz, ¹ and support for 33W fast charging, ² Redmi 13 represents a leap forward for the Redmi range, underlining Xiaomi's commitment to provide exceptional value for its users. 108MP super-clear camera and fun features for an unparalleled photography experience As a first for the Redmi number series, Redmi 13 debuts a 108MP super-clear main camera, equipped with 3x in-sensor zoom to provide users with images of outstanding detail. Harnessing the advanced Samsung ISOCELL HM6 1/1.67" sensor and cutting-edge 9-in-1 pixel binning technology, Redmi 13 can produce ultra-clear night photos and vibrant HDR images steeped in vividness and clarity. Whether capturing breathtaking landscapes or precious moments with loved ones, Redmi 13 empowers users to take stunning photos with ease. Beyond exceptional main camera performance, Redmi 13 also caters to selfie enthusiasts. With its upgraded 13MP front camera and soft-light ring which uses the display to create natural and balanced lighting, Redmi 13 delivers incredible selfies. Helping users to elevate their photography game are an array of creative features, such as a variety of filmCamera vintage filters that provide real-time previews, evoking a nostalgic, classic feel, and filmFrame, which lets users add a range of frame designs. Whether documenting travels or sharing memorable experiences, Redmi 13 enables users to express their creativity with its diverse features. Elegant glass back design to advance your style Redmi 13 introduces a refined touch to the Redmi series with its sleek glass back design. Available in four color options — Midnight Black, Sandy Gold, Pearl Pink, and the standout Ocean Blue, ³ which boasts a captivating effect that mimics the ripples of the sea — Redmi 13 caters to users seeking both style and sophistication. Offering a lightweight yet quality feel in hand, Redmi 13 is just 8.3mm ⁴ slim. It also provides protection against wet weather conditions and accidental spills with its IP53 certification. ⁵ Redmi 13 delivers an outstanding blend of style, performance, and reliability for users seeking a device that effortlessly complements their lifestyle. Immersive 6.79-inch display with AdaptiveSync refresh rate to offer an enhanced viewing experience With an expansive 6.79-inch FHD+ display incorporating AdaptiveSync technology, Redmi 13 intelligently adjusts its refresh rate up to 90Hz based on usage scenarios, ¹ ensuring a seamless and responsive experience while optimizing battery life. With superb color depth and a peak brightness of 550 nits, content on Redmi 13 appears vibrant and crystal clear, even under bright sunlight. Designed with user convenience and durability in mind, Redmi 13 comes with a Corning® Gorilla® Glass display for resilience against everyday wear and tear, and optimization for enhanced touch recognition and control, effectively preventing accidental triggers from water droplets. Meanwhile, users can rest assured in the device's eye-care experience, thanks to triple TÜV Rheinland certifications for Low Blue Light, Flicker Free, and Circadian Friendly attributes. By incorporating DC dimming, the device further reduces eye strain and enhances comfort in low-light environments, providing users with added peace of mind. Large 5030mAh battery with 33W fast charging ² for users to maximize their day Equipped with a massive 5030mAh battery, Redmi 13 delivers solid all-day performance on a single charge. Users can enjoy extended periods of use, with up to approximately 23 hours of calling or 28 hours of music after just 60 minutes of charging. ⁶ Additionally, with a mere five minutes of charging, users can experience two hours of calling. ⁶ Redmi 13 can be powered up to 100% charge in just 62 minutes, ⁶ thanks to its 33W fast charging. ² But Redmi 13 isn't just about power – it's about delivering a seamless and intuitive user experience. Running on the latest Xiaomi HyperOS, ⁷ the device boasts a revamped user interface with enhanced home screen options, improved notification management, and intuitive widgets for effortless navigation and customization. At its core is the MediaTek Helio G91-Ultra mobile platform that offers robust performance for the latest gaming titles and seamless multitasking between apps. With support for up to 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage,⁸ users can experience enhanced performance and storage capacity, further bolstered by memory extension technology that increases available memory to a maximum of 16GB. ⁹ Additionally, storage configurations of 128GB and 256GB can be expanded with support for up to 1TB of expandable storage, ⁹ ensuring users have ample space for their favorite apps, games, and media content. Bringing added convenience, Redmi 13 incorporates practical features such as a 3.5mm headphone jack for hassle-free audio connectivity, a side-mounted fingerprint reader for quick and secure access, and Flash notifications via a rear LED light for alarms and incoming calls. ¹⁰ Price and availability Redmi 13 is available in Midnight Black, Sandy Gold, Pearl Pink, and Ocean Blue,³ in 6GB+128GB, 8GB+128GB and 8GB+256GB configurations, ⁸ starting from 179 USD . text: Advancing into a robust growth trajectory, fueled by multiple engines Beijing, Hong Kong, May 23, 2024 — Xiaomi Corporation (“Xiaomi” or the “Group”; stock code:1810), a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an Internet of Things (“IoT”) platform at its core, announced its unaudited consolidated results for the three months ended March 31, 2024 (“the Period” or “Q1”) with quarterly revenue registering double-digit year-over-year (“YoY”) growth for two consecutive quarters. During the Period, the Group’s total revenue amounted to RMB75.5 billion, an increase of 27% YoY. Adjusted net profit hit a record high, increasing by 100.8% YoY to RMB6.5 billion. This included RMB2.3 billion in expenses related to its smart Electric Vehicle (“EV”) business and other new initiatives, signaling accelerated growth. Due to the efficient execution of its core operating strategy of “dual emphasis on scale and profitability”, in the first quarter of 2024, Xiaomi’s gross profit margin reached 22.3% at the Group level, an increase of 2.8 percentage points YoY. The Group diligently executed its operating strategies, driving double-digit revenue growth in Q1 in its three core businesses — smartphones, IoT and lifestyle products, and internet services. Xiaomi’s multiple growth engines, combined with its robust performance of the smart EV business, propelled its results to far exceed market estimates. The profitability of Xiaomi’s core businesses remains solid over the long term, with abundant cash resources facilitating strong support for technological innovation and development of smart EV business. As of March 31, 2024, the Group’s cash resources reached RMB127.3 billion. Its research and development expenses in the first quarter were RMB 5.2 billion, up 25.4% YoY, with numerous technological breakthroughs achieved, particularly in smart EV technologies. Premiumization strategy pays off with rising ASP of smartphones Driven by globalization and premiumization strategies, Xiaomi’s global smartphone shipments increased by 33.7% YoY to 40.6 million units during the Period, marking YoY growth for three consecutive quarters. Smartphone revenue achieved fourth consecutive quarter’s growth, reaching RMB46.5 billion. According to Canalys, Xiaomi maintained its top three global smartphone shipment ranking for 15 consecutive quarters, with a 13.8% market share in the first quarter. The profitability of smartphone business continued to improve, with the gross profit margin in the first quarter reaching 14.8%, an increase of 3.6 percentage points YoY. The Group continued to make strides into premium price segments. According to third-party data, Xiaomi’s market share of smartphone sales in the RMB5,000 to RMB6,000 price segment in mainland China reached 10.1% during the Period, up by 5.8 percentage points YoY. The proportion of global premium smartphone shipment also reached a new high in the first quarter, representing 21.7% of total smartphone shipments, up by 1.4 percentage points YoY. Xiaomi’s global expansion has paid off, with solid growth in key markets across the Middle East, Latin America, Africa, and Southeast Asia. According to Canalys, in the first quarter of 2024, the Group’s smartphone shipments ranked among the top three across 56 countries and regions globally and among the top five across 67 countries and regions globally. Compared to last year, Xiaomi ranked among the top three in 51 markets and the top five in 65 markets. The Group’s competitive edge in these markets has further strengthened. IoT business margin hits record high with smart large home appliances showing strong momentum During the Period, IoT and lifestyle products reached a historic high, with revenue increasing by 21.0% YoY to RMB20.4 billion. The gross profit margin notably increased by 4.1 percentage points YoY to 19.9%, hitting a record high. Xiaomi further consolidated its leading edge in IoT product categories. Capitalizing on its market reputation, rich product portfolio and exceptional user experience within the smart ecosystem, Xiaomi’s revenue from smart large home appliances increased by over 46% YoY, with sales volume maintaining strong growth. During the quarter, the air conditioner shipments exceeded 690,000 units, up 63%; the refrigerator shipments exceeded 530,000 units, an increase of 52%; and the washing machine shipments exceeded 360,000 units, up 47%, all on a YoY basis. Xiaomi’s premium TV category also underwent continuous upgrades. The growth momentum across all product categories remained strong. According to IDC, the global shipments of Xiaomi tablets increased by 93% YoY. Additionally, Xiaomi has made significant strides in the wearables. According to Canalys, the TWS earbud shipments ranked No. 1 in mainland China, and rose to No. 2 globally. Solid internet services growth spurs global expansion During the Period, internet services maintained solid growth, with revenue reaching a record high of RMB8.0 billion, representing an increase of 14.5% YoY. The gross profit margin of internet services reached 74.2%. The Group’s MAU globally and in mainland China both hit record highs. In March 2024, global MAU reached 658.1 million, an increase of 10.6% YoY, while the MAU in mainland China reached 160.4 million, up 9.7% YoY. Xiaomi has been actively solidifying global partnerships. In the first quarter, revenue from overseas internet services reached RMB2.5 billion, hitting a record high and accounting for 31.2% of total internet services revenue. Scaling EV production to target over 100,000 new vehicles delivery for 2024 The debut of Xiaomi’s smart EV has sparked tremendous enthusiasm among users, swiftly emerging as a new growth engine. Xiaomi’s first smart EV, the Xiaomi SU7 Series , was officially launched on March 28, 2024, completing the overall layout of the Group’s strategy of “Human × Car × Home”. Positioned as a “full-size high-performance eco-technology sedan”, the Xiaomi SU7 Series includes three models, with prices starting at RMB215,900. The official launch garnered widespread market attention, generating strong order demand. As of April 30, the cumulative locked-in orders for the Xiaomi SU7 Series reached 88,063 vehicles. As of 10:00 a.m. Beijing time on May 15, the cumulative deliveries reached 10,000 vehicles, setting a new industry record for delivery speed by a new brand’s debut car model. Buoyed by the exceptional performance of Xiaomi’s SU7 Series, which exceeded market expectation, the Group has set a target of over 100,000 new vehicle deliveries for 2024, showcasing its confidence in the series’ competitiveness and production capacity. Xiaomi is bolstering efforts to ramp up the expansion of production capacity by starting double shift production in June to ensure timely delivery, and expand its sales and service network. The Group plans that by the end of 2024, its sales and service network will encompass 219 sales stores covering 46 cities, and 143 service centers across 86 cities. As a tech company venturing into the EV manufacturing industry, Xiaomi aims to integrate smart features. The Group is firmly committed to its new goal for 2020–2030, which is to invest in foundational core technologies and to become a global leader in the evolving realm of cutting-edge technologies. In the first quarter of 2024, its research and development expenses were RMB5.2 billion, up 25.4% YoY. Xiaomi has made substantial advancements in smart EV technology, underpinning the continuous development of its smart EV. For Xiaomi Pilot Autonomous Driving, Xiaomi remains committed to full-stack proprietary technology research and development. By harnessing advanced frameworks that incorporate cutting-edge algorithms such as Road-Mapping Foundational Model, Super-Res Occupancy Network Technology and Adaptive BEV Technology, Xiaomi has made a breakthrough with the first mass production of End-to-end AI Model Technology in mainland China. Xiaomi’s autonomous driving team boasts over 1,000 skilled professionals, with a plan to expand the team to 1,500 and 2,000 in 2024 and 2025 respectively. City Navigate on Autopilot (NOA) on Xiaomi Pilot Max is scheduled to be rolled out across 10 cities in mainland China by the end of May 2024, with nationwide coverage expected by August 2024. text: Beijing, CHINA, April 26, 2024 — Xiaomi today unveiled its sixth environmental, social, and governance (ESG) report. The over 80-page document published in Chinese and English outlines the progress that Xiaomi and its subsidiaries have made in the realm of ESG implementation, management, and strategy in 2023. This extensive report is divided into 4 main sections: Technology Created to Better Lives, Xiaomi's Zero Carbon Philosophy, Shared Success for Partners, and Governance and Compliance. Technology Created to Better Lives Under its mission of letting “everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology”, Xiaomi remains dedicated to making technology accessible and inclusive for all. In 2023, an innovation in this regard included AI Identification Glasses, showcased by Xiaomi engineers during the Group’s fourth Hackathon Technology Competition. With ambient sound detection technology and gesture interaction intelligent technology, these glasses help to aid users through daily life. Moreover, numerous accessibility features have been incorporated into the company’s newly introduced operating system, Xiaomi HyperOS. These include Xiaomi Ambient Sound Recognition, haptic feedback, and an AI Dialing Assistant, underscoring Xiaomi's commitment to inclusive and accessible technology. HyperOS serves as a unified operating system, designed to integrate seamlessly with the envisioned "Human x Car x Home" smart ecosystem, and aims to bring greater security, foster seamless connectivity among the myriad of devices, and optimize individual device performance. At the same time, the company worked to enhance its smart manufacturing processes, regarded as a means for greater efficiency of resource utilization and reduced waste. This strategic move facilitated further progress in emerging sectors such as robotics, smart electric vehicles, and unmanned factories, reflecting Xiaomi's dedication to technological innovation and sustainability. Zero Carbon Philosophy Embracing a zero-carbon philosophy, Xiaomi prioritizes low-carbon practices across its operations and extends support to suppliers in adopting climate-conscious measures. The company's commitment to carbon neutrality is underscored with the introduction of its first White Paper on Climate Action at COP28 in Dubai in the winter of 2023, outlining its Zero-carbon Philosophy and approach to zero carbon. During the year, the company announced its commitment to 100% renewable electricity in its operations by 2035, and carbon neutrality plus 100% renewable energy in its own operations by 2040. Additionally, its trade-in service was upgraded in select European markets, including Spain, France, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Italy, and Poland, furthering its commitment to sustainable practices and responsible consumerism. In acknowledgement of its strides made in sustainability in 2023, Xiaomi was awarded a Gold certification from the Alliance for Water Stewardship, making Xiaomi Science and Technology Campus the first commercial building globally to apply for such a certification. Further, earlier this week, on Earth Day (April 22, 2024), Xiaomi’s dedication to waste minimization and environmental stewardship was showcased in the announcement of a partnership with public welfare and diving instructor organization, Professional Association of Diving Instructors (PADI). Through a series of engaging online and offline activities, including beach clean-ups in select parts of Southeast Asia on April 27 with Xiaomi Fans and the creation of limited edition Xiaomi and PADI merchandise crafted from recycled fishing nets, Xiaomi aims to raise awareness about marine conservation and inspire collective action. Shared Success for Partners Xiaomi is committed not only to the growth and well-being of its own employees but also to ensuring transparency across its supply chain, while making meaningful contributions to society and the global community. Through concerted efforts to create a comfortable work environment, Xiaomi earned a spot on Forbes' list of the World's Best Employers 2023, ranked among the top 3 of Universum's list of China's Most Attractive Employers, and was recognized by Forbes China as China's Best Employer in Innovative Practices of the Year. With a steadfast focus on research and development, Xiaomi actively promotes engagement for its employees in innovative research projects through the Xiaomi Foundation. Notably, collaborations with over 150 universities and colleges led to groundbreaking innovations like the Xiaomi AIoT Box, showcasing the company's prowess in seamlessly integrating hardware and software to simulate diverse scenarios through the Mijia app. Besides nurturing internal talent, of paramount importance is also ensuring the functionality and sustainability of the supply chain. To this end, the company has introduced a risk management framework to identify and manage ESG risks in this regard. By leveraging means such as on-site audits and assessment questionnaires and by working closely with its suppliers, Xiaomi seeks to gain a full understanding of potential issues so that action can be taken to solve these. It also has a stringent evaluation mechanism in place for new suppliers and ESG compliance remains a top priority in this process. Beyond safeguarding the supply chain, Xiaomi extends its impact on society through philanthropic endeavors. Throughout the year, the Xiaomi Foundation facilitated numerous donations for natural disaster relief and social welfare initiatives, underscoring the company's commitment to corporate social responsibility. Governance and Compliance Meanwhile, Xiaomi Group continued to raise the bar of its ESG management system, with a firm belief that it is a key pillar in the health and development of the company. To this end, the Board is regularly updated on progress in this area. In recognition of its efforts in 2023, Xiaomi received several awards and accolades, including Best ESG in the Technology Hardware sector by Institutional Investor, and ESG Company to Watch of the Year by Bloomberg Green. Moreover, the company's steadfast commitment to equality and diversity culminated in the appointment of its first female director to the Board in January 2024, a milestone highlighting Xiaomi's progressive approach to inclusivity. Further, reinforcing its dedication to innovation and intellectual property protection, Xiaomi concluded the 2023 reporting period with over 37,000 patents secured globally, a testament to its unwavering pursuit of cutting-edge development and respect for intellectual property rights. The release of the 2023 Environmental, Social, and Governance report reflects Xiaomi's commitment to playing its part to better the world in which we live, and the progress it has made in this regard. Through efforts in innovative technology, a zero carbon philosophy, a drive for the nurturing of the entire supply chain, and stringent governance and compliance, the company has made significant strides on its way to a sustainable future.
